gameText: Exert Gandalf twice to remove all threats and to heal all companions of one culture (except <symbol>gandalf</symbol>).
loreText: Wherever he came men's hearts would lift again, and the winged shadows pass from memory.

title: Echoes of Valinor
gameText: Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may exert him to draw 2 cards.
loreText: Here in the Court of the Kings, Isildur grew a white tree, from a seed brought over the waters....'

title: Fool's Hope
gameText: Spot Gandalf and discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent discard all but 2 Shadow conditions.
loreText: There never was much hope....'

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Defender of the West
gameText: While you cannot spot 3 companions of the same culture, Gandalf is strength 2.
loreText: I come with counsel and tidings in this dark hour.'

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Manager of Wizards
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Place 3 cards from hand on top of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength 3. Any Shadow player may place 3 cards from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck to prevent this.

title: Gandalf's Staff
subtitle: Focus of Power
gameText:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
While you can spot 4 twilight tokens, Gandalf is strength +1.

title: Glamdring
subtitle: Elven Blade
gameText:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
He is Damage +1.
Skirmish: If you have more cards in hand than each opponent, discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent exert a minion.

title: Have Patience
gameText: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.

title: Intimidate
gameText:
Spell.
If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.

title: King's Advisor
gameText: Exert Gandalf twice to make an opponent exert a minion for each <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion you spot.
loreText: Will they answer the summons, think you?'

title: Light the Beacons
gameText: Exert Gandalf three times (or twice if you have initiative) to make all unbound companions of one culture (except <symbol>gandalf</symbol>) strength +3 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Theoden will honour your old alliance and come with a mighty army.'

title: Moment of Respite
gameText: At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard 2 cards from hand to heal Gandalf.
loreText: ...Gandalf says you must go ere nightfall, and the Lord of the Mark is eager for his own house.'

title: Númenor's Pride
gameText:
To play, spot Gandalf and add 3 threats.
Gandalf is defender +1 and cannot take wounds.
Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

title: Peace of Mind
gameText: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound Hobbit 3 times.
loreText: All Wizards should have a Hobbit or two in their care... to teach them the meaning of humility!'

title: Sharpen Your Swords
gameText: Spot Gandalf to make a <symbol>gondor</symbol> companion strength +1 for each <symbol>gondor</symbol> companion you spot (limit +4).
loreText: Courage will now be your best defence against the storm that is at hand....'

title: Stay This Madness
gameText:
To play, spot Gandalf.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to wound 2 minions.

title: Steadfast Champion
gameText:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
Each minion gains this ability: Assignment:: Assign this minion to Gandalf. Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and heal a companion 3 times.

title: Terrible and Evil
gameText:
Spell.
Exert Gandalf X times to wound a minion X times. If that minion is a Nazgûl, wound it again.

title: Undaunted
gameText: Exert Gandalf to make him strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +8).
loreText: ...here the hammerstroke will fall hardest....'

title: Wizard Staff
gameText:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength 3.

title: Captured by the Ring
gameText: Play Gollum from your draw deck or discard pile to add a threat.
loreText: Give us that.....'

title: Clever Hobbits
gameText: Discard any number of <symbol>gollum</symbol> conditions. For each condition discarded, make Sméagol strength +3 and damage +1.
loreText: Clever hobbits to climb so high, very clever hobbits!'

title: Days Growing Dark
gameText: <keyword>Fellowship:</keyword> Discard 3 cards from hand to play Sméagol from your discard pile.
loreText: Come on, we must go, no time to lose!'

title: The Dead City
gameText:
Stealth.
Bearer must be Sméagol.
If Sméagol is about to be killed in a skirmish, he is discarded instead.

title: Fat One Wants It
gameText:
Each time Gollum or Sméagol is played, add a threat.
Regroup: Discard this condition to return Gollum to his owners hand.

title: Gollum
subtitle: Plotting Deceiver
gameText: If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this minion from your discard pile.
loreText: Let Her deal with them... she must eat. All She gets is filthy Orcses.'

title: Gollum
subtitle: Vile Creature
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert Gollum twice or remove a threat to make him strength +2.
loreText: When they come to the bridge they will see us. Come away! Climb, climb!'

title: Heavy Burden
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Discard Gollum and remove a threat to add a burden.
loreText: Sméagol knows... Sméagol carried burden many years.'

title: Hobbitses Are Dead
gameText: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to make a Nazgûl, <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion or <symbol>gollum</symbol> minion strength +2. If you have initiative, you may play this event from your discard pile; place it under your draw deck instead of discarding it.

title: It's Mine
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> and exert Gollum to discard the top card of your draw deck. If that card is a <symbol>gollum</symbol> or <symbol>wraith</symbol> card, take it into hand.
loreText: See! See! He wants it for himself.'

title: Let Her Deal With Them
gameText:
To play, spot Gollum or Sméagol. Bearer must be a minion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Bearer is Damage +1.
If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this condition from your discard pile.

title: Nasty
gameText: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each <symbol>gollum</symbol> card you spot.
loreText: He's a fat, horrid Hobbit, who hates Sméagol, who makes up nasty lies.'

title: Never
gameText:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Regroup: Discard Sméagol to remove 2 threats.

title: No Safe Places
gameText: Exert Sméagol to reveal an opponents hand. That opponent must discard a card from hand for each culture revealed.
loreText: ...they are watching... eyes will see us.'

title: Plotting
gameText:
To play, spot Gollum and add up to 9 threats.
Gollum is strength +2.
Discard this condition and remove 9 threats at the start of the regroup phase.

title: Scouting
gameText:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Maneuver: Discard Sméagol to discard a minion. An opponent may exert a minion twice to prevent this.

title: Secret Paths
gameText:
To play, spot Sméagol and add 2 threats.
The move limit for this turn is +1.
Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

title: Serving the Precious
gameText: Discard Sméagol to play a companion from your discard pile.
loreText: Sméagol look after Master. Sméagol serve Master well!'

title: Sméagol
subtitle: Always Helps
gameText:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Assignment:: Assign a minion to Sméagol and add 2 threats to exhaust that minion.

title: Sméagol
subtitle: Hurried Guide
gameText:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from your hand. Sméagol cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.

title: Sneaking!
gameText:
Stealth.
Heal Sméagol (or cancel Sméagols skirmish if he has more vitality than the minion or minions he is skirmishing).

title: So Polite
gameText: Play Gollum from your discard pile to add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> for each threat you spot.
loreText: Sméagol shows them secret ways that nobody else could find and they say, Sneak!''

title: Sweeter Meats
gameText: If a minion is about to take a wound, spot Gollum to prevent that wound.
loreText: It may well be, oh yes, it may very well be, that when She throws away the bones and the empty clothes... we shall find It!'

title: Very Nice Friends
gameText: Play Sméagol from your discard pile to play the fellowships next site (replacing an opponents site if necessary). If you do not move again this turn, discard your hand.
loreText: He hurts us.... hurts poor Sméagol!'

title: We Hates Them
gameText:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
Each minion gains this ability: Assignment:: Assign this minion to Sméagol. Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and play a companion from your discard pile.

title: Where Shall We Go
gameText: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a minion Sméagol is skirmishing twice.
loreText: If you scare him off, we are lost.'

title: Andúril
subtitle: Flame of the West
gameText: Bearer must be Aragorn. Discard other weapons he bears. He is <keyword>damage +1</keyword> and cannot bear other weapons. <keyword>Fellowship</keyword> or <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> If the fellowship is at any site 2 or any site 5, play the fellowships next site (replacing opponents site if necessary).

title: Andúril
subtitle: King's Blade
gameText:
Bearer must be Aragorn. Discard other weapons he bears. He is damage +1 and cannot bear other weapons.
Fellowship or Regroup: If the fellowship is at any site 2 or any site 5, play the fellowships next site (replacing opponents site if necessary).

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Captain of Gondor
gameText:
Knight.
At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add twilight2 to heal another gondor companion.

title: Cirion
gameText: While you have only 4 or 5 cards in hand, Cirion is strength +2.
loreText: So now at last the City was besieged...

title: City of Men
gameText: Make a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man strength +2. If that Man is skirmishing a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion, discard that minion at the end of the skirmish.
loreText: I will gladly give my life to defend her beauty, her memory... her wisdom.'

title: Dagger Strike
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Make a <symbol>gondor</symbol> or <symbol>shire</symbol> companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.

title: Denethor
subtitle: Steward of the City
gameText:
Fellowship: Play a gondor knight. That knights twilight cost is 2.
Each time a Shadow card adds a threat, add a burden. Each time a Shadow card adds a burden, add a threat.

title: Denethor
subtitle: Wizened Steward
gameText: Denethor is strength +1 for each other <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man you can spot (limit +4).
loreText: ...in desperate hours gentleness may be repaid with death.'

title: Derufin
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> While you have exactly 5 cards in hand, you may exert Derufin to discard an engine, machine, or possession.
loreText: From the uplands of Morthond....

title: Dervorin
gameText: At the start of the regroup phase, if you have only 4 cards in hand, you may spot another <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man to discard a minion.
loreText: The men of Ringló Vale behind the son of their lord....

title: Duty of Two
gameText: Add 3 threats to heal all <symbol>gondor</symbol> companions.
loreText: ...for himself, and for the one that will not return.'

title: Faramir
subtitle: Stout Captain
gameText:
Ranger. To play, spot a gondor Man.
Each time Faramir wins a skirmish involving a fierce minion, you may exert Faramir to discard that minion.

title: Faramir
subtitle: Wizard's Pupil
gameText:
Ranger.
Fellowship: Play a rohan Man to heal Faramir.
Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to prevent all wounds to Faramir.

title: First Level
gameText:
Fortification.
Maneuver: Exert a gondor Man or spot a knight to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.

title: Footman's Armor
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.

title: Blood Runs Chill
gameText: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X and exert that Dwarf twice to make an opponent discard X Shadow cards.
loreText: ...the Dark Door gaped before them like the mouth of night.

title: Counts But One
gameText: If Gimli is not assigned to a skirmish, add a threat to have him replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.
loreText: ...no matter how big.'

title: Gimli
subtitle: Counter of Foes
gameText:
Damage +1.
For each wound on Gimli, he is strength +1 and damage +1.
loreText: Twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two....

title: Honed
gameText: Make a Dwarf who is damage +X strength +X.
loreText: What are we waiting for?'

title: Unheard of
gameText: If a Dwarf who is damage +X wins a skirmish, wound a minion not assigned to a skirmish X times.
loreText: ...an Elf will go underground and a Dwarf dare not.'

title: Wish For Our Kinfolk
gameText:
Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion and either an elven companion or a gondor Man to add a dwarven token here.
Skirmish: Remove a dwarven token here to make a companion damage +1.
loreText: ...war already marches on their own lands.'

title: A Grey Ship
gameText: Spot an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total X (to a minimum of 0) to heal X unbound companions. You may not use archery special abilities.
loreText: ...full of ghosts.'

title: Legolas
subtitle: Elven Stalwart
gameText:
Archer.
While you can spot 3 wounded minions, each minion skirmishing Legolas is strength 3.
loreText: ...Legolas of the Elves, for whom the ghosts of Men have no terror.

title: Life of the Eldar
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Discard an Elf to draw 3 cards.
loreText: Your hands are cold....'

title: Reckless We Rode
gameText: Exert an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total X (to a minimum of 0) to wound a minion X times. You may not use archery special abilities.
loreText: ...driving them like leaves....'

title: Shake Off the Shadow
gameText:
Fellowship: Exert an Elf companion and either a gandalf companion or a dwarven companion to add an elven token here.
Archery: Remove an elven token here to add 1 to the fellowship archery total (limit +2).
loreText: Speak and be comforted....'

title: A Fool
gameText: At sites 1<symbol>king</symbol> to 5<symbol>king</symbol>, heal Gandalf. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
loreText: ...but an honest fool he remains.'

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Leader of Men
gameText: When Gandalf is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2.
loreText: ...the rule of no realm is mine, neither of Gondor nor any other, great or small.'

title: Let Us Not Tarry
gameText: Exert Gandalf to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength 1 for each Gandalf signet you spot.
loreText: There is much to say and to do, and you are weary.'

title: Mighty Steed
gameText: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, spot Shadowfax or exert Gandalf to have him replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.
loreText: He always turns up when things are darkest. Go on! Go on, White Rider! Gandalf! Gandalf!'

title: Not the First Halfling
gameText:
Fellowship: Exert Gandalf and either an elven companion or a shire companion to add a gandalf token here.
Skirmish: Remove a gandalf token here to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength 2.

title: On Your Doorstep
gameText: Spot Gandalf and exert a companion to place a card of that companions culture from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
loreText: Lord Denethor is a Steward only.'

title: Saved From the Fire
gameText: Spot Gandalf and place a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in the dead pile to take up to 3 cards from that companions culture into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
loreText: ...we will bear Faramir, Steward of Gondor, to a place where he can sleep in peace....'

title: Shadowfax
subtitle: Greatheart
gameText:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing Gandalf must exert.
Skirmish: Add a threat to make Gandalf strength +1.

title: Hidden Even From Her
gameText:
Gollum is fierce.
Shadow: Spot 6 companions to play Gollum from your discard pile and exert a companion. Place this condition on top of your draw deck.
loreText: ...even when he had come to her again and had bowed low....

title: Larder
gameText:
To play, spot a gollum minion.
Regroup: Discard an Orc from hand to add a gollum token here.
Skirmish: Remove a gollum token here to make Shelob strength +3 (limit +6).
loreText: When she binds with cords, she's after meat.'

title: Promise Keeping
gameText: Each time a companion takes a wound during a skirmish that involved a <symbol>gollum</symbol> minion, exert a companion.
loreText: And we'll save the Precious, as we promised.... Then we'll pay everyone back!

title: Shelob
subtitle: Eater of Light
gameText:
Fierce.
When you play Shelob, you may play a gollum possession from your draw deck.
Shelob is strength +3 for each minion stacked on a gollum possession.
loreText: ...who only desired death for all others....

title: Shelob
subtitle: Last Child of Ungoliant
gameText:
Enduring. Fierce.
While in a fierce skirmish, Shelob is damage +1.
loreText: ...for all living things were her food, and her vomit darkness.

title: Sméagol
subtitle: Slippery Sneak
gameText:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Skirmish: Add a number of threats equal to the total vitality of the minions Sméagol is skirmishing to discard Sméagol. Regroup: Discard Sméagol to take a gollum minion from your discard pile into hand.

title: Spider Poison
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Remove a threat or a burden to transfer this possession to a companion skirmishing Shelob. Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, bearer must exert.
loreText: "He lay now pale, and heard no voice, and did not move."

title: Still Far Ahead
gameText: Spot Sméagol to play the fellowships next site (replacing opponents site if necessary). The Shadow number of the fellowships next site is -1 until the end of the turn.
loreText: ...the very crown of this bitter road.

title: Web
gameText:
Regroup: If there are fewer than 3 cards stacked here, spot your Orc or gollum minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Play a gollum minion stacked here as if played from hand.
loreText: Caught in a web. Soon he'll be eaten!'

title: At His Command
gameText: Exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion with the Aragorn signet strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
loreText: Even the shades of Men are obedient to his will....'

title: Catapult
gameText:
To play, spot 2 gondor knights.
Maneuver: Discard 2 cards from hand to reveal the top card of an opponents draw deck. Choose an opponent who must discard a Shadow card that has a twilight cost that is the same as the twilight cost of the revealed card.

title: Elessar's Edict
gameText: If a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Wraith is about to be killed, discard him and either exhaust another <symbol>gondor</symbol> Wraith or spot another exhausted <symbol>gondor</symbol> Wraith to prevent that.
loreText: Yes, the Dead ride behind. They have been summoned....'

title: Faramir
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
gameText:
Knight.
When you play Faramir (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play a knight revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
loreText: ...I will go and do what I can in his steadif you command it.'

title: Fourth Level
gameText:
Fortification.
Skirmish: Exert 2 gondor Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a gondor Man. Exhaust that minion.
loreText: ...about each was set a wall....

title: Garrison of Gondor
gameText:
Archer. Knight.
To play, spot 3 gondor companions.
While you can spot a fortification, Garrison of Gondor is defender +1.
loreText: But about the Gate resistance still was stout.... 

title: Imrahil
subtitle: Prince of Dol Amroth
gameText:
Knight. To play, spot a knight.
Each time Imrahil wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 minions.
loreText: ...he was of high blood, and his folk also, tall men and proud with sea-grey eyes.

title: King of the Dead
subtitle: Oathbreaker
gameText:
Enduring. To play, spot a gondor Wraith and add 2 threats.
Response: If Aragorn is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert King of the Dead to prevent that wound.
loreText: ...crying out that the King of the Dead was upon them.'

title: Knight of Dol Amroth
gameText:
Knight.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: "'Amroth for Gondor!' they cried."

title: Knight's Mount
gameText:
Bearer must be a knight.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion who is not assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: Like thunder they broke upon the enemy....

title: Oathbreaker
gameText:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing this companion.
loreText: at the Stone of Erech they shall stand again / and hear there a horn in the hills ringing.

title: A Path Appointed
gameText:
Fellowship: Exert a gondor Man and either a dwarven companion or a rohan companion to add a gondor token here.
Regroup: Remove a gondor token here to discard a minion.
loreText: ...those who follow me do so of their free will....'

title: Shadow Host
gameText:
Enduring. To play, spot 2 exhausted gondor Wraiths and add 2 threats.
While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.
loreText: ...fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin....

title: Sixth Level
gameText:
Fortification.
Regroup: Exert a gondor Man to play a gondor fortification from your discard pile (limit 1).
loreText: ...and in each wall was a gate.

title: Sleepless Dead
gameText:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: ...for the Dead needed no longer any weapon but fear. None would withstand them.'

title: Spectral Sword
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Wraith.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to heal bearer.
loreText: ...pale banners like shreds of cloud, and spears like winter-thickets on a misty night.'

title: Stronger and More Terrible
gameText:
To play, add a threat.
Each time your gondor Wraith wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.
loreText: And lo! in the darkness of Mordor my hope rose....'

title: Swept Away
gameText:
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
While you have initiative, exhausted gondor Wraiths cannot take wounds.
loreText: And suddenly the Shadow Host that had hung back at the last came up like a grey tide, sweeping all away before it.'

title: Black Númenorean
gameText:
Corsair. Fierce.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a raider token to discard a possession borne by a character skirmishing this minion.
loreText: ...corrupted by Sauron, and who hated above all the followers of Elendil.

title: Black Sails of Umbar
gameText:
When you play this possession, you may add a raider token here.
Shadow: Remove X raider tokens here to play a corsair from your discard pile; its twilight cost is X. Discard this possession.

title: Castamir of Umbar
gameText:
Corsair. Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to add 2 raider tokens to a card that already has a raider token on it.
loreText: They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.'

title: Corsair Ballista
gameText:
Bearer must be a corsair.
While you have initiative, bearer is an archer and fierce.
loreText: Ranged weapons bristled from the warships and aided the Cosairs' plunder of coastal cities.

title: Corsair Buccaneer
gameText:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove a threat to add 2 raider tokens to a card that already has a raider token on it.
loreText: ...a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin....'

title: Corsair Freebooter
gameText:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove 2 culture tokens to add 2 raider tokens to a card that already has a raider token on it.
loreText: ...the strength of the rebels in Umbar was a great peril to Gondor....

title: Corsair Gunners
gameText:
Corsair.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a raider token to make a corsair fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: The Corsairs are upon us!'

title: Corsair Lookout
gameText:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, if you have initiative, you may discard an ally to add 2 raider tokens to a card that already has a raider token on it.
loreText: ...watchmen on the walls saw afar a new sight of fear, and their last hope left them.

title: Corsair Marauder
gameText:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, if you can spot another corsair, you may discard a possession to add 2 raider tokens to a card that already has a raider token on it.
loreText: Umbar remained at war with Gondor for many lives of men....

title: Corsair Plunderer
gameText:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may discard 2 cards from hand to add 2 raider tokens to a card that already has a raider token on it.
loreText: ...Umbar... fell into the hands of the Men of Harad.

title: Corsair War Galley
gameText:
When you play this possession, you may add a raider token here. While you can spot 6 raider tokens and a raider Man, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples players hand.
Regroup: Add twilight1 for each raider token you can spot. Discard this possession.

title: Haradrim Marksman
gameText:
Southron. Archer.
While you can spot another raider Man, Ring-bound companions cannot take archery wounds.
loreText: Archers from Harad rode atop the great war-beasts on the Fields of Pelennor.

title: Haradwaith
gameText:
While you can spot a raider minion at site 4king, you have initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples players hand.
Response: If a companion is played, discard this condition and a raider card from hand to add twilight5.

title: Heavy Axeman
gameText:
Easterling.
While you can spot 4 burdens, Heavy Axeman is strength +4 and fierce.
loreText: ...the Easterlings were strong and war-hardened and asked for no quarter.

title: Line of Defense
gameText: While you can spot a mounted <symbol>raider</symbol> Man, <symbol>raider</symbol> Men cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes).
loreText: ...and stood like towers of defence....

title: Mûmakil
gameText:
Bearer must be a Southron.
Bearer is fierce.
While you have initiative or can spot 4 threats, bearer is damage +1.
loreText: But wherever the mûmakil came there the horses would not go, but blenched and swerved away....

title: Ships of Great Draught
gameText:
Shadow: Remove a threat or discard a raider card from hand to add a raider token here.
Regroup: Remove 2 raider tokens here to place a raider card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

title: Wind That Sped Ships
gameText: Make a corsair strength +1 for each <symbol>raider</symbol> token you spot (limit +6). If you have initiative, you may place this event on top of your draw deck.
loreText: ...black against the glittering stream... a fleet borne up on the wind....

title: Between Nazgûl and Prey
gameText: Exert an enduring <symbol>wraith</symbol> minion twice to assign that minion to an unbound companion.
loreText: The age of Men is over.'

title: Beyond All Darkness
gameText: Exert a Nazgûl to make him strength +2 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword>. If the character he is skirmishing is killed, the Free Peoples player must place his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.
loreText: ...where thy flesh shall be devoured....'

title: Black Dart
gameText: <keyword>Archery:</keyword> Spot your enduring or mounted Nazgûl to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Discard a mount borne by that companion. Bearer cannot heal or bear mounts.

title: Black Flail
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Skirmish: If bearer is The Witch-king, exert him and spot a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing to discard that possession.

title: Flung Into the Fray
gameText:
When you play a minion stacked here, you may exert a companion.
Regroup: If no minion is stacked here, spot your wraith minon to stack it here.
Shadow: Spot 2 wraith minions to play a wraith minion stacked here as if played from hand.
loreText: With a cry of hatred that stung the very ears like venom he let fall....

title: Gothmog
subtitle: Morgul Commander
gameText: While you have initiative, each <symbol>wraith</symbol> minion is an archer.

title: Mastered By Madness
gameText: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples mount.
loreText: ...then Windfola had thrown them in his terror, and now ran wild upon the plain.

title: Morgul Ambusher
gameText: While you can spot 3 threats, the minion archery total is +2.
loreText: Fear, the City is rank with it.'

title: Morgul Creeper
gameText: While you can spot 3 burdens, the minion archery total is +2.

title: Morgul Lurker
gameText: While you have initiative, the minion archery total is +2.
loreText: Kill all in your path!'

title: Morgul Squealer
gameText:
Shadow: Discard this minion to play a wraith minion from your discard pile.
Shadow: Spot 6 companions and discard this minion to play up to 2 wraith minions from your draw deck; their twilight costs are each 1.
loreText: The time of the Orc has come.'

title: Streaming to the Field
gameText:
For each wraith Orc you can spot, the Free Peoples player must have an additional card in hand to have initiative.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a wraith Orc strength +2.

title: Úlairë Attëa
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring.
Regroup: Exert Úlairë Attëa and spot your wraith minion to return that minion to your hand.

title: Úlairë Nertëa
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring. Fierce.
The site number of each wraith minion is 1.
loreText: They had been mustered....

title: Úlairë Otsëa
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring. Fierce.
Regroup: Discard Úlairë Otsëa to add twilightX, where X is the current site number.
loreText: No living man may hinder me!'

title: Unhindered
gameText: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, the Shadow has initiative until the end of the turn, regardless of the Free Peoples players hand.

title: Winged Mount
gameText:
To play, discard 2 cards from hand.
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.
loreText: A creature of an older world maybe it was....

title: The Witch-king
subtitle: Black Captain
gameText:
Enduring.
Each Man skirmishing The Witch-king loses all strength bonuses from weapons.
loreText: ...the Nazgûl Lord like a shadow of despair.

title: Charged Headlong
gameText: If you have initiative, discard a <symbol>rohan</symbol> possession to play a <symbol>rohan</symbol> possession from your discard pile.
loreText: Sea-kings' city in the South-kingdom / foe-beleaguered, fire-encircled.

title: Doom Drove Them
gameText:
Fellowship: Exert a rohan companion and either a gondor Man or a shire companion to add a rohan token here.
Skirmish: Remove a rohan token here to exert a minion skirmishing a companion.
loreText: "He bent over her like a cloud, and his eyes glittered...."

title: Éomer
subtitle: Keeper of Oaths
gameText: <keyword>Valiant.</keyword> When you play Éomer (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck and play all <symbol>rohan</symbol> possessions revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
loreText: "'Death! Ride, ride to ruin and the world's ending!'"

title: Éowyn's Shield
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
The minion archery total is 1.
Skirmish: If bearer is Éowyn, add a threat and discard this possession to discard a hand weapon borne by a minion she is skirmishing.
loreText: Up Eorlingas! Fear no darkness!'

title: Fury of the Northmen
gameText: Exert a minion skirmishing a mounted <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man.
loreText: Another long screech rose and fell, and he threw himself back again from the wall, panting like a hunted animal.

title: No Living Man
gameText: Exert Théoden to exert a minion for each Théoden signet you spot.
loreText: They are looking for something, surely?'

title: Rohirrim Army
gameText:
To play, spot 3 rohan companions.
You may play Rohirrim Army any time you could play a regroup event.
When you play Rohirrim Army, you may discard a minion.
loreText: Begone, foul dwimmerlaik, lord of carrion!'

title: Théoden
subtitle: Tall and Proud
gameText:
Valiant.
While you can spot a rohan Man, Théodens twilight cost is 1.
If Théoden is killed, you may play a rohan companion from your discard pile or draw deck.
loreText: ...into their minds a blackness came, and they thought no more of war, but only of hiding and of crawling, and of death.

title: Called Away
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Discard a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion, spot a companion (except the Ring-bearer), and remove X burdens, where X is that companion's vitality, to return that companion to its owner's hand.
loreText: ...spear shall be shaken, shield shall be splintered....'

title: Gorgoroth Agitator
gameText:
Besieger.
To play, spot a sauron Orc.
When you play this minion, if you can spot another besieger, you may add a threat for each companion over 4.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a sauron engine from your discard pile.

title: Gorgoroth Assassin
gameText:
Besieger.
Assignment: Spot a sauron engine or site you control to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
loreText: ...they could endure the Sun, so long as the will of Sauron held sway over them.

title: Gorgoroth Berserker
gameText:
Besieger. Enduring.
To play, spot a sauron Orc.
Maneuver: If you have initiative, exert Gorgoroth Berserker twice to take control a site. Maneuver: Remove a threat and exert Gorgoroth Berserker twice to take control a site.
loreText: ...and wielded heavy hammers in their knotted hands.

title: Gorgoroth Breaker
gameText:
Besieger.
Archery: Exert this minion or stack it on a site you control to make the fellowship archery total 2.
loreText: ...like a storm upon the plain and a thunder in the mountains.

title: Gorgoroth Looter
gameText:
Besieger.
When you play this minion, you may remove a burden to play a besieger stacked on a site.
loreText: ...new foes came swirling behind....

title: Gorgoroth Patrol
gameText:
Besieger.
Regroup: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard this minion to make the move limit for this turn 1.
loreText: ...hurrying orcs were digging... just out of bowshot from the walls....

title: Gorgoroth Servitor
gameText:
Besieger.
Archery: Return this minion to your hand to make the fellowship archery total 2 and prevent the Free Peoples player from using archery special abilities.

title: Gorgoroth Stormer
gameText:
Besieger.
Shadow: If you have initiative, exert this minion to add a burden and make the Free Peoples player draw a card.
loreText: ...filled with malice, hating even their own kind....

title: Great Hill Troll
gameText:
Besieger. Fierce.
The twilight cost of this minion is 1 for each sauron engine you spot.
When you play this minion at sites 5king to 9king, you may discard a Free Peoples condition.
loreText: ...and soon yet more companies of the enemy were swiftly setting up....

title: Grond
subtitle: Hammer of the Underworld
gameText:
Engine. Shadow: Play a sauron minion to add a sauron token here.
Regroup: Remove X sauron tokens here to discard a Free Peoples card (except a companion) with a twilight cost of X. Discard a sauron minion or this possession.
loreText: ...and the black serpent foundered.

title: Morgai
gameText:
While you can spot a sauron minion at site 5king, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples players hand.
Response: If a companion is played, discard a sauron card from hand to take control of a site. Discard this condition.
loreText: Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never....'

title: Olog-hai of Mordor
gameText:
Besieger. Fierce.
The twilight cost of this minion is 2 for each sauron minion stacked on a site.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a besieger stacked on a site you control. That besieger is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Siege Troop
gameText:
Besieger.
Regroup: Exert this minion twice to take control of a site.

title: Their Marching Companies
gameText:
Engine. To play, spot a sauron minion.
Regroup: Remove a threat to stack your sauron minion on a site you control.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a sauron minion stacked on a site you control.
loreText: The City is all set about with flame, and the field is full of foes.'

title: Troll of Gorgoroth
subtitle: Abomination of Sauron
gameText:
Besieger. Fierce.
To play, spot a sauron Orc.
The twilight cost of this minion is 2 for each sauron engine you spot.
Regroup: Exert Troll of Gorgoroth to stack a besieger on a site you control.
loreText: File after file passed....

title: Closer and Closer He Bent
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Exert an unbound Hobbit and add a burden to reveal your hand. Place each Free Peoples card revealed this way beneath your draw deck.
loreText: ...yet still driven as if by a madness....

title: Morgai Foothills
gameText:
When the fellowship moves from site 4king, remove twilight1 for each Ring-bound companion you spot.
Regroup: Discard a card from hand for each Ring-bound companion you can spot. Discard this condition.
loreText: The Ring is enough. This extra weight is killing me. It must go.'

title: So Fair, So Desperate
gameText: If the Shadow has initiative, add a threat to make an unbound Hobbit strength +1 for each <symbol>shire</symbol> card you spot.
loreText: King's man! King's man!' his heart cried within him.

title: Song of the Shire
gameText:
Fellowship: Exert a shire companion and either a rohan companion or a gandalf companion to add a shire token here.
Skirmish: Remove a shire token here to prevent an unbound companion from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
loreText: ...the hosts of Mordor were enheartened, and filled with a new lust and fury they came yelling....

title: Sting
subtitle: Bane of the Eight Legs
gameText:
Bearer must be Frodo or Sam.
Response: If a fierce skirmish involving bearer is about to end, add a threat to discard a minion involved in that skirmish.

title: Straining Towards Us
gameText: Exert Frodo to remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> for each Frodo signet you spot.
loreText: ...they found the enemy already on the out-wall, or assailing it....'

title: Unheeded
gameText: If a minion exerts, exert an unbound Hobbit to wound that minion.
loreText: ...and passing up beneath the hauberk had pierced the sinew behind his mighty knee.

title: We Shall Meet Again Soon
gameText: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert an unbound Hobbit to place a Shadow card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
loreText: Pippin sat with his knees drawn up and the ball between them. He bent low over it, looking like a greedy child stooping over a bowl of food.

title: The Dimholt
gameText: <keyword>Sanctuary.</keyword> <keyword>Underground.</keyword> <keyword>Fellowship:</keyword> Add 3 threats to play an enduring companion from your draw deck.
loreText: She should not die.... At least she should not die alone, unaided.

title: City of the Dead
gameText: <keyword>Underground.</keyword> <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Remove 2 burdens to play an enduring minion from your draw deck or discard pile.
loreText: He said: Who are you? I still did not answer, but it hurt me horribly; and he pressed me, so I said: A hobbit.'

title: Crashed Gate
gameText: At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player must add 3 threats or choose an opponent who may take control of a site.
loreText: You're in the service of the Steward of Gondor now. You'll do as you're told.'

title: Osgiliath Channel
gameText: <keyword>River.</keyword> <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn.
loreText: No such anguish had Shelob ever known, or dreamed of knowing....

title: Merry
subtitle: Noble Warrior
gameText:
To play, spot a rohan companion.
Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to make Merry strength +2 for each rohan companion you spot.

title: Pippin
subtitle: Guard of Minas Tirith
gameText:
To play, spot a gondor Man.
Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion Pippin is skirmishing twice if that minion bears a fortification.
loreText: ...blind almost to all else that is moving. So we must keep it. Therein lies all our hope.'

title: The One Ring
subtitle: The Binding Ring
gameText:
Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play a ring from your draw deck.
Maneuver: Exert bearer to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
loreText: One Ring to bring them all....

title: Freca
subtitle: Hungry Savage
gameText:
When you play Freca, you may spot another dunland Man to take control of a site.
When Freca is killed, the Free Peoples player may liberate a site.
loreText: We will die for Saruman.'

title: Durin III
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
gameText:
Damage +1.
While you can spot 2 Dwarves, Durin III is twilight cost 2.
Durin III is strength +1 for each artifact and each possession he bears.
loreText: Durin is the name that the Dwarves used for the eldest of the Seven Fathers of their race....

title: Gimli
subtitle: Bearer of Grudges
gameText:
Damage +1.
While Gimli is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats.
While Gimli is damage +X, he is resistance +X.
loreText: Never trust an Elf.'

title: Linnar
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
gameText:
Each time a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, you may heal that Dwarf.
Skirmish: Discard a dwarven card from hand to make a Dwarf damage +1.
loreText: ...they were joined by great forces sent from the Houses of the other Fathers....

title: Ring of Accretion
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer is damage +1.
Maneuver: For each Dwarf you spot, reveal a card from the top of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest. Discard this artifact.

title: Ring of Fury
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer is damage +2.
Regroup: Spot a Dwarf that is damage +X to heal X Dwarves. Discard this artifact.
loreText: Azog! If you are in come out! Or is the play in the valley too rough?'

title: Ring of Guile
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer is damage +1.
Maneuver: Take a dwarven event into hand from your discard pile. Discard this artifact.
loreText: But, as Thrór had said, the Ring needed gold to breed gold....

title: Ring of Retribution
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this artifact to exert each Orc.
loreText: We fought this war for vengeance, and vengeance we have taken. But it is not sweet.'

title: Sindri
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
gameText: You may play <symbol>dwarven</symbol> skirmish events stacked on <symbol>dwarven</symbol> conditions as if from hand.
loreText: Concerning the beginning of the Dwarves strange tales are told both by the Eldar and by the Dwarves themselves....

title: Úri
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> If Úri is damage +X, exert him to make him strength +X.
loreText: ...the Dwarves had the victory through their strength, and their matchless weapons, and the fire of their anger, as they hunted for Azog in every den under mountain.

title: Aiglos
gameText:
Bearer must be an Elf.
If bearer is Gil-galad, he is strength +1 for each elven artifact you can spot (limit +6).
Regroup: Discard Aiglos to wound a minion for each Elf you spot.
loreText: ...for the Spear of Gil-galad... none could withstand.'

title: Elven Rope
gameText:
To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be an Elf or Hobbit.
Maneuver: Discard this possession to make a Shadow player return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owners hand.
loreText: It freezes, it bites! Elves twisted it, curse them!'

title: Galadriel
subtitle: Bearer of Wisdom
gameText: While Galadriel bears an artifact or The One Ring, she is resistance +1 for each <symbol>elven</symbol> companion you can spot.
loreText: ...I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night!...Dreadful as the Storm and the Lightning!'

title: Gil-galad
subtitle: Elven High King
gameText:
To play, spot 2 elven companions.
Regroup: Exert Gil-galad to wound each wounded minion.
loreText: Gil-galad was an Elven-king. / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.'

title: Glorfindel
subtitle: Revealed in Wrath
gameText:
When Glorfindel is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is 2.
Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may exert Glorfindel to make a Nazgûl he is skirmishing strength X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

title: Knife of the Galadhrim
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man. If bearer is Aragorn, he may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
Skirmish: Discard this possession to wound a minion bearer is skirmishing.
loreText: It was overlaid with a tracery of flowers and leaves wrought of silver and gold....

title: Merry's Dagger
gameText:
Bearer must be Merry.
Skirmish: Exert Merry twice or discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove twilight1 to prevent this.
loreText: They have already seen service in war.'

title: Narya
subtitle: Ring of Fire
gameText:
Bearer must be Círdan or Gandalf.
Fellowship: Remove X culture tokens, where X is equal to bearers vitality. Discard this artifact.
loreText: ...the Third Ring, Narya the Great, and the stone upon it was red as fire.

title: Nenya
subtitle: Ring of Adamant
gameText:
Bearer must be Galadriel.
Maneuver: Heal 2 companions and place up to 2 cards from hand on top of your draw deck. Discard this artifact.
loreText: ...Nenya, the ring wrought of mithril, that bore a single white stone flickering like a frosty star.

title: Pippin's Dagger
gameText:
Bearer must be Pippin.
Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice or discard this possession to wound a minion an Elf is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove twilight1 to prevent this.
loreText: These are the daggers of the Noldorin.'

title: Strands of Elven Hair
gameText:
To play, spot a Dwarf. When you play this possession, add 2 elven tokens here.
Fellowship: Discard this possession or remove an elven token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a dwarven or elven card, you may take it into hand.

title: Vilya
subtitle: Ring of Air
gameText:
Bearer must be Elrond or Gil-galad.
Skirmish: Discard the top card of your draw deck. Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength X, where X is the twilight cost of the discarded card. Discard this artifact.
loreText: Gil-galad before he died gave his ring to Elrond....

title: Ent Draught
gameText:
To play, spot an Ent.
Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him or her damage +1.
loreText: Indeed the hobbits felt that the hair on their heads was actually standing up, waving and curling and growing.

title: Huorn
gameText:
Damage +1.
This companion is strength +1 for each Ent you spot.
Response: If this companion is about to take a wound, exert an Ent to prevent that.
loreText: ...the Forest itself was moving behind us.'

title: Radagast
subtitle: The Brown
gameText:
The move limit is +1.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, each opponent may discard 2 cards from hand to draw 2 cards.
loreText: ...a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts....'

title: Sent Back
gameText:
Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard each minion skirmishing a Wizard. Place that Wizard in your dead pile.
Fellowship or Regroup: Play a Wizard (even if another copy of that Wizard is in your dead pile).
loreText: The Sun shines through you.'

title: Gollum
subtitle: Dark as Darkness
gameText:
Shadow: Exert Gollum twice to exert the Ring-bearer.
Shadow: Remove a burden to add twilight1.
Skirmish: Remove a burden to add twilight2.
Regroup: Remove a burden to add twilight3.
Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to wound the Ring-bearer.

title: Slippery as Fishes
gameText:
While Gollum is at a mountain, river, or underground site, he is strength +2.
Regroup: Spot Gollum to reveal your hand. Place all Shadow cards revealed beneath your draw deck. Discard this condition.
loreText: I hoped the river-voyage would beat him, but he is too clever a waterman.'

title: Sméagol
subtitle: Bearer of Great Secrets
gameText:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each time the fellowship moves, place an unbound companion in the dead pile.
Regroup: If Sméagol is the Ring-bearer, add 2 burdens to discard each minion.
loreText: ...he used it to find out secrets, and he put his knowledge to crooked and malicious uses.'

title: Boromir
subtitle: Bearer of Council
gameText:
While Boromir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 3 burdens or wound him twice.
Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, discard each minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: True-hearted Men, they will not be corrupted. We of Minas Tirith have been staunch....'

title: Elendil
subtitle: The Tall
gameText:
To play, spot 2 gondor Men.
Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn.
Regroup: Discard a gondor artifact to liberate a site.
loreText: ...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....

title: Isildur
subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms
gameText:
While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions.
While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each gondor knight is strength +1.
loreText: But for my part I will risk no hurt to this thing: of all the works of Sauron the only fair.'

title: Narsil
subtitle: Blade of the Faithful
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
If bearer is Elendil or Isildur, he is strength +1 for each gondor artifact you can spot (limit +6).
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, exert 2 gondor Men to prevent that.
loreText: ...Isildur cut the Ring from his hand....'

title: Sapling of the White Tree
gameText:
To play, spot an unbound gondor Man.
Response: If a gondor Man is about to take a wound, discard this gondor artifact to prevent that.
loreText: Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of Trees.'

title: Scroll of Isildur
gameText:
Tale. To play, spot a gondor Man.
The Ring-bearer is resistance +1 for each gondor artifact you can spot (limit +3).
Fellowship: Discard this artifact to play a ring from your discard pile.
loreText: What evil it saith I do not know; but I trace here a copy of it, lest it fade beyond recall.

title: Seeing Stone of Minas Anor
gameText:
To play, spot a gondor Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a gondor Man and add 2 threats).
Regroup: Exert a gondor Man or discard this artifact to discard your hand and draw 3 cards.
loreText: Didst thou think that the eyes of the White Tower were blind?'

title: Seeing Stone of Orthanc
gameText:
To play, spot a gondor Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a gondor Man and add 2 threats).
Regroup: Add a threat or discard this artifact to remove twilight2 or draw a card.
loreText: I am the lawful master of the Stone, and I had both the right and the strength to use it, or so I judged.'

title: Library of Orthanc
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Play an <symbol>isengard</symbol> minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an <symbol>isengard</symbol> minion strength +1. <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> to take an <symbol>isengard</symbol> card stacked here into hand.

title: Sack of the Shire
gameText: If an <symbol>isengard</symbol> minion wins a skirmish, until the regroup phase, make that minion strength +1 for each site you control and fierce.
loreText: There's some devilry at work in the Shire....'

title: Host of Moria
subtitle: Legion of the Underdeeps
gameText: When you play Host of Moria, you may play a <symbol>moria</symbol> card from your discard pile.
loreText: There was a horn-blast and a rush of feet, and orcs one after another leaped into the chamber.

title: Ring of Asperity
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
When you play this artifact, you may wound an unwounded companion.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owners hand.
loreText: The Nine, the Seven, and the Three... had each their proper gem.'

title: Ring of Ire
gameText:
Bearer must be The Witch-king.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a wraith minion damage +1.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owners hand.
loreText: Nine he gave to Mortal Men, proud and great, and so ensnared them.'

title: Ring of Rancor
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Maneuver: Remove a burden to heal each Nazgûl.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owners hand.
loreText: So it is now: the Nine he has gathered to himself....'

title: Horn of the Mark
gameText:
Bearer must be Merry or Pippin.
Bearer gains the Théoden signet.
Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, exert him to discard each minion involved in that skirmish.
loreText: He that blows it at need shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends....'

title: The Red Arrow
gameText: <keyword>Assignment:</keyword> Exert a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man to play a <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man. You may exert that <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man to play a possession on him or her. Discard this artifact.
loreText: The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'

title: Ithil Stone
gameText:
To play, exert a wraith or sauron minion.
At the start of each of your Shadow phases, you may draw a card.
Shadow: Discard this artifact to play a sauron minion. Its twilight cost is 3.
loreText: ...and in it there was a stone like the Moon....'

title: Sauron
subtitle: The Lord of the Rings
gameText:
Damage +2. Enduring. Fierce.
For each burden you spot, threat you spot, and site you control, Saurons twilight cost is 1.
loreText: One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne / In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.

title: Bilbo
subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled
gameText:
Ring-bound.
Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add twilight3.
Regroup: Add a burden to play a shire tale.
loreText: But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'

title: Everyone Knows
gameText:
Tale. Each unbound Hobbit is strength +1 for each vitality over 3 he or she has.
Skirmish: Prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Discard this condition.
loreText: ...I'm the tall one, you're the short one.'

title: Goldberry
subtitle: River-daughter
gameText:
Each time the fellowship moves to a river, heal Goldberry and Tom Bombadil.
Skirmish: If the fellowship is at a river, exert Goldberry to make a companion strength +1.
loreText: Slender as the willow-wand, clearer than the water.'

title: Tom Bombadil
subtitle: The Master
gameText:
To play, remove 2 burdens or 2 threats.
Skirmish: Spot 2 shire companions and exert Tom Bombadil X times, where X is the fellowships site number, to cancel a skirmish involving a shire companion.
loreText: Hey! Come derry dol! Can you hear me singing?'

title: Great Day, Great Hour
gameText: If an opponent plays a minion, exert a Dwarf who is damage +X to exert that minion X times
loreText: Oft hope is born, when all is forlorn.'

title: Memories of Darkness
gameText:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a dwarven condition from hand or from your discard pile.
loreText: Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'

title: More Yet to Come
gameText: If a Dwarf kills a minion in a skirmish and that minion did not take all wounds caused by that Dwarf's damage bonus, assign those remaining wounds to minions not assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: ...whatever is still to do, I hope to have a part in it, for the honour of the folk of the Lonely Mountain.'

title: Aegnor
subtitle: Elven Escort
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword>  Exert Aegnor to make a minion skirmishing an unbound <symbol>elven</symbol> companion strength 1 for each archer you spot.
loreText: Affectionately referred to as Figwit' by his contemporaries in Rivendell.

title: Arwen
subtitle: Echo of Lúthien
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword>  Discard a card from hand to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If the bottom card was an <symbol>elven</symbol> card, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength 3.
loreText: ...mine is the choice of Lúthien, and as she so have I chosen, both the sweet and the bitter.'

title: Arwen
subtitle: Queen of Elves and Men
gameText: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength 2 for each wounded minion you can spot.
loreText: Often is it seen, said Aragorn, that in dangerous days men hide their chief treasure.'

title: Celeborn
subtitle: Lord of the Galadhrim
gameText: At the start of each skirmish involving Celeborn, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an <symbol>elven</symbol> card, you may discard it to wound each minion in that skirmish.
loreText: ...with him went the last living memory of the Elder Days in Middle-earth.

title: Círdan
subtitle: The Shipwright
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Skirmish: Exert Círdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength 1 for each elven event in your discard pile.
loreText: ...he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars....

title: Elrond
subtitle: Venerable Lord
gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Elrond, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an elven card, you may heal another Elf.
loreText: To me then even our victory can bring only sorrow and parting  but to you hope of joy for a while.'

title: Fleet-footed
gameText: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength 2. Spot a site in a support area to place this event on top of your draw deck.
loreText: Not all Elven weapons are carried in sheath or quiver.

title: Galadriel
subtitle: Lady Redeemed
gameText:
When Galadriel is in your starting fellowship, her twilight cost is 3.
Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an elven event from hand to discard a Shadow condition or Shadow possession.
loreText: I pass the test,' she said. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.'

title: Glimpse of Fate
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Each time you lose initiative, make a minion strength 4 until the regroup phase.
loreText: The uttermost choice is before you: to repent and go to the Havens... or else to abide the Doom of Men.'

title: Phial of Galadriel
subtitle: Star-glass
gameText:
Bearer must be a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Until the regroup phase, remove the game text (except card type and race) of a minion skirmishing bearer and make it unable to gain game text. Discard this artifiact.
loreText: ...the hand that held it sparkled with white fire.

title: Borne Far Away
gameText: Spot your Wizard to exchange a companion in hand with a companion in your dead pile or discard pile.
loreText: ...the wanderers were lifted up and borne far away out of the darkness and the fire.

title: Brooding on Tomorrow
gameText: Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may spot a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions.
loreText: ...tomorrow will be certain to bring worse than today, for many days to come.'

title: Gathering Wind
gameText: Exert your Wizard and choose a number. Make each minion with that twilight cost strength 2 until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...the rush of their wide wings as they passed over was like a gale.

title: Out of the High Airs
gameText: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard to discard each minion.
loreText: ...the Nazgûl turned and fled, and vanished into Mordor's shadows....

title: Treebeard
subtitle: Keeper of the Watchwood
gameText:
To play, spot 3 gandalf companions.
Regroup: Exert Treebeard twice to play a gandalf condition from your discard pile and make an opponent discard one of his or her conditions.
loreText: Leave it to the Ents!... Trees are coming back to live here, old trees, wild trees.'

title: A Dark Shape Sprang
gameText: If an opponent plays a possession on a companion, play Gollum at twilight cost 2 from your discard pile or hand to suspend the current phase. Begin a skirmish phase involving Gollum and that companion. When it ends, resume the suspended phase.
loreText: Something struck Sam violently in the back....

title: Final Strike
gameText:
Any site 9 is a mountain.
Shadow: If the fellowship is at any site 9, play Gollum from your discard pile.
Response: If the Free Peoples player uses a maneuver or archery special ability, exert Gollum to cancel its effect.
loreText: The fires below awoke in anger....

title: Gollum
subtitle: Mad Thing
gameText: To assign Gollum to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must make Gollum strength +3 until the regroup phase or add a burden.
loreText: ...swiftly but warily, creeping on behind, a slinking shadow among the stones.

title: Reclaim the Precious
gameText: <keyword>Assignment:</keyword>  Assign Gollum to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this and assign Gollum. <keyword>Regroup:</keyword>  Exert Gollum twice to discard a possession. Discard this condition.
loreText: ...white fangs gleamed, and then snapped as they bit.

title: Shelob
subtitle: Her Ladyship
gameText:
Enduring. Fierce.
When you play Shelob, if you can spot Gollum, you may spot a companion. That companion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the end of the turn.
loreText: ...she served none but herself, drinking the blood of Elves and Men....

title: Unabated in Malice
gameText:
While you have initiative, each gollum minion is damage +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a gollum minion strength +1 for each culture you can spot.
loreText: ...she lusted for sweeter meat. And Gollum had brought it to her.

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Elessar Telcontar
gameText: When you play Aragorn, you may heal another companion. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may exert a companion of one culture to heal a companion of another culture.
loreText: Now come the days of the King, and may they be blessed while the thrones of the Valar endure!'

title: Cursed of Erech
gameText:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
When you play Cursed of Erech, exert him twice. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert another gondor Wraith to make Cursed of Erech defender +1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...a black dread fell on them....

title: Dead Man of Dunharrow
gameText:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
When you play this companion, exert him twice.
loreText: ...the Shadow Host pressed behind and fear went on before them....

title: Denethor
subtitle: Lord of Minas Tirith
gameText:
To play, spot 2 gondor Men.
Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a gondor card into hand from your draw deck, then reshuffle. Choose an opponent who may draw 2 cards.
loreText: There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....

title: Drawing His Eye
gameText: For each <symbol>gondor</symbol> companion you spot, reveal 1 card at random from a Shadow player's hand. Choose a revealed Shadow card to be discarded, then its owner draws a card.
loreText: We cannot achieve victory by arms, but by arms we can give the Ring-bearer his only chance, frail though it be.'

title: End of the Game
gameText: Make an exhausted <symbol>gondor</symbol> companion strength +2. If that companion wins this skirmish, heal that companion or make him or her <keyword>damage +1.</keyword>
loreText: ...he drew Andúril and held it up glittering in the sun. You shall not be sheathed again until the last battle is fought,' he said.

title: Every Little is a Gain
gameText: Spot a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man to discard a stacked Shadow card or to wound a minion bearing a Fortification.
loreText: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate, men of the Outlands marching to defend the City of Gondor in a dark hour....

title: Fifth Level
gameText:
Fortification.
Bearer is strength 1 for each Fortification you can spot.
Maneuver: Exert 2 gondor Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition to a minion.
loreText: A strong citadel it was indeed....

title: Hardy Garrison
gameText:
To play, spot 2 gondor Men.
Each time you lose initiative, you may wound a minion.
loreText: All before the walls on either side of the Gate the ground was choked with wreck and with bodies of the slain....

title: Last Throw
gameText: If no opponent controls a site, spot 2 <symbol>gondor</symbol> Men to make the move limit +1 for this turn.
loreText: We must push Sauron... We must march out to meet him at once.'

title: Suffered Much Loss
gameText: Each site on the adventure path is a battleground. While you have initiative, each Uruk-hai is strength +1.
loreText: For we are already at war, as you may have seen....'

title: Cast Unto the Winds
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Spot a Southron, remove a threat, and remove <symbol>twilight3</symbol> to wound an unbound companion.
loreText: With horns in my mouth / I walk in the South....'

title: Corsair Boatswain
gameText:
Corsair. To play, spot a raider Man.
Shadow: Exert this minion to play a raider support area possession from your draw deck.
loreText: Promise of plunder and of the whip keep in line a lustful Corsair crew.

title: Corsair Brute
gameText:
Corsair.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove a raider token to wound a companion he is skirmishing.
loreText: ...the region of South Gondor became a debatable land between the Corsairs and the Kings.

title: Corsair Ruffian
gameText:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may spot another Corsair and discard the top card of the Free Peoples player's draw deck to add 2 raider tokens to a card that already has a raider token on it.
loreText: An incarnation of savagery was Ghynóh the Cruel.

title: Easterling Berserker
gameText:
Easterling. To play, spot an Easterling.
While this minion is unwounded, he is damage +2.
Skirmish: Wound 2 other raider Men to heal this minion.
loreText: ...from nearby there marched up an army of Easterlings that had waited for the signal....

title: Easterling Pillager
gameText:
Easterling. Fierce.
When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add a burden for each companion over 5.
loreText: ...for the sack of the City and the rape of Gondor....

title: Far Harad Mercenaries
gameText:
Southron.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another raider Man to discard an unbound companion this minion is skirmishing.
loreText: ...men like half-trolls, with white eyes and red tongues.

title: Field of the Fallen
gameText:
To play, spot a raider Man. While there is a character in the dead pile, each companion of the same culture as that character is strength 1.
Skirmish: Exert your Southron to make him strength +1.

title: High Vantage
gameText: Until the end of the assignment phase, each time a Southron is about to take a wound, prevent that.
loreText: Southrons rain arrows down upon their enemies from their defended perch atop their great beasts of war.

title: Mûmak Chieftan
gameText:
Southron.
When you play this minion, you may play a mount on him from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is 2.
loreText: The commander of a mûmak never imagines he is in complete control of the beast.

title: Quelled
gameText: Exert a <symbol>raider</symbol> Man to discard a Free Peoples condition. If you spot a <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man, discard an additional Free Peoples condition.
loreText: Against the great mounts of the Southron army, Rohirrim steeds could not easily prevail.

title: Rallying Call
gameText:
To play, spot a raider Man.
Threats cannot be removed by Free Peoples cards.
Shadow: Remove twilight1 and play a Southron to add a threat.
loreText: Horns were blown and trumpets were braying....

title: Seasoned Leader
gameText:
Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is Enduring.
Skirmish: Remove a threat to play a raider condition from your discard pile.
loreText: Only by many conquests and hardships does one rise to prominence in the army of the Haradrim.

title: Southron Fanatic
gameText:
Southron.
Each time a Man is assigned to skirmish this minion, wound that Man.
loreText: Stirred by the Dark Lord, the fullness of Southron cruelty was leveled at the people of Gondor.

title: Southron Savage
gameText:
Southron.
While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
loreText: The merciless deserts of Haradwaith breed equally merciless fighters.

title: Stampeded
gameText: If a Free Peoples possession is played, spot a <symbol>raider</symbol> card to discard that possession. If that possession was a <symbol>gondor</symbol> or <symbol>rohan</symbol> possession, wound an unbound Man.
loreText: ...the Mûmak of Harad was indeed a beast of vast bulk, and the like of him does not walk now in Middle-earth....

title: Under Foot
gameText:
Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a raider Man and discard this condition to reconcile your hand.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a raider Man strength +2.
loreText: I make the earth shake, / As I tramp through the grass; / Trees crack as I pass.'

title: Black Marshal
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Exert a Nazgûl and play a <symbol>wraith</symbol> minion to add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> (or <symbol>twilight2</symbol> if you have initiative).
loreText: ...at their head was one greater than all the rest: a Rider, all black....

title: Cirith Ungol Scavenger
gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a character this minion is skirmishing.
loreText: A noise of tramping feet and harsh shouts: Orcs were coming up to the Cleft from the far side....

title: Cirith Ungol Soldier
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...not even the black shadows, lying deep where the red glow could not reach, would shield him long from the night-eyed orcs.

title: Cirith Ungol Warrior
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...deafening, roaring in his ears, the crash of the feet and the rending clamour of the Orcs before him.

title: Cirith Ungol Watchman
gameText: Each companion skirmishing this minion loses all damage and strength bonuses from possessions.
loreText: Sam looked up towards the orc-tower, and suddenly from its narrow windows lights stared out like small red eyes.

title: Dark Swooping Shadows
gameText: Heal an enduring <symbol>wraith</symbol> minion to add a burden or 2 threats.
loreText: ...how can he win to the Gate, if these foul hell-hawks have other weapons than fear?'

title: Gorbag
subtitle: Covetous Captain
gameText: For each wound on the Ring-bearer, each <symbol>wraith</symbol> Orc is strength +1.
loreText: I tell you, it's no game serving down in the city.'

title: Gorbag's Sword
gameText:
Bearer must be a wraith Orc.
When you play this possession, you may discard a possession. Its owner may place it on top of his or her draw deck instead.
If bearer is Gorbag, he is fierce.
loreText: You touch it and I'll stick this blade in your gut.'

title: Houses of Lamentation
gameText: Make a <symbol>wraith</symbol> minion strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a companion of the same culture as a card in the dead pile).
loreText: ...thy shrivelled mind be left naked to the Lidless Eye.'

title: Morgul Banner-bearer
gameText: While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and an <keyword>archer</keyword>.
loreText: So great an army had never issued from that vale since the days of Isildur's might....

title: Morgul Vanguard
gameText: <keyword>Assignment:</keyword> Assign this minion to an unbound companion bearing a hand weapon.
loreText: ...soon the host of Morgul will enter in at many points.'

title: Stooping to the Kill
gameText:
While you have initiative, each of your wraith minions is damage +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a wraith minion strength +2.
loreText: And with a piercing cry out of the dim sky fell the winged shadows....

title: Swarming Like Beetles
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Spot a <symbol>wraith</symbol> Orc and remove a threat to wound an unwounded companion.
loreText: ...in secret they have long been building floats and barges in great number in East Osgiliath.'

title: Ten Times Outnumbered
gameText: Make a <symbol>wraith</symbol> Orc strength +2 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
loreText: The passage of Anduin was won by the Enemy.

title: Úlairë Cantëa
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Cantëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Cantëa to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
loreText: ...the shadows of death fell dark upon the earth.

title: Úlairë Enquëa
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Enquëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: If Úlairë Enquëa is skirmishing, heal him to add a burden.
loreText: Ever they circled above the City, like vultures that expect their fill of doomed men's flesh.

title: Úlairë Lemenya
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Lemenya during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Lemenya to wound up to 3 other wraith minions.
loreText: It was no brigand or orc-chieftain that ordered the assault upon the Lord of Mordor's greatest foe.

title: Úlairë Nelya
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Nelya during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Nelya to add twilight1 for each burden.
loreText: Perching now on the wall beside the ruined gate the Nazgûl sent out its deadly cries. All the cliffs echoed.

title: Úlairë Toldëa
subtitle: Thrall of The One
gameText:
Enduring.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Toldëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Toldëa to make him damage +1.
loreText: ...like shadows of untimely night, he saw in the middle airs below him five birdlike forms...

title: Éowyn
subtitle: Lady of Ithilien
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert Éowyn to choose an opponent. That opponent must wound a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Éowyn.
loreText: Yet now that I have leave to depart, I would remain. For this House has become to me of all dwellings the most blessed.'

title: Fell Deeds Awake
gameText:
To play, spot a rohan Man.
Each time you lose initiative, you may liberate a site.
loreText: ...he seized a great horn from Guthláf his banner-bearer, and he blew such a blast upon it that it burst asunder.

title: Unyielding
gameText: If your <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man wins a skirmish, discard a <symbol>rohan</symbol> possession to wound a minion or to liberate a site.
loreText: ...they gathered and rallied and fought until the day wore away.

title: Advance Captain
gameText: Each roaming <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion is <keyword>damage +1.</keyword>
loreText: The foe who gave him his scar soon after gave him the adornment for his helm.

title: Advance Marauder
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> exert this minion to make a roaming <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion strength +3.
loreText: The sun gleamed red....

title: Advance Regular
gameText: Each roaming <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion is <keyword>fierce.</keyword>
loreText: In vain men shook their fists at the pitiless foes that swarmed before the Gate.

title: Advance Scout
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Exert or discard this minion to make each <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion you spot roaming until the regroup phase.
loreText: The lines of fire became flowing torrents, file upon file of Orcs bearing flames....

title: Barren Land
gameText:
To play, spot a sauron minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 8 or 9, exert each Ring-bound companion.
Shadow: Discard this condition to play a sauron minion. Its twilight cost is 2.
loreText: There the last living things gave up their struggle....

title: Beaten Back
gameText: Make a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion strength +2 for each site you control. If you have initiative, that minion is <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
loreText: The Rammas was broken, and all the Pelennor abandoned to the Enemy.

title: Cirith Ungol Guard
gameText: <keyword>Damage +1.</keyword>
loreText: ...this stronghold had been built not to keep enemies out of Mordor, but to keep them in.

title: Cirith Ungol Patroller
gameText: <keyword>Damage +1.</keyword> While you can spot 3 possessions, this minion is <keyword>fierce.</keyword>
loreText: A message came: Nazgûl uneasy. Spies feared on stairs. Double vigiliance. Patrol to head of Stairs.'

title: Cirith Ungol Sentinel
gameText: <keyword>Damage +1.</keyword> If you can spot another <symbol>sauron</symbol> Uruk-hai, this minion is twilight cost 1 for each possession you can spot.
loreText: Any trespasser found by the guard is to be held at the tower.'

title: Cirith Ungol Sentry
gameText: <keyword>Damage +1.</keyword>
loreText: ...treachery had yielded up the Tower to the Lord of the Ringwraiths, and now for long years it had been held by evil things.

title: Flames Within
gameText:
While you have initiative, each of your sauron minions is strength +2.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a sauron minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is roaming).
loreText: Soon there was great peril of fire behind the wall....

title: Gorgoroth Keeper
gameText:
Besieger. While you control a site, this minion's twilight cost is 2.
Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control.
loreText: ...new foes came swirling behind....

title: Gorgoroth Swarm
gameText:
Besieger.
When you play this minion, you may spot another besieger and 6 companions to play a besieger from your discard pile and control a site.
loreText: File after file passed....

title: Gothmog
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
gameText:
