loreText: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.

title: Orophin
subtitle: Brother of Haldir
gameText: While Orophin is at a forest site and you can spot another Elf, Orophin is an archer.
loreText: ...wolves were howling on the wood's borders: but on the land of Lórien no shadow lay.

title: Refuge
gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
Fellowship: Discard a companion from hand to heal a companion.
loreText: Now you shall rest, and we will not speak of your further road for a while.'

title: Rúmil
subtitle: Brother of Haldir
gameText: Maneuver: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an elven card, Rúmil is an archer until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...the Elves feared and distrusted the world outside....

title: Seclusion
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each elven character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Spot an Elf companion to discard a condition from play.
loreText: We allow no strangers to spy out the secrets of the Naith. Few indeed are permitted even to set foot there.'

title: Taking the High Ground
gameText:
Toil 1. (For each elven character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 1.)
Archery: Discard an elven character from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1.
Each time the fellowship moves from an underground site, return your Elf to your hand.

title: Betrayal of Isengard
gameText:
Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove twilight1.
Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.
loreText: There is only one Lord of the Ring.'

title: Discoveries
gameText:
Spell. Toil 3. (For each gandalf character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 3.)
Spot a gandalf Wizard and X other companions to examine the top X cards of your draw deck. Replace those cards in any order.
loreText: I have come back from dark journeys and long search....'

title: Gandalf
subtitle: The White Rider
gameText: Skirmish: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him and another unbound companion skirmishing a minion to make Gandalf strength +3 and have him replace that companion in that skirmish.
loreText: Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day.'

title: Gandalf's Hat
gameText:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
Each time the fellowship moves from a battleground site, add a burden.
Regroup: Add 2 burdens to remove all twilight tokens from the twilight pool.
loreText: He wore a tall pointed blue hat....

title: Introspection
gameText: Spell. Choose one: Spot a gandalf Wizard to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions from play; or spot a gandalf Wizard at a battleground site to discard a condition from play.
loreText: ...I do not know the word  yet. But we shall soon see.'

title: Járnsmid
subtitle: Barding Emissary
gameText: At the start of each skirmish involving Járnsmid, you may remove a burden (or 2 burdens if you can spot another <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion).
loreText: Sauron's Easterling allies were another trial for the Bardings, still keenly aware of the great efforts to rebuild Dale.

title: Mysterious Wizard
gameText: Spell. Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 if you cannot spot 5 burdens).
loreText: ...there are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'

title: Salve
gameText:
Spell. To play, spot a gandalf Wizard.
Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound that would kill him or her, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
loreText: ...the whole hall became suddenly dark as night.

title: The Terror of His Coming
gameText: Make a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion strength +2. Then, if that companion is at a battleground or dwelling site, you may take a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> condition from your discard pile into hand.
loreText: The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.

title: Traveled Leader
gameText: Spot a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> Wizard to replace a site in the fellowships current region with a site from your adventure deck.
loreText: ...the question is: who will follow me, if I lead you there?'

title: Watch and Wait
gameText:
To play, spot a gandalf companion.
Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per bearer.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
loreText: I could not take it from him without doing greater harm; and I had no right to do so anyway.'

title: With Doom We Come
gameText:
While Gandalf is at an underground site, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
While the fellowship is at a battleground site, each gandalf character gains muster.
loreText: We come, we come with roll of drum....'

title: Come Away
gameText:
While you can spot Sméagol, the Shadow number of each site is 1.
Each time the fellowship moves, wound a companion or discard this condition.
loreText: All ways are watched, yes,' said Gollum. Of course they are. But hobbits must try some way. This may be least watched.'

title: From Deep in Shadow
gameText: Spot X <symbol>gollum</symbol> cards to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. You may play a revealed minion. Its twilight cost is 2.
loreText: ...she moved with a horrible speed, now running on her creaking legs, now making a sudden bound.

title: Not Alone
gameText: Each time the fellowship moves to a mountain or underground site, you may discard a <symbol>gollum</symbol> event from hand to take a minion from your discard pile into hand.
loreText: Gollum stalked the Ring-bearer over many leagues, awaiting the right opportunity to strike.

title: There's Another Way
gameText:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Sméagol is strength +1.
Regroup: Discard this condition to replace the fellowships current site with a site from your adventure deck.
loreText: Frodo felt a strange certainty that in this matter Gollum was for once not so far from the truth....

title: Treacherous Little Toad
gameText:
To play, spot a gollum card.
Bearer must be a wounded companion.
While you can spot a gollum character or a gollum card in your support area, bearer cannot heal.
loreText: The Precious will be ours once the Hobbitses are dead!'

title: Blade of Gondor
subtitle: Sword of Boromir
gameText:
Bearer must be Boromir.
He is damage +1.
Skirmish: If Boromir is not assigned to a skirmish, discard a gondor card borne by him to have him replace an unbound Hobbit skirmishing a minion.
loreText: Its strength pales next to that of the man wielding it.

title: Boromir
subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith
gameText:
Ranger.
Fellowship: Add twilight2 to heal Boromir.
loreText: ...seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face... proud and stern of glance.

title: Concealment
gameText: Make a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man strength +1. If he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion, your opponents cannot use special abilities.
loreText: ...your refuge is so hidden that perhaps he does not know that Men are concealed here.'

title: Confronting the Eye
gameText: Fellowship: Spot a gondor Man and add twilight2 to make each unbound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase (limit +1).
loreText: To know that I lived and walked the earth was a blow to his heart, I deem; for he knew it not till now.'

title: Elendil's Valor
gameText: Make a gondor companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: In panoply of ancient kings, / in chainéd rings he armoured him; / his shining shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him....'

title: Faramir
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor
gameText:
Ranger.
Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make him strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
loreText: We do not want the escapes of Mirkwood in Ithilien.'

title: Faramir's Sword
gameText:
Bearer must be Faramir.
He is damage +1.
Each minion skirmishing Faramir at a battleground or forest site is roaming.
loreText: There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full.'

title: Gondorian Steed
gameText:
Bearer must be a knight.
Bearer is damage +1.
Each time the fellowship moves from a mountain site, add twilight2.
loreText: A skilled cavalry augments Minas Tirith's mighty defenses.

title: Guardian
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each gondor character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Skirmish: If a gondor companion is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him or her replace an unbound companion skirmishing a minion.
loreText: Boromir wouldn't fail the other Hobbits as he had Frodo.

title: Invigorated
gameText: Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a gondor Man (or to heal 2 gondor Men if you can spot a roaming minion).
loreText: He sprang down the steps and away, leaping down the path.

title: Tireless
gameText: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a gondor Man strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a battleground site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing a hand weapon; he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion.
loreText: So long as foes were standing, so too would Aragorn.

title: Valorous Leader
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing bearer.
loreText: Before he ever sat the throne, Aragorn had proven himself a great leader to the people of Gondor.

title: Saruman
subtitle: Of Many Colours
gameText: Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) When you play Saruman, name a culture. Each companion of the named culture is strength 1.
loreText: White! he sneered. It serves as a beginning.'

title: Brutal Easterling
gameText: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish an exhausted companion, it is fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: Out of some savage land in the wide East they come, we deem.'

title: Castamir of Umbar
subtitle: Corsair Vandal
gameText:
Fierce. Toil 1. (For each men character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 1.)
Each wounded men minion is strength +2.
loreText: ...they have allied them with the Enemy, and now make a heavy stroke in his cause.'

title: Corrupted Spy
gameText:
This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is damage +1.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 0, this minion is fierce.

title: Countless Companies
gameText:
Response: If a men possession is discarded from play, stack it here.
Shadow: Remove twilight1 to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.
loreText: Not tall, but broad and grim... wielding great axes.'

title: Covetous Easterling
gameText: While this minion is skirmishing a Man, it is damage +2.
loreText: Long have the Men of Rhûn thirsted for the wealth of Gondor, and many times have they sought to claim it.

title: Crazed Hillman
gameText:
Fierce.
While this minion is in a fierce skirmish, it is strength +7 (or +10 if it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less).
loreText: Already given to fierce passions, a warrior of Dunland quickly frenzies in the heat of battle.

title: Crooked Townsman
gameText: This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot.
loreText: ...the Riders can use men and other creatures as spies, as we found at Bree.'

title: Dunlending Zealot
gameText: While this minion is exhausted, each unbound companion is resistance 1 (or 2 if the fellowship is at a battleground site).
loreText: ...unfriendly to the Dúnedain, hating the Rohirrim.

title: Easterling Banner-bearer
gameText: This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each companion he is skirmishing (or +2 for each if that companion has resistance 2 or less).
loreText: They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien. The Rohirrim cannot come.'

title: Enraged Southron
gameText:
Ambush twilight3.
The move limit for this turn is +1.
loreText: As with wild animals, fleeing prey seems only to incite the warriors of Harad.

title: Frenzied Dunlending
gameText: While this minion is bearing a possession, it is fierce.
loreText: While Dunlendings lack the skills of the trained soldiers they attack, they carry in them a well-honed hatred.

title: Gathering Strength
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each men character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Make a men minion strength +6.
loreText: Always more people coming to Mordor. One day all the peoples will be inside.'

title: Goaded to War
gameText:
To play, spot a men minion.
Each time the fellowship moves to a battleground or plains site, add twilight1.
loreText: ...the mûmakil were bellowing....

title: Gríma
subtitle: Betrayer of Rohan
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a men minion, you may exert Gríma to exert a companion.
loreText: In his eyes was the hunted look of a beast seeking some gap in the ring of his enemies.

title: Harrying Hillman
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a men minion, add twilight2.
loreText: Though Dunlendings are by no means cowardly, their prowess in battle seems to manifest more as victory grows more assured.

title: Hemmed In
gameText:
While you can spot 6 companions, each companion skirmishing a men minion loses all strength bonuses from possessions.
Maneuver: Spot your men minion and discard this condition to transfer a Free Peoples possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.

title: Last Days
gameText: Each time a men minion is killed or discarded from play (except during the regroup phase), you may play a men minion. Its twilight cost is 2, and it is fierce and strength +2 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Not long now shall stand the high hall which Brego son of Eorl built. Fire shall devour the high seat.'

title: Messenger's Mount
gameText:
Bearer must be The Mouth of Sauron. He is fierce.
Response: If a men minion is about to take a wound, remove twilight3 to prevent that.
loreText: ...it was huge and hideous, and its face was a frightful mask....

title: The Mouth of Sauron
subtitle: Messenger of Mordor
gameText: Maneuver: Exert The Mouth of Sauron to play a men condition or men possession from your draw deck.
loreText: ...he learned great sorcery, and knew much of the mind of Sauron; and he was more cruel than any orc.

title: Mûmak Rider
gameText:
Archer.
When you play this minion to a battleground or plains site, you may spot another men minion to discard a possession from play.
loreText: Only the best marksmen can keep their aim true as they are carried along by the great beasts of the Haradrim.

title: Poisonous Words
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each men character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Add twilight1 for each men card you can spot.
loreText: So fair. So cold. Like a morning of pale spring still clinging to winter's chill.'

title: Trail of Terror
gameText: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot 3 <symbol>men</symbol> minions and remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> to make each unbound companion resistance 1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Now the Wild Men are moving through the Westfold, burning as they go.'

title: War Trident
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 5 or less, bearer is strength +2.
While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 3 or less, bearer is strength +2.

title: Wrathful Hillman
gameText: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a plains site, remove <symbol>twilight2</symbol> or discard this minion.
loreText: For behold! the storm comes, and now all friends should gather together, lest each singly be destroyed.'

title: The Balrog
subtitle: The Terror of Khazad-dûm
gameText:
Damage +1.
While The Balrog is at an underground site, it is fierce and cannot take wounds or be exerted.
loreText: The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.

title: Whip of Many Thongs
subtitle: Weapon of Flame and Shadow
gameText:
Bearer must be The Balrog. It is fierce.
When you play this artifact, the Free Peoples player reveals his or her hand and discards all Free Peoples cards from hand that have a twilight cost of 1 or less.
loreText: ...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed....

title: Abiding Evil
gameText: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing an <symbol>orc</symbol> Orc strength X.
loreText: The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'

title: Barrage
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each orc character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Make each of your orc minions strength +2 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Fires now raged unchecked in the first circle of the City....

title: The Beckoning Shadow
gameText:
To play, exert an orc minion.
If you can spot 5 burdens, and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
loreText: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.

title: Bloodstained Field
gameText: Spot an <symbol>orc</symbol> lurker to wound an Elf.
loreText: Orcs will eagerly spill any blood, but Elven is the sweetest of all.

title: Cave Troll of Moria
subtitle: Savage Menace
gameText:
Damage +1. Fierce. Toil 2. (For each orc character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Each time an orc lurker wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
loreText: There is no hope of escape that way.'

title: Cave Troll's Hammer
subtitle: Unwieldy Cudgel
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc Troll.
When you play this possession, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each lurker you spot.
loreText: Its weight is greater than any foe it has felled.

title: Goblin Aggressor
gameText: While this minion is bearing a possession, each <symbol>orc</symbol> minion is strength +1.
loreText: The road may lead to Moria, but how can we hope that it will lead through Moria....'

title: Great Cost
gameText:
At the start of each skirmish involving an orc minion, you may spot 6 companions to exert a companion in that skirmish.
Shadow: Discard this condition and spot an orc minion to make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck.

title: Mordor Aggressor
gameText: While this minion is bearing a possession, each <symbol>orc</symbol> minion is strength +2.
loreText: The enemy,' men murmured. The dike is down. Here they come pouring through the breaches!'

title: Morgul Tormentor
gameText: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.
loreText: Some Orcs go beyond savagery, taking pleasure in the suffering of their enemies.

title: Orc Artisan
gameText: Each time you play an <symbol>orc</symbol> possession on an <symbol>orc</symbol> Orc, you may add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> (or <symbol>twilight2</symbol> if that Orc is at a battleground or underground site).
loreText: Much Orc weaponry is scavenged from fallen foes, but they still have ample need for smiths to outfit their troops.

title: Orc Dreg
gameText: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at an underground site, remove <symbol>twilight2</symbol> or discard this minion.
loreText: ...their Captain cared not greatly what they did or how many might be slain....

title: Orc Footman
gameText: When this minion is discarded from play, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to shuffle this minion into your draw deck.
loreText: On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached....

title: Orc Sapper
gameText: When you play this minion, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to prevent that companion from being assigned to this minion until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence and to keep the men of Gondor busy in many places.

title: Orc Skulker
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each skirmish event you play is twilight cost 1.
loreText: I have never heard before of Orcs upon Amon Hen. Yet who knows what may happen in these evil days....'

title: Orc Spear
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc minion.
When you play this possession on a minion that has a twilight cost of 4 or more, add twilight2.
loreText: The flared backs of Orkish spearheads are crafted to inflict more damage as they are pulled out of a victim.

title: Orc Strategist
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Maneuver: Make an orc lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.
loreText: It takes a strong will indeed to command an unruly band of Orcs.

title: Orc Tormentor
gameText: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.
loreText: ...orc-speech sounded at all times full of hate and anger....

title: Pitiless Orc
gameText: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.
loreText: Curses they heeded not, nor understood the tongues of western men...

title: Rallying Orc
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time you play another orc lurker at a battleground or underground site, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
loreText: Orcs can spring from the shadows in surprising numbers.

title: Retribution
gameText:
Each time an orc minion bearing a weapon wins a skirmish, add a burden.
Shadow: Discard this condition to play an orc weapon from your discard pile.
loreText: With his mighty army, the Dark Lord exacted a high price for resisting his will.

title: Scavenging Goblins
gameText: When you play this minion, you may play an <symbol>orc</symbol> weapon from your discard pile on your <symbol>orc</symbol> Orc.
loreText: The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'

title: Storming the Ramparts
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each orc character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Spot an orc minion to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions from play.
loreText: The defenses of Minas Tirith were daunting, but the siegecraft of the Orcs was equal to the challenge.

title: Taunt
gameText: Reveal the top 5 cards of your draw deck (or, if the fellowship is at a battleground site, the top 7 cards) to make an <symbol>orc</symbol> minion strength +1 for each <symbol>orc</symbol> card revealed.
loreText: Go on. Call for help. Squeal! No one's gonna save you now.'

title: Troll's Keyward
subtitle: Keeper of the Beast
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Shadow: Exert Trolls Keyward and reveal your hand to add twilight1 for each orc Troll revealed.
loreText: Tending the Cave Troll is a task neither envied or respected within the tribes of Moria.

title: Vile Goblin
gameText: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a Dwarf, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: The Orcs infesting Khazad-dûm despoiled and defiled the ancient Dwarven mansion.

title: Aldred
subtitle: Éored Soldier
gameText: At the start of each skirmish involving Aldred, you may discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: We counted all the slain and despoiled them....'

title: Cast Out
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each rohan character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Maneuver: Spot a rohan Man and discard this condition to exert a minion.
Maneuver: Spot a mounted rohan Man and discard this condition to return an exhausted minion to its owners hand.

title: Challenging the Orc-host
gameText: Make a <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion strength +2 (or +1 for each minion you can spot if that companion has resistance 5 or more).
loreText: ...we overtook the Orcs at nightfall two days ago, near to the borders of the Entwood. There we surrounded them, and gave battle....'

title: Cleaving a Path
gameText: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a rohan companion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a plains site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing armor; he or she is skirmishing a wounded minion.
loreText: Captains and champions fell or fled before them.

title: Coif
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
Each time a Shadow card adds any number of twilight tokens, you may exert bearer to prevent that.
Each time the fellowship moves from a forest site, exert a companion.
loreText: ...the Hornburg still held fast, like an island in a sea.

title: Éomer
subtitle: Éored Leader
gameText:
While you can spot a rohan Man, Éomers twilight cost is 1.
Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Éomer to play a rohan companion from your draw deck.
loreText: ...the front of the first éored roared like a breaker foaming to the shore....

title: Éored Warrior
gameText: While this companion is at a battleground or plains site, he is strength +3.
loreText: ...suspecting what I most fear, a league between Orthanc and the Dark Tower, I led forth my éored, men of my own household....'

title: For the Mark
gameText:
Spot a rohan Man to discard a possession from play.
You may exert a rohan Man who has resistance 3 or more to play this event during the maneuver phase.
loreText: South strode Éomer and men fled before his face, and they were caught between the hammer and the anvil.

title: Golden Glimmer
gameText: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot a rohan companion and add 2 burdens to prevent that.
loreText: Dark is the hour, yet maybe we shall return to the Golden Hall.'

title: Haethen
subtitle: Veteran Fighter
gameText:
Haethen cannot take wounds during fierce skirmishes.
Skirmish: Exert Haethen to make him strength +1.
loreText: His years as a Rider of Rohan were long behind him, but the threat to Helm's Deep demanded this old warrior again take up arms.

title: Léofric
subtitle: Defender of the Mark
gameText: Skirmish: If Léofric is in a skirmish, exert him to play a rohan skirmish event from your draw deck.
loreText: There is trouble now on all our borders, and we are threatened....'

title: The Mouth of Sauron
subtitle: Lieutenant of Barad-dûr
gameText: Assignment: Assign The Mouth of Sauron to the companion who has the highest strength. (If two or more are tied for highest, choose one.)
loreText: Is there anyone in this rout with authority to treat with me?' he asked. Or indeed with wit to understand me?'

title: Bilbo
subtitle: Melancholy Hobbit
gameText:
Ring-bound.
At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may exert him to take a shire skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: I want to see the wild country again before I die, and the Mountains....'

title: Diversion
gameText: Discard a Hobbit not assigned to a skirmish from play to discard a minion from play. If the fellowship is at a battleground site, you may add 2 burdens to play this event during a skirmish involving a Hobbit.
loreText: Each member of the fellowship was willing to make any sacrifice to safeguard the Quest.

title: Flotsam and Jetsam
gameText: If a companion (except a Hobbit) wins a skirmish, heal a Hobbit.
loreText: Welcome, my lords, to Isengard!' he said. We are the doorwardens.'

title: Home and Hearth
gameText: Each time you play a Hobbit, you may remove a burden. Then, if the fellowship is at dwelling site, heal the Ring-bearer.
loreText: He drew a deep breath. Well, I'm back,' he said.

title: Hope is Kindled
gameText: Make a Hobbit strength +2. If that Hobbit wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.
loreText: Soft as butter they can be, and yet sometimes as tough as old tree-roots.'

title: Long Live the Halflings
gameText:
To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: If your Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to make each companion who has resistance 7 or more strength +2 until the regroup phase.
loreText: My friends, you bow to no one.'

title: Measure of Comfort
gameText: While you can spot a Hobbit, each unbound companion is resistance +1.
loreText: Though fate had it that the fellowship would not accompany Frodo to his final goal, some reassurance came in knowing he did not have to make the journey alone.

title: No Worse for Wear
gameText: Prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Then, if the fellowship is at a dwelling site, you may discard 2 cards from hand to return this event to your hand.
loreText: That was good.'Let's get another one!'

title: Pippin
subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence
gameText: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or heal a companion.
loreText: Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'

title: A Promise
gameText: While you can spot Frodo and Sam and neither is exhausted, each is strength +1.
loreText: But I'm glad, Sam. I cannot tell you how glad. Come along! It is plain that we were meant to go together.'

title: Rosie Cotton
subtitle: Barmaid
gameText:
Sam cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns Rosie Cotton to a skirmish, add 2 burdens.
loreText: It seems she didn't like my going abroad at all....'

title: Simple Living
gameText: Response: If you play a shire event, discard this condition to heal each Hobbit.
loreText: They do not and did not understand or like machines more complicated than a forge-bellows, a water-mill, or a hand-loom....

title: Stand Together
gameText: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, he or she gains muster until the end of the turn. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
loreText: For a breathless time they sat there, silent and alert...'

title: Sudden Fury
gameText:
Each time a shire companion loses a skirmish, add a shire token here.
Skirmish: Remove a shire token from here to make a shire companion strength +1.
loreText: It raised a whip a second time, but the blow never fell.

title: Tolman Cotton
subtitle: Farmer of Bywater
gameText: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, spot another Hobbit and exert Tolman Cotton to prevent that.
loreText: The land was rich and kindly, and though it had been long deserted when they entered it, it had before been well tilled....

title: Advancing Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
When you cannot spot another urukhai minion, discard this minion.
loreText: Already they are scaling the bank at many points, thick as marching ants.'

title: Barbaric Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1.
Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign this minion to an unwounded companion.
loreText: Their lust for Man-flesh allowed Saruman to bend the Uruk-hai to his will.

title: Berserker Torch
gameText:
Toil 1. (For each urukhai character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 1.)
Bearer must be an urukhai Uruk-hai.
Bearer is strength +2 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.
loreText: ...the Orcs have brought a devilry from Orthanc....'

title: Breeding Pit Conscript
gameText:
Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
When you play this minion, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.
loreText: A select few of Saruman's Uruk-hai were charged with harvesting his war-machine.

title: Broken Heirloom
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each urukhai character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Spot an urukhai minion to discard a possession borne by a companion who has resistance 4 or less.
loreText: ...he blew the horn. But no help came. Only more orcs.'

title: Broken in Defeat
gameText: Make an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion strength +2. Then you may spot 6 companions to return this event to your hand.
loreText: The world of Men will fall and all will come to darkness, and my city to ruin.'

title: Crushing Uruk
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving an urukhai minion, exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that companion.
loreText: Uruks strike with crippling force.

title: Dark Alliance
gameText: Response: If an ally or companion uses a special ability, discard this condition and exert an urukhai lurker to prevent that.
loreText: The power of Isengard is at your command, Sauron, Lord of the Earth.

title: Merciless Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to place this minion on the bottom of your draw deck.
loreText: They reached the summit of the rock; they drove towards the gates.

title: Quelling Force
gameText: Make an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion strength +1 for each other <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion you can spot.
loreText: They gained the gates. The trees, swung by strong arms, smote the timbers with a rending boom.

title: Saruman
subtitle: Agent of the Dark Lord
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to make an urukhai minion strength +2.
Each time a companion is killed, you may heal Saruman.
loreText: There will be no dawn for Men.'

title: Shingle in a Storm
gameText:
While you can spot 6 companions, each urukhai minion is damage +1.
Assignment: Discard this condition to assign an urukhai minion to a companion who has resistance 2 or less.
loreText: Against the Deeping Wall the hosts of Isengard roared like a sea.

title: Strange Device
gameText: Spot an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion to draw 3 cards. Then discard 2 cards from hand or discard an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion from hand.
loreText: ...a small white hand in the centre of a black field.

title: Suppressing Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1.
While there is a companion in the dead pile, each unbound companion is resistance 4.
loreText: Few fighters are skilled enough to outstrip the natural instincts of the Uruk-hai.

title: Tempest of War
gameText:
While you can spot an urukhai minion, each unbound companion is resistance 1 for each condition he or she bears.
Skirmish: Spot an urukhai minion and a companion who has resistance 2 or less to discard from play all conditions in all players support areas.

title: Uruk Common
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a battleground site, remove twilight2 or discard this minion.
loreText: Casualties of war were neither honored nor remembered by the White Hand.

title: Uruk Decimator
gameText:
While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +2.
While this minion is bearing a possession, it is damage +1.
loreText: The barricade was scattered as if by a thunderbolt.

title: Uruk Desecrator
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each unbound companion is resistance 2 for each wound he or she has.
loreText: Madness is seldom considered a liability, but a requisite in the ranks of the Uruk-hai.

title: Uruk Dominator
gameText:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make it strength +1 for each urukhai Uruk-hai you spot (or +2 for each if you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less).
loreText: The Great Orc race revels in its ability to overwhelm an enemy.

title: Uruk Pikeman
gameText:
Damage +1.
While this minion is skirmishing an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3 (or +5 if that companion has resistance 4 or less).
loreText: The dark tide flowed up to the walls from cliff to cliff.

title: Uruk Slaughterer
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving an urukhai minion, you may discard any number of cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
loreText: Captives of the Uruk-hai are treated with brutality and malice, but only if they survive their capture.

title: Uruk Zealot
gameText: Damage +1. To play, spot an urukhai minion. Each companion who has resistance 0 is strength 3. Each time Uruk Zealot wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards.
loreText: The Uruk-hai do not question the authority of the White Hand. They know its cause is righteous.

title: Uruk-hai Guard
gameText:
Damage +1.
Assignment: Exert this minion and spot a companion to prevent the Free Peoples player from assigning that companion to this minion.
loreText: Wolves and orcs were housed in Isengard, for Saruman was mustering a great force....'

title: Uruk-hai Troop
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each character skirmishing this minion loses all strength bonuses from weapons.
loreText: Attacking in swarming hordes, the Uruk-hai close with the enemy rapidly to make weapons useless.

title: Vicious Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may draw a card for each wound on a character it is skirmishing.
loreText: ...the sweet grass of Rohan had been bruised and blackened as they passed.

title: Weapon of Opportunity
gameText:
Bearer must be an urukhai minion.
When you play this possession on a minion that has a twilight cost of 4 or more, draw a card.
loreText: The fighting Uruk-hai will use any resource available to carry out the will of Saruman.

title: Worthy of Mordor
gameText: At the start of the regroup phase, you may remove twilight1 to make an urukhai minion gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
loreText: Tasked by Sauron, Saruman moved swiftly to build the army demanded of him.

title: Black Rider
gameText:
Fierce.
This minion is strength +1 for each companion you can spot.
loreText: The Nine are abroad again. They have crossed the River secretly and are moving westward. They have taken the guise of riders in black.'

title: Dark Approach
gameText: Play a Nazgûl. His twilight cost is 1 for each forest site you can spot (limit 4).
loreText: Frodo hesitated for a second: curiosity or some other feeling was struggling with his desire to hide.

title: Dark Temptation
gameText: Each time you play a Nazgûl, you may heal the Ring-bearer twice to add a burden.
loreText: He felt that he had only to slip it on, and then he would be safe.

title: Echo of Hooves
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each wraith character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Spot your Nazgûl at a battleground or forest site to play a mount on him from your draw deck.
loreText: ...the black horses leaped down the hill in pursuit, and from the Riders came a terrible cry....

title: In the Ringwraith's Wake
gameText: If a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
loreText: He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'

title: Lingering Shadow
gameText:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl.
Each time a wound is removed from bearer, add a burden.
loreText: I am wounded... wounded; it will never really heal.'

title: Minas Morgul Answers
gameText:
Toil 2. (For each wraith character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.)
Spot a Nazgûl to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
loreText: There was a flare of livid lightnings: forks of blue flame springing up from the tower and from the encircling hills into the sullen clouds.

title: Nazgûl Blade
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +1.
loreText: Fear and terror may be the greatest weapons the Nazgûl wield, but their steel is just as perilous.

title: Sauron's Gaze
gameText:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl.
The Free Peoples player cannot use bearers special abilities.
loreText: Then suddenly he seemed to see me, and he laughed at me. It was cruel. It was like being stabbed with knives.'

title: Sense of Obligation
gameText:
To play, spot a wraith minion.
Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
At the end of each assignment phase, if bearer is not assigned to a skirmish and a companion who does not bear a wraith condition is, add a burden.

title: Shadowy Mount
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is fierce.
Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign bearer to an unbound companion bearing a wraith condition.
loreText: ...why do these black horses endure such riders?'

title: Steed of Mordor
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Bearer gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw 2 cards.
loreText: ...the Black Riders rode like a gale....

title: Úlairë Attëa
subtitle: Black Predator
gameText:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Remove twilight2 and discard a wraith card from hand to make Úlairë Attëa strength +3.
loreText: Frodo thought that he heard a faint hiss as of venomous breath and felt a thin piercing chill.

title: Úlairë Cantëa
subtitle: Black Assassin
gameText:
Fierce.
Assignment: Assign Úlairë Cantëa to a companion who has resistance 0.
Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and another wraith card to kill a companion Úlairë Cantëa is skirmishing.
loreText: Flee them! Speak no words to them! They are deadly.'

title: Úlairë Enquëa
subtitle: Black Threat
gameText:
Fierce. Toil 1. (For each wraith character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 1.)
Response: If you are playing a wraith event that has toil X, exert Úlairë Enquëa to reduce that events twilight cost by X.
loreText: ...the Shire is no longer any protection to you.'

title: Úlairë Lemenya
subtitle: Black Enemy
gameText: When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may play a <symbol>wraith</symbol> mount from your discard pile.
loreText: Out of the gate in the trees that they had just left rode a Black Rider.

title: Úlairë Nelya
subtitle: Black Hunter
gameText:
Fierce.
Each time Úlairë Nelya wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.
loreText: ...peril is now both before you and behind you, and upon either side.'

title: Úlairë Nertëa
subtitle: Black Horseman
gameText:
The twilight cost of each mount is 1.
While Úlairë Nertëa is mounted, each Nazgûl is strength +1 and has muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
loreText: Watch every shadow! ...Black horsemen have passed through Bree.'

title: Úlairë Otsëa
subtitle: Black Specter
gameText: Shadow: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a wraith condition from hand to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
loreText: We can feel their presence  it troubled our hearts, as soon as we came here, and before we saw them; they feel ours more keenly.'

title: Úlairë Toldëa
subtitle: Black Shadow
gameText:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Toldëa, you may exert him to take a wraith event from your discard pile into hand.
loreText: So black were they that they seemed like black holes in the deep shade behind them.

title: Unending Life
gameText:
While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgûl is strength +3.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a Nazgûl.
loreText: The power of their master is in them, and they stand or fall by him.'

title: Unimpeded
gameText: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Nazgûl strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he is at a battleground or forest site; he is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; he is bearing a possession; he is in a fierce skirmish
loreText: Who goes there?'

title: The Witch-king
subtitle: Black Lord
gameText:
Fierce.
The Witch-king is twilight cost 1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
Each time a companion is played, you may reveal this card from hand to exert the Ring-bearer.
loreText: He sprang forward and bore down on Frodo.

title: The Witch-king's Beast
subtitle: Fell Creature
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
If bearer is The Witch-king, after all skirmishes and fierce skirmishes have been resolved, you may exert him twice to make him participate in one additional assignment and skirmish phase.
loreText: The great shadow descended like a falling cloud.

title: The Angle
gameText: Forest. Shadow: Play a Nazgûl (or spot 6 companions and discard 2 cards from hand) to draw a card.

title: The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
gameText: Battleground. Underground. The Balrog is twilight cost 3.

title: Emyn Muil
gameText: Mountain. Maneuver: Remove twilight2 and exert your minion that is not fierce to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Hill of Sight
gameText: Battleground. Forest. While you can spot 3 minions (or 6 companions), each unbound companion is resistance 2.

title: Hobbiton Market
gameText: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves from this site, wound each minion that is not a lurker.

title: Northern Pelennor
gameText: Battleground. Plains. Shadow: Make your lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.

title: Shores of Nen Hithoel
gameText: River. Shadow: Spot 5 orc Orcs to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

title: Slopes of Orodruin
gameText: Mountain. Shadow: Remove twilight2 and discard 2 Free Peoples cards from hand to draw a card.

title: Starkhorn
gameText: Mountain. Each time your Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.

title: Wold Battlefield
gameText: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your Man (except an enduring Man) to make him or her damage +1.

title: Gandalf
subtitle: The White Rider
gameText: Skirmish: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him and another unbound companion skirmishing a minion to make Gandalf strength +3 and have him replace that companion in that skirmish.
loreText: Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day.'

title: Faramir
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor
gameText:
Ranger.
Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make him strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
loreText: We do not want the escapes of Mirkwood in Ithilien.'

title: Faramir's Sword
gameText:
Bearer must be Faramir.
He is damage +1.
Each minion skirmishing Faramir at a battleground or forest site is roaming.
loreText: There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full.'

title: The Balrog
subtitle: The Terror of Khazad-dûm
gameText:
Damage +1.
While The Balrog is at an underground site, it is fierce and cannot take wounds or be exerted.
loreText: The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.

title: Dark Approach
gameText: Play a Nazgûl. His twilight cost is 1 for each forest site you can spot (limit 4).
loreText: Frodo hesitated for a second: curiosity or some other feeling was struggling with his desire to hide.

title: Úlairë Attëa
subtitle: Black Predator
gameText:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Remove twilight2 and discard a wraith card from hand to make Úlairë Attëa strength +3.
loreText: Frodo thought that he heard a faint hiss as of venomous breath and felt a thin piercing chill.

title: Úlairë Cantëa
subtitle: Black Assassin
gameText:
Fierce.
Assignment: Assign Úlairë Cantëa to a companion who has resistance 0.
Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and another wraith card to kill a companion Úlairë Cantëa is skirmishing.
loreText: Flee them! Speak no words to them! They are deadly.'

title: Úlairë Enquëa
subtitle: Black Threat
gameText:
Fierce. Toil 1. (For each wraith character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 1.)
Response: If you are playing a wraith event that has toil X, exert Úlairë Enquëa to reduce that events twilight cost by X.
loreText: ...the Shire is no longer any protection to you.'

title: The Witch-king
subtitle: Black Lord
gameText:
Fierce.
The Witch-king is twilight cost 1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
Each time a companion is played, you may reveal this card from hand to exert the Ring-bearer.
loreText: He sprang forward and bore down on Frodo.

title: Arod
subtitle: Rohirrim Steed
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
When you play Arod, you may reinforce a dwarven token.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, remove 2 dwarven tokens to prevent that.
loreText: A smaller and lighter horse, but restive and fiery....

title: Awkward Moment
gameText: Make a Dwarf strength +3 (or +4 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword> if you can spot a <symbol>dwarven</symbol> token).
loreText: It's a long way.

title: Deep Hatred
gameText:
Each time the fellowship moves, add twilight2.
Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf who is not assigned to a skirmish to wound 2 Orcs (or to wound 1 Orc twice).
Discard this from play if the fellowship is ahead on the adventure path.
loreText: ...the War of the Dwarves and the Orcs....

title: Dwarf-lords
gameText: You may remove from the game 4 other <symbol>dwarven</symbol> cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your Dwarf bearing a hand weapon strength +3.
loreText: ...Seven for the Dwarf-lords in their halls of stone....

title: Gimli
subtitle: Lord of the Glittering Caves
gameText:
Damage +1.
Gimli is strength +1 for each minion assigned to a skirmish.
Assignment: Exert Gimli and spot a lurker minion to make that minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.
loreText: He and his people did great works in Gondor and Rohan.

title: Honoring His Kinfolk
gameText: If a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, play a <symbol>dwarven</symbol> possession from your discard pile and you may reinforce a <symbol>dwarven</symbol> token.
loreText: ...but Gimli had to be dragged away by Legolas....

title: Sorrow Shared
gameText: Remove a <symbol>dwarven</symbol> token to heal a Dwarf.
loreText: Gimli was saddened by Éowyn's despair.

title: Subterranean Homestead
gameText:
To play, exert 2 Dwarves.
When you play this, add a dwarven token here for each mountain site and each underground site on the adventure path.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a Shadow player discard the top card of his or her draw deck.

title: Arwen
subtitle: Reflection of Lúthien
gameText:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each of your other elven companions is resistance +1.
Skirmish: Exert Arwen to make a minion she is skirmishing strength 1 for each other companion assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: Arwen vanimelda, namarië!'

title: Asfaloth
subtitle: Swift Blossom
gameText:
Bearer must be an Elf.
When you play Asfaloth, you may reinforce an elven token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 elven tokens to heal bearer (or heal bearer and heal another Elf if bearer is in a fierce skirmish).
loreText: ...my horse will not let any rider fall....'

title: Celeborn
subtitle: The Wise
gameText:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each Elf who has resistance 7 or more gains muster.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may take an elven event into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: I did not know that your plight was so evil.'

title: City of the Trees
gameText: At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn. At the start of each skirmish involving an Elf and a wounded minion, you may draw a card.
loreText: Many stairs they climbed to meet the Galadhrim.

title: Crashing Cavalry
gameText: <keyword>Assignment:</keyword> Discard this from play and assign a minion to an <symbol>elven</symbol> companion. Those characters cannot use skirmish special abilities until the start of the regroup phase.
loreText: At that moment there came a roaring and a rushing: a noise of loud waters rolling many stones.

title: Final Shot
gameText: Make an <symbol>elven</symbol> companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn).
loreText: Redoubling their efforts, the Company at last felled the Cave Troll.

title: Galadriel
subtitle: Sorceress of the Hidden Land
gameText:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reveal a card from the top of your draw deck for each forest on the adventure path to heal an Elf for each elven card revealed.
loreText: Do not let your hearts be troubled....'

title: Inside a Song
gameText: Exert an Elf to take an <symbol>elven</symbol> skirmish event into hand from your discard pile and you may reinforce an <symbol>elven</symbol> token.
loreText: I thought that Elves were all for moon and stars; but this is more elvish than anything I ever heard tell of.'

title: Kindreds Estranged
gameText: You may remove from the game 4 other <symbol>elven</symbol> cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make a minion skirmishing your Elf at a forest or river site strength 3.
loreText: Men multiply and the Firstborn decrease....'

title: Legolas
subtitle: Of the Grey Company
gameText:
Archer.
At the start of each archery phase, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an elven card, wound a minion.
loreText: My heart bids me go on... but we must hold together. I will follow your counsel.'

title: Let Fly
gameText: Spot 3 Elves, spot a Shadow race, and choose a Shadow player to wound each of that players minions which is not of that race.
loreText: Yet I make my tale twenty at the least. But that is only a few leaves in a forest.'

title: Lórien Protector
gameText: While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.
loreText: There was a sound of soft laughter over their heads, and then another clear voice spoke in an elven-tongue.

title: Many Miles
gameText: Spot 2 Elf archers to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if a Shadow player has replaced the fellowships current site this turn).
loreText: I can see a darkness. There are shapes moving in it, great shapes far away upon the bank of the river; but what they are I cannot tell.'

title: Secluded Homestead
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
When you play this, add an elven token here for each forest site and each river site on the adventure path.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to reconcile your hand.

title: Shrouded Elf
gameText: <keyword>Response:</keyword> If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.
loreText: Cloaked by Elven garments and by darkness, warriors led by Haldir reinforced Helm's Deep.

title: Spring Forth Nimbly
gameText: Make an Elf strength +1 for each card that has an <symbol>elven</symbol> token on it.
loreText: ...the Elf had no boots, but wore only light shoes, as he always did....

title: Standing Tall
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this condition from play to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength 1 for each of the following that is true: it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or more; it is wounded; you can spot an Elf archer; the fellowship is at a forest site.
loreText: Yrch,' said Legolas, falling into his own tongue.

title: Take Up the Bow
gameText: Toil 2. (For each elven character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is 2.) Archery: Discard this from play and spot 3 Elf archers to discard a minion from play. Each of those archers loses archer and cannot gain archer.
loreText: Stringing the bow and fitting an arrow....

title: Wells of Deep Memory
gameText:
At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card for each of the following you can spot: Arwen, Celeborn, or Galadriel.

title: Alatar
subtitle: Final Envoy
gameText:
Aid twilight2. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight2 to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may reinforce a gandalf token. While you can spot a gandalf companion, each minion skirmishing bearer is strength 1.
loreText: Third of the Istari to be named, he was clad in sea-blue.

title: Dasron
subtitle: Merchant From Dorwinion
gameText: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may remove 2 Free Peoples culture tokens to take a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> event into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: ...its inhabitants, traditional trading partners of Esgaroth and Dale, now look to their northern allies for protection against the wild Easterlings....

title: Fear and Great Wonder
gameText:
When you play this, add a gandalf token here.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to spot a gandalf companion. That companion gains muster until end of turn.
loreText: The Hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.

title: The Flame of Anor
gameText:
Spell.
Spot 3 gandalf companions to make a minion skirmishing a companion strength 3.
loreText: The power of the flame is like that of the Sun  beautiful yet blinding.

title: For a While Less Dark
gameText:
Spell.
Make a gandalf companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion bears a follower).
loreText: The Nazgûl gave a long wailing cry and swerved away; and with that the four others waivered....

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Bearer of Obligation
gameText: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 <symbol>gandalf</symbol> cards from hand.
loreText: But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care.'

title: Look to My Coming
gameText:
You may remove from the game 4 other gandalf cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Spot Gandalf to make your gandalf companion strength +3.
loreText: ...at dawn on the fifth day.'

title: No Colour Now
gameText: Discard your <symbol>gandalf</symbol> condition from play to discard a condition from play and draw a card.
loreText: He raised his hand, and spoke slowly in a clear cold voice. Saruman, your staff is broken.'

title: The Palantír of Orthanc
subtitle: Recovered Seeing Stone
gameText: Bearer must be Gandalf. To play this, if you can spot The Palantír of Orthanc, discard it. At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add a burden to reveal a Shadow player's hand. He or she must choose a revealed minion and discard it from hand.
loreText: ...a heavy shining thing came hurtling down from above.

title: Pallando
subtitle: Far-travelling One
gameText:
Aid  twilight2.
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a gandalf companion, exert bearer twice. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.
loreText: Brought as a companion by Alatar, he traveled the South and East to aid the Free Peoples.

title: Radagast
subtitle: Tender of Beasts
gameText:
Aid  twilight2. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight2 to transfer this to a companion.)
While you can spot 2 gandalf companions, minions skirmishing bearer do not gain strength bonuses from possessions.
loreText: It would have been useless in any case to try and win over the honest Radagast to treachery.'

title: Return to Us
gameText: Discard 2 Shadow cards from hand to take a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> event into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: Yes, that was the name. I was Gandalf.'

title: Shadowfax
subtitle: Roaring Wind
gameText:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
When you play Shadowfax, you may reinforce a gandalf token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 gandalf tokens to wound a minion skirmishing bearer.
loreText: Then Shadowfax gathered himself together and sprang away, and the night flowed over him....

title: Strange Meeting
gameText: Each companion bearing a follower gains <keyword>muster</keyword> (and is strength +1 if that companion is a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion).
loreText: Gandalf obviously expected to find Treebeard here; and Treebeard might almost have been loitering about near the gates on purpose to meet him.'

title: Traveler's Homestead
gameText:
To play, spot a Wizard.
When you play this, add X gandalf tokens here, where X is the current region number.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to discard a Shadow condition from play.
loreText: Of the Wizards, it was Gandalf that chose no home.

title: Vapour and Steam
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert your <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion and add a burden to make that companion <keyword>damage +1</keyword>.
loreText: There was none to see, or perhaps in after ages songs would still be sung of the Battle of the Peak.'

title: Chasm's Edge
gameText: Gollum is strength +1 for each Ring-bound companion you can spot.
loreText: ...Gollum, dancing like a mad thing, held aloft the ring... It shown now as if verily it was wrought of living fire.

title: Cunningly Hidden
gameText: You may remove from the game 4 <symbol>gollum</symbol> cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Spot Gollum to make a minion strength +2.
loreText: No one ever found out what had become of Déagol....'

title: Déagol
subtitle: Fateful Finder
gameText:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Aid  Add a burden.
Skirmish: If bearer is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this from play to play an artifact or possession from your draw deck on bearer.
loreText: ...there in his hand lay a beautiful golden ring.'

title: Duality
gameText: Spot Sméagol to choose a Shadow player who must discard a Shadow card from hand or remove <symbol>twilight2</symbol>.
loreText: Gollum had two loyalties: The Ring and The Ring.

title: Fishing Boat
gameText:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
When you play Fishing Boat, you may reinforce a gollum token.
Each time Sméagol is about to be overwhelmed in a skirmish, you may remove 2 gollumtokens to make him strength +2 until the end of that skirmish.

title: Gladden Homestead
gameText:
To play, spot Sméagol.
When you play this, add a gollum token here for each gollumcard you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to spot a Shadow condition and place that condition on top of its owners draw deck.

title: Gollum
subtitle: Her Sneak
gameText:
While a card titled Déagol is removed from the game, Gollum is strength +2 and fierce.
Shadow: Remove a card titled Déagol in your discard pile from the game to play this minion from your discard pile.
loreText: Of that deadly gleam and of the dark eyeholes Frodo and Sam were always conscious.

title: It's My Birthday
gameText: Make Gollum strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot Sméagol or Déagol).
loreText: Give us that, Déagol, my love....'

title: Little Snuffler
gameText:
If the fellowship is in region 1, spot Gollum to wound a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 2, spot Gollum to exert a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 3, play a gollum minion from your discard pile.

title: Naked Waste
gameText: You may remove from the game 4 other <symbol>gollum</symbol> cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Spot Sméagol to make a Ring-bound companion strength +3.
loreText: Nothing can hide from them. Curse the White Face!'

title: Out of All Knowledge
gameText: Spot Sméagol or exert Gollum to make Sméagol strength +2 and you may reinforce a <symbol>gollum</symbol> token.
loreText: And he thought suddenly: It would be cool and shady under those mountains. The Sun could not watch me there.'

title: Sméagol
subtitle: Simple Stoor
gameText:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
For each card titled Déagol in your discard pile, Sméagol is strength +2 and resistance 1. Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may take a gollum card from your draw deck and place it in your discard pile.
loreText: ...his head and his eyes were downward.'

title: Softly Up Behind
gameText: Spot Sméagol and discard 2 <symbol>gollum</symbol>cards from hand to return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owners hand. While this is in your discard pile, Sméagol gains <keyword>muster</keyword>.
loreText: The Ring went into the shadows with him, and even the maker... could learn nothing of it.'

title: Trap Is Sprung
gameText: To play, discard Gollum from play. Heal the Ring-bearer to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on the Ring-bearer.
loreText: Crumbs on his jacket. He took it. He took it!'

title: Wild Light of Madness
gameText: Spot Gollum to make the Free Peoples player choose to either add a burden or exert a companion.
loreText: ...for at that moment many things happened.

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Isildur's Heir
gameText:
Aragorn is strength +1 for each gondor card that has a culture token on it.
At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Thus came Aragorn, son of Arathorn, Elessar....

title: Away on the Wind
gameText: <keyword>Response:</keyword> If Faramir is about to take a wound, discard this condition from play and place Boromir or Denethor in the dead pile from play to prevent that and heal Faramir twice.
loreText: ...then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated.'

title: Banners Blowing
gameText: You may remove from the game 4 other <symbol>gondor</symbol> cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man strength +3.
loreText: And so... with less than six thousands... the Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate....

title: Boromir
subtitle: Doomed Heir
gameText:
Boromir is resistance 1 for each lurker minion you can spot.
Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make him strength +1 for each possession he bears.
loreText: I shall go to Minas Tirith, alone if need be, for it is my duty.'

title: Brego
subtitle: Loyal Steed
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor companion.
When you play Brego, you may reinforce a gondor token.
Maneuver: Exert bearer and remove 2 gondor tokens to wound a minion.
loreText: Turn this fellow free. He has seen enough of war.'

title: Denethor
subtitle: Last Ruling Steward
gameText:
Denethor is resistance +1 for each gondor possession in your discard pile.
Maneuver: Spot a gondor possession borne by a companion and remove that posssession from the game to exert a minion twice.
loreText: ...he took up the staff of his Stewardship that lay at his feet and broke it on his knee.

title: Elendil
subtitle: High-king of Gondor
gameText:
Knight. To play, spot 2 gondor knights or exert 2 gondor Men.
Each of your gondor companions is resistance +1.
Maneuver: Remove a gondor token to make an unbound companion resistance +1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...and Elendil of Westernesse who overthrew Sauron....'

title: Faramir
subtitle: Prince of Ithilien
gameText:
While you can spot Boromir, Faramir is twilight cost 1.
While you can spot Denethor, Faramir is twilight cost 1.
While Faramir bears a gondor possession, he is defender +1.
loreText: Do you wish then... that our places had been exchanged?'

title: Guard of the White Tree
gameText:
Knight.
Skirmish: Discard a gondor condition from your support area to make this companion strength +2.
loreText: This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel....

title: Guarded City
gameText: Spot a <symbol>gondor</symbol> companion to reinforce a <symbol>gondor</symbol> token for each possession borne by that companion.
loreText: ...so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded but carven by giants out of the bones of the earth.

title: Heirs of Gondor
gameText:
When you play this, add a gondor token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a gondor companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2.
loreText: And Eldarion our son is a man full-ripe for kingship.'

title: Hope Renewed
gameText: Discard a <symbol>gondor</symbol> possession from play to discard a possession from play and you may reinforce a <symbol>gondor</symbol> token.
loreText: ...Frodo saw the old king's head: it was lying rolled away by the roadside... Look! The king has got a crown again!'

title: Isildur
subtitle: Heir of Elendil
gameText:
Knight.
Isildur is resistance +1 for each card in your hand. At the end of any phase, if Isildur has resistance 0, place him in your dead pile.
Each time you reconcile, you may draw a card.
loreText: ...Elendil's son cut the Ring from Sauron's hand....'

title: Kings' Legacy
gameText:
Each time Elendil wins a skirmish, make a gondor or elven companion strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.
Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a Man.
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, make a gondor Man damage +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Kingsfoil
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
Fellowship: Discard this possession from play to heal a companion and, if that companion is a shire companion, you may discard a condition he or she bears.
loreText: Life to the dying / In the king's hand lying!'

title: Rally the Company
gameText: Make a <symbol>gondor</symbol> companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion has resistance 6 or more).
loreText: Aragorn was able to keep the way open for escape from the Chamber of Mazarbul.

title: Stewards' Legacy
gameText:
Each time Denethor exerts, he gains muster until the end of the regroup phase.
Each time Boromir exerts, you may exert a minion.
Each time Faramir exerts, you may spot a minion to prevent it from using special abilites until the regroup phase.

title: Storied Homestead
gameText:
When you play this, add a gondor token here for each gondor companion who has resistance 7 or more.
Response: If a minions special ability is used, discard this condition or remove 2 gondor tokens from here to cancel its effect.
loreText: ...a silent company of tall images graven in cold stone.

title: Tradesman From Lebennin
gameText: At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add <symbol>twilight2</symbol> to reinforce a <symbol>gondor</symbol> token.
loreText: Fearful of the spreading Shadow, many from southern Gondor sought refuge behind the walls of Minas Tirith.

title: Alatar Deceived
gameText: Each time a Wizard wins a skirmish, this condition becomes a <keyword>fierce, damage +1</keyword> Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 11 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
loreText: ...the world of Men, which We must rule.'

title: Pallando Deceived
gameText: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a Wizard to make this condition a <keyword>fierce</keyword> Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
loreText: We may join with that Power.'

title: Radagast Deceived
gameText: Each time a Wizard heals, this condition becomes a <keyword>fierce</keyword> Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 12 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
loreText: Radagast the Simple! Radagast the Fool!'

title: Staff of Saruman
subtitle: Fallen Istar's Stave
gameText:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
Regroup: If Saruman is the only minion you can spot, discard this artifact from play to return him to your hand.
loreText: He raised his staff and it engulfed Gandalf in flames.

title: Bring Down the Wall
gameText: Spot a companion to make a <symbol>men</symbol> minion strength +1 for each wound on that companion.
loreText: Helm's Deep has one weakness. Its outer wall is solid rock but for a small culvert at its base, which is little more than a drain.'

title: Caravan From the South
gameText:
To play, spot a men minion.
When you play this, if you spot a plains site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 men tokens.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowships next site, you may discard a possession from play.

title: Corsair Champion
gameText:
Each time a Free Peoples possession is played, you may spot a men card and reveal this minion from hand to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
loreText: Rumor of his approach strikes terror.

title: Cruel Dunlending
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another <symbol>men</symbol> minion <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
loreText: Burning with a rage stoked by Saruman, the Wild Hillmen made the Rohirrim villagers suffer.

title: Desert Wind
gameText:
To play, spot a men minion.
While you can spot 5 or more culture tokens, the minion archery total is +2.
loreText: Silent Haradrim assassins strike as if from nowhere.

title: Driven From the Plains
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this condition from play to make a <symbol>men</symbol> minion <keyword>damage +1</keyword> for each of the following that is true: it is at a plains site; it is bearing a possession; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less.
loreText: The Hillmen sent the villagers before them like lambs to the slaughter.

title: Dunlending Patriarch
gameText:
When you play this, you may spot another men minion to make this minion twilight cost 1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
loreText: The wisdom of Dunland is passed from elder to youth.

title: Dunlending Trapper
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved before any others.)
To play, spot a men minion.
Assignment: Discard a men card from your hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
loreText: His traps catch men as well as beasts.

title: Easterling Runner
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Exert this minion, spot another  <symbol>men</symbol> minion, and remove a culture token to reinforce a <symbol>men</symbol> token.
loreText: The key to coordinating the columns of the Easterling army is their use of swift couriers.

title: Fires Brightly Burning
gameText: You may remove from the game 4 <symbol>men</symbol> cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your <symbol>men</symbol> minion strength +2.
loreText: The torches of hate carried by the Dunlendings were kindled by the voice of Saruman.

title: Gríma
subtitle: Footman of Saruman
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, you may spot another men minion to exert each companion.
loreText: He was crafty: dulling men's wariness, or working on their fears, as served the occasion.'

title: Harmless
gameText:
Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving a men minion, transfer this condition from your support area to that companion. Limit 1 per companion.
Minions cannot take wounds during skirmishes involving bearer.
loreText: The Dunlendings prey on weak village folk.

title: Howdah
gameText:
When you play this, add a men token here for each men archer you spot.
At the start of the archery phase, you may discard this condition from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make the minion archery total +1.
loreText: Wooden towers perched on the backs of the Mûmakil.

title: Lying in Wait
gameText:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to your men minion. (Limit 1 per bearer.)
Bearer is strength +1 for each other men minion you can spot.
Each time a men minion wins a skirmish, make bearer strength +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Merciless Dunlending
gameText: While you can spot another <symbol>men</symbol> minion, this minion is strength +2 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: Victims of the Dunlendings receive no quarter.

title: Pirate Cutthroat
gameText:
To play, spot a men card in your support area.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to reinforce a men token for each card you spot that has the same card title as that condition.
loreText: Prisoners are never taken by the Corsairs of Umbar.

title: Southron Murderer
gameText:
Archer.
While you can spot 4 or more culture tokens, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.
loreText: In Harad, death is often swift, but seldom painless.

title: Stragglers
gameText:
When you play this, add a men token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a men minion strength +2 for each men minion not assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: When finished ransacking a homestead, Dunlendings slaughtered fleeing villagers.

title: Vicious Dunlending
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another <symbol>men</symbol> minion <keyword>damage +1</keyword>.
loreText: A swath of terror cut across the fields of Rohan.

title: Voice of the Desert
subtitle: SouthronTroop
gameText:
To play, spot a men minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, each men minion cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, each men minion is an archer.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each men minion is fierce.

title: Worn Battleaxe
gameText: Bearer must be a <symbol>men</symbol> minion. While you can spot a culture token, bearer is strength +1 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: Arms of the Hillmen of Dunland are crude but effective.

title: Always Threatening
gameText:
When you play this, you may add an orc token here for each orc condition you can spot.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a lurker minion strength +2.

title: Chamber Patrol
gameText:
To play, spot an orc minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, orc Orcs cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, the current site gains underground.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each orc Orc is strength +2.

title: Defiled
gameText:
You may remove from the game 4 orc cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your orc lurker minion strength +2.
loreText: ...transmogrified to trophies by the advancing hordes.

title: Enemy Upon Enemy
gameText:
Regroup: Spot an orc lurker minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Remove a burden to play a lurker minion stacked here as if from hand. That minion is twilight cost 3.
loreText: On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached.

title: Expendable Servants
gameText: If you can spot more <symbol>orc</symbol> conditions than <symbol>orc</symbol> minions, you may discard your <symbol>orc</symbol> condition from play to play an <symbol>orc</symbol> minion from your discard pile.
loreText: Sauron's minions were loyal to his rule. Their loyalty was repaid in blood: the enemy's or their own.

title: Forced March
gameText:
To play, spot 2 orc minions.
