Regroup: Make the Free Peoples player spot another orc condition, discard it from play, and remove twilight3 to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows). Discard this condition.
loreText: Orcs do not rest.

title: Howling Orc
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved before any others.)
Each time an orc minion is killed in a skirmish, you may make this minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Losses served only to enrage the besiegers.

title: Isengard Informant
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Exert this minion to play an <symbol>orc</symbol> Troll from your discard pile.
loreText: Some remained in Isengard to propel the war machine.

title: Massing Strength
gameText: Discard any number of your <symbol>orc</symbol> minions from play to make an <symbol>orc</symbol> minion strength +3 for each one discarded.
loreText: ...the Dark Power, moving its armies like pieces on the board, was gathering them together.

title: Orc Crusher
gameText:
To play, spot an orc Orc.
This minion is twilight cost 1 for each burden.
Each time a Ring-bound companion loses a skirmish involving an orc minion, you may reveal this card from hand to add a burden.
loreText: Hit me now, Sam. Hit me!'

title: Orc Line-breaker
gameText: At the end of each skirmish involving this minion, if you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion is <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
loreText: Fell captains moved Sauron's forces from the Gorgoroth plains.

title: Orc Plains Runner
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Discard this minion from play (or exert this minion if the fellowships next site is an underground site) and spot another <symbol>orc</symbol> minion to return that minion to your hand.
loreText: Saruman unleashed the remaining minions to ravage the countryside of Rohan.

title: Orc Raid Commander
gameText:
To play, spot an orc card in your support area.
When you play this, spot a Free Peoples condition to discard from play each other card that has the same card title as that condition.
loreText: Once inside the walls of the City, the besiegers were ordered to kill on sight.

title: Orc Reaper
gameText: While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, each minion that has the title Orc Reaper is strength +2.
loreText: As they overrun the lands of the Free Peoples, the forces of the Shadow destroy all available resources.

title: Ordnance Grunt
gameText:
Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an orc minion.
Shadow: Discard an orc condition from play to play this minion from your discard pile.
loreText: Only Trolls had the strength to man the siege catapults.

title: Picket Denizen
gameText:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If another orc minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that.
loreText: Frontline minions drew the fire of parapet archers.

title: Underdeeps Denizen
gameText: While this minion is at an underground site, it cannot take wounds.
loreText: There was a crash on the door, followed by crash after crash... How many there were the Company could not count.

title: Unforgiving Depths
gameText:
While you can spot 3 underground sites, each orc Orc gains muster.
Shadow: Discard this condition from play and spot an orc minion to replace the fellowships current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.

title: Whatever Means
gameText: Make an <symbol>orc</symbol> Orc strength +2 (or +6 if you remove 2 burdens).
loreText: The besiegers believed not that the flames would burn the city walls, but the souls of those behind them.

title: Bitter Tidings
gameText:
If Théoden is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Théodred to prevent that.
If Théodred is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Éowyn to prevent that.
loreText: Théodred my son is slain.'

title: Éomer
subtitle: Heir to Meduseld
gameText:
While Éomer bears a mount, he is damage +1.
While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +1 for each other rohan companion you can spot.
loreText: I have no child. Théodred my son is slain. I name Éomer my sister-son to be my heir.'

title: Éowyn
subtitle: Restless Warrior
gameText:
Each possession you play on Éowyn during the fellowship phase is twilight cost 1.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reinforce a rohan token (or reinforce 2rohan tokens if you can spot Éomer or Théoden).
loreText: Let her be as lord to the Eorlingas, while we are gone.'

title: Ferthu Théoden Hal
gameText:
To play, spot 2 rohan Men.
Unless you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, discard a possession from play.
loreText: Receive now this cup and drink in happy hour.'

title: Firefoot
subtitle: Mearas of The Mark
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
When you play Firefoot, you may reinforce a rohan token.
At the start of the maneuver phase, if bearer is Éomer, you may remove 2 rohan tokens to make him defender +1 and strength +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Freely Across Our Land
gameText:
When you play this, add a rohan token here.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to play a rohan possession from your discard pile on your rohan companion.
loreText: Unchecked, unchallenged, killing at will!

title: Háma
subtitle: Captain of the King's Guard
gameText:
Háma is strength +1 for each Shadow possession you can spot.
Each time Háma wins a skirmish, you may discard a possession from play.
loreText: Do not hope too much! These are dark days.'

title: Hamstrung
gameText: Make a <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved twice this turn).
loreText: Spears and arrows from Rohan brought down the mighty Mûmakil.

title: Hurried Barrows
gameText:
You may remove from the game 4 other rohan cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your mounted rohan companion strength +3.
loreText: The fallen sleep with honor.

title: King's Board
gameText:
Skirmish: Exert Éomer to make Éowyn or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to make Éomer or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Théoden to make Éomer or Éowyn strength +2.
loreText: Also wakened in Edoras was hospitality.

title: Merchant of Westfold
gameText: Each time the fellowship moves, you may add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> and remove a Free Peoples culture token to reinforce a <symbol>rohan</symbol> token.
loreText: Villagers from the surrounding farmlands fled to Helm's Deep seeking safety.

title: Riddermark Tactician
gameText:
When you play this, you may reinforce a rohan token.
Each time a Shadow player replaces the fellowships current site, you may spot another rohan Man to make, until the regroup phase, the fellowship archery total +2 and the minion archery total 2.

title: Ride With Me
gameText: Make your <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion strength +2 (or exert Théoden to make that companion strength +5 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword> instead.)
loreText: Maybe we shall cleave a road, or make such an end as will be worth a song  if any be left to sing of us hereafter.'

title: Rider's Bow
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.
loreText: Riders of the Mark carried short bows easily fired from horseback.

title: Snowmane
subtitle: Noble Mearas
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
When you play Snowmane, you may reinforce a rohan token.
Skirmish: If bearer is Théoden, you may remove 2 rohan tokens to exhaust a minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: Where now the horse and the rider?'

title: Théoden
subtitle: The Renowned
gameText:
While you can spot Éowyn, Théoden is defender +1.
While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1.
While you can spot Théodred, the move limit is +1.
loreText: Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!'

title: Théodred
subtitle: Second Marshal of the Mark
gameText:
While you can spot a rohan Man who has resistance of 7 or more, Théodred is twilight cost 1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Théodred, you may exert each minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: The son of Théoden defended Rohan at the Fords of Isen.

title: Wind-swept Homestead
gameText:
To play, spot 2 rohan companions.
When you play this, add a rohan token here for each plains site and each battleground site on the adventure path.
At the start of each regroup phase, add a rohan token here for each of your companions that has muster.

title: Sauron
subtitle: Dark Lord of Mordor
gameText:
Damage +1. Fierce.
When you play Sauron, you may exert any number of minions. For each minion you exert, Sauron is twilight cost X, where X is the current region number.
loreText: ...the Shadow grows once more....'

title: Sceptre of the Dark Lord
gameText:
Bearer must be Sauron.
He is damage +1.
Each time Sauron wins a skirmish and the companion he is skirmishing is not killed, you may assign X wounds to other companions, where X is the current region number.

title: Bilbo
subtitle: Aged Ring-bearer
gameText:
Ring-bound.
While Bilbo is not assigned to a skirmish, each Ring-bound Hobbit is strength +1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may remove a burden for each other Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
loreText: ...I am quite ready to go on another journey....'

title: Bill the Pony
subtitle: Dearly-loved
gameText:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
When you play Bill the Pony, you may reinforce a shire token.
Regroup: Spot 2 minions and remove 2 shire tokens to make a Shadow player discard a minion from play.
loreText: Sam would not go to bed until he had visited Bill....

title: Daddy Twofoot
subtitle: Next-door Neighbor
gameText:
Aid  Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may take a shire event into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: That's a dark bad place, if half the tales be true.'

title: Don't Let Go
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this condition to make a Hobbit strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is participating in a fierce skirmish; he or she has resistance 7 or more; he or she is at a dwelling site; you can spot an unwounded Hobbit.
loreText: Don't you give up on me Mr. Frodo!'

title: Everything but My Bones
gameText:
You may remove from the game 4 other shire cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your Hobbit at a dwelling or forest site strength +3.
loreText: ...I'll carry Mr. Frodo up myself....'

title: Faith in Friendship
gameText:
When you play this, add a shire token here.
At the start of the regoup phase, you may discard this from play or remove a token from here to heal a shire companion.
loreText: I'm going to take care of you.

title: Fates Entwined
gameText: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may heal another Hobbit once (or heal another Hobbit twice if the Hobbit that won the skirmish was Frodo or Bilbo).
loreText: Yes, I am coming... The Ring-bearers should go together.'

title: Frodo
subtitle: Frenzied Fighter
gameText:
Ring-bound.
While you can spot more minions than companions, Frodo cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
Skirmish: If Frodo is not assigned to a skirmish, exert Frodo to have him replace a Ring-bound companion skirmishing a minion.

title: Frodo Gamgee
subtitle: Son of Samwise
gameText:
Aid  Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot a Ring-bound Hobbit.
Bearer is strength +1 for each Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
loreText: ...Rose and me had settled to call him Frodo, with your leave...'

title: The Gaffer
subtitle: Master Gardener
gameText:
Aid  Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
When you transfer The Gaffer to a shire companion, heal bearer (or heal bearer twice if he or she is at a dwelling site.)
loreText: ...the Gaffer was recognized as the leading authority....

title: Humble Homestead
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
When you play this, add a shire token here for each forest site and each dwelling site on the adventure path.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 3 tokens from here to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit.

title: Mithril-coat
subtitle: Dwarf-mail
gameText:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make each minion he is skirmishing lose fierce and unable to gain fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...cold as ice, and harder than steel.'

title: New Chapter
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time you play a follower, you may heal a companion (or heal Sam twice).
loreText: And so it was settled. Sam Gamgee married Rosie Cotton in the spring of 1420....

title: Phial of Galadriel
subtitle: The Light of Eärendil
gameText:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
While bearer is in region 1, bearer gains muster.
While bearer is in region 2, each of your shire companions gains muster.
While bearer is in region 3, each character gains muster.

title: Sam
subtitle: Bearer of Great Need
gameText:
Ring-bound.
Sam is resistance +1 for each Hobbit you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Sam and transfer a follower he is bearing to your support area to discard a minion from play.
loreText: ...the last of all the Company. The errand must not fail.'

title: Westfarthing Businessman
gameText: This companion is strength +1 for each <symbol>shire</symbol> card that has a culture token on it.
loreText: There's a tidy bit of money tucked away up there, I hear tell....'

title: Assault Commander
gameText:
Damage +1.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to make an unbound companion resistance 1 for each card that has the same card title as that condition.
loreText: Fear is a potent weapon in the hands of an Uruk-hai.

title: Assault Denizen
gameText:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture token you can spot.
loreText: Theories and tactics of warfare were tested upon the battlefields of Middle-earth.

title: Cavern Denizen
gameText:
Damage +1.
While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.
loreText: Saruman uses the enemy's strength to his own advantage.

title: Endless Assault
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this condition to make an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a battleground site; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; it is bearing a possession; you can spot an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion not assigned to a skirmish.

title: Enemy Without Number
gameText:
To play, spot 2 urukhai minions.
Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to add twilight1.
Regroup: Spot an urukhai minion and discard this condition from play to add twilight3.
loreText: Valour could not prevent the breach of the Deeping Wall.

title: Entranced Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Possessions borne by this minion cannot be discarded by Free Peoples cards.
loreText: An Uruk is disarmed only when it hurls its weapon.

title: Fearless Approach
gameText:
To play, spot an urukhai minion.
When you play this, if you spot a battleground site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 urukhai tokens.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowships next site, you may discard a condition from play.

title: Isengard Infiltrator
gameText:
Damage +1.
While the fellowship is at a forest site, the fellowship archery total is 1.
Each elven companion skirmishing this minion is strength 2.
loreText: The Uruk-hai trained to engage the enemy in its own territory.

title: New Enemy
gameText:
You may remove from the game 4 urukhai cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your urukhai minion skirmishing a companion with resistance 4 or less strength +2.
loreText: ...goblin-soldiers of greater stature.

title: Signs of War
gameText: While you can spot 3 <symbol>urukhai</symbol> lurker minions, at the start of each skirmish involving an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> lurker minion, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.
loreText: Horsemen were galloping on the grass of Rohan; wolves poured from Isengard.

title: Uruk Aggressor
gameText:
Damage +1.
When you play this, you may spot a companion who has resistance 0 to make this minion twilight cost 2.
loreText: The defenses of the Hornburg were exploited, exposing their weakest points.

title: Uruk Blitz
gameText:
To play, spot an urukhai minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, each Uruk-hai is damage +1.
While the fellowship is in region 2, each companion is strength 1.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each unbound companion is resistance 2.

title: Uruk Distractor
gameText:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a companion skirmishing another urukhai minion.
loreText: Wounds do not always remove the Uruk-hai from their assault.

title: Uruk Invader
gameText:
Damage +1.
This minion is twilight cost 1 for each companion who has resistance 2 or less.
loreText: To sense weakness is to assume victory.

title: Uruk Outrider
gameText: This minion is <keyword>damage +1</keyword> for each character in the dead pile.
loreText: The lesser the enemy, the greater the rage.

title: Uruk Reserve
gameText:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time your urukhai minion is about to be killed in a skirmish, you may place that minion on the bottom of your draw deck instead.

title: Uruk Rogue
gameText:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: If no other minions are assigned to a skirmish, you may exert this minion twice to make it fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Some minions prefer to fight alone.

title: Uruk Tactician
gameText:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a companion skirmishing an urukhai lurker minion strength 2.
loreText: Select warriors had been tasked with advancing the assault beyond the Deeping Wall.

title: War Machine
gameText: Exert your <symbol>urukhai</symbol> lurker minion to play an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> hand weapon from your discard pile on your <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion.
loreText: ...on the front of their iron helms was set an S-rune, wrought of some white metal.

title: Weapons of Control
gameText:
When you play this, add an urukhai token here for each wounded companion.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a companion skirmishing an urukhai minion strength 1.

title: Dark Fell About Him
gameText:
To play, exert your Nazgûl twice and spot an exhausted companion.
Heal that companion to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on that companion.
loreText: Men cast from the saddle lay grovelling on the ground.

title: From Hideous Eyrie
gameText: You may remove from the game 4 <symbol>wraith</symbol> cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your Nazgûl in a fierce skirmish strength +2.
loreText: Down, down it came, and then, folding its fingered webs, it gave a croaking cry....

title: Shadow in the East
gameText:
Toil 1. (For each wraith character you exert when playing this, it is twilight cost 1.)
To play, spot a wraith card in your support area. Spot a companion to draw a card for each wound on that companion (and draw an additional card if you can spot a Nazgûl).
loreText: ...it is called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery.'

title: They Came From Mordor
gameText:
When you play this, you may add a wraith token here for each wraith card in your support area.
Shadow: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to play a wraith mount from your draw deck on your wraith minion.
loreText: That is the worst news that has come to Bree....'

title: Úlairë Enquëa
subtitle: Sixth of the Nine Riders
gameText:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Enquëa, if you can spot 2 other Nazgûl, you may exert 2 unbound companions (or exert each companion if you can spot 6 companions).
loreText: It is many a year since the Nine walked abroad.'

title: Úlairë Lemenya
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow
gameText:
Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Úlairë Lemenya and discard a Nazgûl from your hand to discard a condition from play.
loreText: As the Shadow grows once more, they too may walk again.'

title: Úlairë Nertëa
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow
gameText:
Fierce.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, Úlairë Nertëa is twilight cost 2.
loreText: From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffling to catch an elusive scent....

title: Abandoned Mine Shaft
gameText: <keyword>Underground.</keyword> If this site is not in region 1 when the fellowship moves from here during the regroup phase, add a burden.

title: Caves of Aglarond
gameText: <keyword>Underground.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may remove 2 burdens.

title: City of Kings
gameText: <keyword>Battleground.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may draw a card.

title: Courtyard Parapet
gameText: <keyword>Dwelling.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site, the first Shadow player may discard 2 cards from hand to add a burden.

title: Crossroads of the Fallen Kings
gameText: <keyword>Forest.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may heal a companion of each culture.

title: Doors of Durin
gameText: <keyword>Marsh.</keyword> Each companion of a race that has the most companions is strength 1 until the regroup phase.

title: Fords of Isen
gameText: <keyword>River.</keyword> Each character is strength +1 for each card borne by that character.

title: The Great Gates
gameText: <keyword>Battleground.</keyword> While a player can spot more companions than minions, each minion is strength +1.

title: Isenwash
gameText: <keyword>Battleground. Plains.</keyword> At the start of the regroup phase, each Shadow player may exert a minion to exert a companion.

title: Redhorn Pass
gameText: <keyword>Mountain.</keyword> Culture tokens cannot be added, removed, or reinforced.

title: Celeborn
subtitle: The Wise
gameText:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each Elf who has resistance 7 or more gains muster.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may take an elven event into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: I did not know that your plight was so evil.'

title: Galadriel
subtitle: Sorceress of the Hidden Land
gameText:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reveal a card from the top of your draw deck for each forest on the adventure path to heal an Elf for each elven card revealed.
loreText: Do not let your hearts be troubled....'

title: Legolas
subtitle: Of the Grey Company
gameText:
Archer.
At the start of each archery phase, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an elven card, wound a minion.
loreText: My heart bids me go on... but we must hold together. I will follow your counsel.'

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Bearer of Obligation
gameText: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 <symbol>gandalf</symbol> cards from hand.
loreText: But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care.'

title: Pallando
subtitle: Far-travelling One
gameText:
Aid  twilight2.
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a gandalf companion, exert bearer twice. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.
loreText: Brought as a companion by Alatar, he traveled the South and East to aid the Free Peoples.

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Isildur's Heir
gameText:
Aragorn is strength +1 for each gondor card that has a culture token on it.
At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Thus came Aragorn, son of Arathorn, Elessar....

title: Denethor
subtitle: Last Ruling Steward
gameText:
Denethor is resistance +1 for each gondor possession in your discard pile.
Maneuver: Spot a gondor possession borne by a companion and remove that posssession from the game to exert a minion twice.
loreText: ...he took up the staff of his Stewardship that lay at his feet and broke it on his knee.

title: Éomer
subtitle: Heir to Meduseld
gameText:
While Éomer bears a mount, he is damage +1.
While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +1 for each other rohan companion you can spot.
loreText: I have no child. Théodred my son is slain. I name Éomer my sister-son to be my heir.'

title: Théoden
subtitle: The Renowned
gameText:
While you can spot Éowyn, Théoden is defender +1.
While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1.
While you can spot Théodred, the move limit is +1.
loreText: Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!'

title: Dain Ironfoot
subtitle: King Under the Mountain
gameText:
Each of your other Dwarves and gandalf Men is twilight cost 1.
At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a dwarven or gandalf condition from play to discard a minion from play.
loreText: The time of my thought is my own to spend.'

title: Elladan
subtitle: Son of Elrond
gameText:
Elrohir is twilight cost 2.
Each time you play an elven event during a skirmish involving Elladan or Elrohir, that event is twilight cost 2.
loreText: The Lady Celebrían bore Elrond two sons, the identical twins Elladan and Elrohir; elder brothers ofArwen, and grandchildren of Galadriel.

title: Elrohir
subtitle: Son of Elrond
gameText:
Elladan is twilight cost 2.
Each time you play an elven event during a skirmish involving Elrohir or Elladan, each minion in that skirmish is strength 2.
loreText: From the North we came with this purpose, and from Elrond our father we brought this very counsel. We will not turn back.'

title: Gildor Inglorion
subtitle: Of the House of Finrod
gameText: At the start of each archery phase, if you can spot more minions than companions, each of your companions is an <keyword>archer</keyword>.
loreText: Elves seldom give unguarded advice, for advice is a dangerous gift, even from the wise to the wise, and all courses may run ill.'

title: Brand
subtitle: King of Dale
gameText:
Each of your Dwarves and other gandalf Men is strength +1.
While you can spot more minions than companions, the fellowship archery total is +X, where X is the number of minions minus the number of companions.
loreText: ...he had the aid of the Dwarves of Erebor.

title: Grimbeorn
subtitle: Beorning Chieftain
gameText:
At the start of each turn, heal Grimbeorn.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert Grimbeorn twice and discard a minion from hand to make Grimbeorn strength +X until the regroup phase, where X is that minions strength.
loreText: He was perhaps a shape-shifter like his father.

title: Duilin
subtitle: Ranger From Blackroot Vale
gameText:
Ranger.
While the fellowship is at a forest or river site, Duilin is strength +3.
loreText: To Minas Tirith Duinhir brought both of his sons, Derufin and Duilin, to defend the Free Peoples of Middle-earth.

title: Duinhir
subtitle: Tall Man of Blackroot Vale
gameText:
While you can spot a mount, Duinhir is damage +1.
Each time Duinhir wins a skirmish, if you can spot more minions than companions, you may exert him to discard a minion that has strength 7 or less.
loreText: The garrison at Osgiliath fought valiantly.

title: Halbarad
subtitle: Ranger of the North
gameText:
Ranger.
While the Ring-bearer has resistance 9 or more, Halbarads twilight cost is 1.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may discard a gondor card from hand to heal a gondor companion.
loreText: He was tall, a dark standing shadow.

title: Furious Hillman
gameText: <keyword>Response:</keyword> If the Free Peoples player plays an event, spot another <symbol>men</symbol> Man and discard this minion from play to cancel that event.
loreText: No village pitchfork could provide defense against the rages of the Wild Men.

title: Swarming Hillman
gameText: At the start of the regroup phase, if you can spot more Man characters than any other race, make the move limit 1 this turn.
loreText: Roving in mindless mobs, the Dunlendings destroyed many Rohirrim homesteads.

title: Half-troll of Far Harad
gameText: At the start of each assignment phase, if you can spot more companions than minions, you may remove <symbol>twilight2</symbol> to play an <symbol>orc</symbol> Orc from your discard pile.
loreText: ...bred for battle in the southern reaches ofHaradwaith....

title: Horror of Harad
gameText: <keyword>Ambush</keyword> <symbol>twilight1</symbol><keyword>. Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. Muster. Toil 2.</keyword>
loreText: The troll-men sprinted on to the Pelennor to bathe their blades in the blood of the enemy.

title: Uruk-hai Healer
gameText:
Damage +1.
At the start of each assignment phase, you may heal an Uruk-hai for each companion you can spot.
loreText: Restoratives were in short supply within the ranks of the White Hand.

title: Uruk-hai Scout
gameText:
Damage +1.
When you play this, choose one of the following keywords: battleground, mountain, plains, or underground. The fellowships current site gains that keyword until the end of the turn.
loreText: ...swart, slant-eyed, with thick legs and large hands.

title: The One Ring
subtitle: The Ring of Doom
gameText:
While wearing The One Ring, the Ringbearer gains hunter 3, and each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...the earth shook, the plain heaved and cracked, and Orodruin reeled.

title: The One Ring
subtitle: The Ruling Ring
gameText:
Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
loreText: One Ring to rule them all....

title: Chamber of Records
gameText:
When you play this, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 dwarven tokens here.
Fellowship: Discard this from play or remove a dwarven token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a dwarven card, take it into your hand, otherwise, place it in your discard pile.

title: The Fortunes of Balin's Folk
gameText: Exert a Dwarf to shuffle a <symbol>dwarven</symbol> condition with one or more <symbol>dwarven</symbol> tokens on it into your draw deck. Wound a minion for each <symbol>dwarven</symbol> token that was on that condition.
loreText: It is grim reading...'

title: Gimli
subtitle: Eager Hunter
gameText: Damage +1. Hunter 3 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)
loreText: Well, after them!' said Gimli. Dwarves too can go swiftly...'

title: Glóin
subtitle: Son of Gróin
gameText:
Each time Glóin wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards, then place 3 cards from your hand beneath your draw deck in any order.
Skirmish: Remove a dwarven token to make Glóin strength +2.

title: Heavy Axe
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
This is twilight cost -1 for each dwarven card that has a culture token on it.
Skirmish: Remove a dwarven token to make bearer strength +1.
loreText: Dwarven smiths created weaponry of all sizes and styles.

title: Sturdy Stock
gameText: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or if you can spot a hunter minion, strength +1 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword> for each hunter minion you can spot).
loreText: Dwarves have a knack for surviving misfortune.

title: Well-crafted Armor
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time bearer takes a wound, you may reinforce a dwarven token.
Skirmish: Discard a dwarven card from hand to make bearer damage +1.
loreText: Dwarven armor is among the strongest crafted in Middle-earth.

title: Whatever End
gameText:
Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter gondor companion or hunter elven companion damage +1 until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a dwarven companion strength +2.
loreText: I will go with you even on the Paths of the Dead...'

title: Arwen
subtitle: She-Elf
gameText:
While you can spot Aragorn, Arwen is strength +1 and resistance +2.
Skirmish: Remove an elven token to make a minion skirmishing Arwen strength -2.
loreText: I do not fear them.

title: Dínendal
subtitle: Mirkwood Archer
gameText:
Aid  twilight3. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight3 to transfer this to a companion.).
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except an elven companion, exert bearer.
Bearer is an archer.
loreText: Elven archers were seldom seen before it was too late.

title: Elven Bow
gameText:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Bearer is an archer.
loreText: No finer bows could defend Helm's Deep than those of the Golden Wood.

title: Elven Warrior
gameText:
While this companion is bearing a possession, he is strength +2.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to place an elven card from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck.
loreText: Elven warriors used their strength and wisdom equally in battle.

title: Focus
gameText:
Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a hunter dwarven Dwarf or hunter gondor Man.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an elven Elf strength +2.
loreText: ...not even my eyes can see him, my good Legolas...'

title: Gift of the Evenstar
subtitle: Blessed Light
gameText:
Each time an Elf wins a skirmish, you may exert that Elf or Aragorn to place an elven token here.
At the start of each maneuver phase, you may remove an elven token here to draw a card.

title: Haldir
subtitle: Sentry of the Golden Wood
gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2.
While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.
loreText: ...since you come with an Elf of our kindred, we are willing to befirend you, as Elrond asked...'

title: Legolas
subtitle: Fleet-footed Hunter
gameText:
Hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).
Regroup: Exert 2 hunter companions to draw a card.
loreText: We have already overtaken some of those that we are hunting...'

title: Legolas
subtitle: Of the Woodland Realm
gameText:
Archer. Hunter 1(While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).
Archery: Exert Legolas to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each hunter minion you can spot.(Limit +3)
loreText: You would die before your stroke fell!

title: Lórien's Blessing
gameText: Spot an <symbol>elven</symbol> follower to make the minion archery total -3.
loreText: We have drunk the cup of parting...and the shadows fall between us.'

title: Mighty Shot
gameText: Spot an Elf to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each minion with twilight cost of 2 or less that you can spot.
loreText: But who can say what it hit?'

title: The Mirror of Galadriel
subtitle: Dangerous Guide
gameText:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time you are about to draw a card, you may exert an Elf to look at the top three cards of your draw deck instead. Take a Free Peoples card into your hand and place the other cards on the bottom of your draw deck.

title: Point Blank Range
gameText: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot 3 archers).
loreText: How many there were the company could not count.

title: Spied From Afar
gameText:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
While you can spot an elven follower, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an elven companion strength +1 for each archer companion you can spot.

title: Sword of the Fallen
gameText:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1 for each wound on that minion.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to exert a minion skirmishing bearer.
loreText: Elven weapons remain in use for centuries.

title: Uruviel
subtitle: Woodland Maid
gameText:
Aid  twilight1. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight1 to transfer this to a companion.).
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may exert an Elf to make the fellowships current site a forest until the end of the turn.

title: Be Gone!
gameText: <keyword>Spell</keyword>. Exert your <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion X times to make a minion strength -2 until the regroup phase, for each time that <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion exerted.
loreText: You did not kill me, you will not kill him!

title: Ent Avenger
gameText: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.
loreText: As they drew near the flash and flicker of their eyes could be seen.

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Powerful Guide
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time you play a spell, you may add a burden to wound a minion.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, you may draw a card and then discard a card from your hand.
loreText: Let the Ring-bearer decide.

title: Leaflock
subtitle: Finglas
gameText:
Leaflocks twilight cost is -1 for each Ent you can spot.
While you can spot 3 other Ents, Leaflock is strength +4.
loreText: When roused to action, little could stop the destructive power of the Ents.

title: Mellon!
gameText:
To play, spot 2 gandalf companions.
At the start of the maneuver phase, discard this condition to make each player count the number of cards in his or her hand, discard each of them and draw the same number of cards from the top of his or her draw deck.

title: Momentous Gathering
gameText: Choose one: spot an Ent to take a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion into hand from your draw deck; or spot 2 Ents to take a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion and a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> condition into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
loreText: ...I have managed to make a fair number promise to come.'

title: One Last Surprise
gameText: <keyword>Spell</keyword>. Spot Gandalf and an unbound companion skirmishing a minion to use Gandalfs resistance to resolve that skirmish instead of that companions strength.
loreText: The dragon passed like an express train...and burst over Bywater with a deafening explosion.

title: Quickbeam
subtitle: Hastiest of All Ents
gameText:
Quickbeam is twilight cost -1 for each Ent you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this companion to place another gandalf companion from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck and reinforce a gandalf token.
loreText: A punch from an Ent-fist crumples up iron...'

title: Shadow of the Wood
gameText:
This companion is twilight cost -1 for each gandalf companion you can spot.
Fellowship: Place this companion in the dead pile to remove twilight5.
loreText: Treebeard's call to the Ent Moot could not be refused.

title: Shepherd of the Trees
gameText:
While you can spot 4 Ents, this companion is strength +3.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a gandalf character, you may play it.
loreText: Ents rarely interacted with Men, but Saruman's devilry demanded action.

title: Skinbark
subtitle: Elder Ent
gameText:
Skinbark is twilight cost -1 for each gandalf condition you can spot.
Each time Skinbark wins a skirmish, you may place a gandalf card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
loreText: ...a man that hacks once at an Ent never gets the chance of a second blow.'

title: Treebeard
subtitle: Enraged Shepherd
gameText:
To play, spot 3 gandalf companions.
Each time Treebeard wins a skirmish, the first Shadow player must exert X minions, where X is the difference between Treebeards strength and the losing characters strength.
loreText: My business is with Isengard tonight.

title: Called to Mordor
gameText:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each time an opponent uses a skirmish special ability in a skirmish involving Gollum or Sméagol, you may wound a minion.
loreText: It won't be long now. He will soon be ready.

title: Connected By Fate
gameText:
To play, spot Sméagol.
While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each Shadow event is twilight cost +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make each Ring-bound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: Thief, thief! Baggins! We hates it for ever!

title: Controlled By The Ring
gameText:
Bearer must be Gollum.
Skirmish: If Gollum is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him replace a minion skirmishing a companion.
loreText: Gollum's appetite for the One Ring could not be quenched.

title: Desperate Move
gameText: Discard a <symbol>gollum</symbol> minion from play to discard a companion. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit 1 this turn to prevent that.
loreText: He leaped into the waters, but the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam...'

title: Gollum
subtitle: Hopeless
gameText: At the start of each skirmish involving Gollum, he is strength +X until the end of that skirmish, where X is the Ring-bearers strength.
loreText: Give it to us raw and wriggling!

title: Herbs and Stewed Rabbit
gameText:
While you can spot Frodo, Sméagol is resistance +1.
While you can spot Sam, Sméagol is strength +1.
While you can spot Bilbo, Sméagol is damage +1.
loreText: Eat them, Eat them!'

title: Hurry Hobbitses
gameText: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
loreText: Very lucky we find you.

title: Nice Fish
gameText:
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, place a gollum token here.
Regroup: Heal a Ring-bound companion for each gollum token here. Discard this condition.
loreText: Bring fish with you. Come!'

title: Not This Time!
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert Gollum and remove a threat to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing.
loreText: Got away, did it, Precious!

title: Release Them
gameText:
Spot Sméagol to prevent a Ring-bound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
While this card is in your discard pile, Sméagol is resistance +1.
loreText: If you let them go, your life will be forfeit.

title: Sméagol
subtitle: Wretched and Hungry
gameText:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each Ring-bound companion is resistance +1.
Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Hobbits to make Sméagol strength +1 and prevent him from being overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
loreText: ...this creature is in some way bound up with my errand.'

title: Something Slimy
gameText: Spot Sméagol to play a condition from your draw deck. If that condition was a <symbol>gollum</symbol> condition, you may make an opponent place a random card from his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.
loreText: What he was chewing, they did not ask or like to think.

title: Sudden Strike
gameText: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to play a minion from your draw deck. If that minion is a <symbol>gollum</symbol> minion, you may also play a Shadow possession or Shadow condition from your draw deck.
loreText: ...she drove her huge bulk down on him again.

title: Swear by the Precious
gameText: Spot Frodo and Sméagol to discard a minion. That minions owner may make each minion strength 2 until the end of the turn to prevent that.
loreText: 'I will serve the master of the Precious.'

title: Unseen Foe
gameText: Discard a <symbol>gollum</symbol> minion from play to wound each companion with strength 8 or more.
loreText: ...all the while he hissed, but spoke no words.

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Swift Hunter
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a hunter companion strength +1.
loreText: Ride out with me. Ride out and meet them.

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Thorongil
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
Maneuver: Add a threat to exert a non-hunter minion with strength less than Aragorn's.
loreText: I will follow the Orcs...'

title: Aragorn's Bow
subtitle: Ranger's Longbow
gameText:
Bearer must be Aragorn.
He is an archer.
Archery: Add a threat to wound a minion with the lowest strength.
loreText: The bow can reach what the sword cannot.

title: Damrod
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add twilight1 to heal a ranger.
loreText: Curse the Southrons!'

title: Decorated Barricade
gameText:
Fortification. This condition is twilight cost -1 for each gondor ranger you spot.
Skirmish: Exert 2 gondor Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a gondor Man.
loreText: In times of war, the beauty of the walls matters little.

title: Dúnedain of the South
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may make a gondor ranger strength +2 until the regroup phase.
loreText: We come to ambush the Men of Harad.'

title: Forth the Three Hunters!
gameText:
Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters).
Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).

title: Gondorian Prowler
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
When this companion is in your starting fellowship, he is twilight cost 1.
Skirmish: Remove a gondor token or exert a gondor Man to make the site number of a minion +2.
loreText: Rangers use all five senses to hunt their prey.

title: Ithilien Blade
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1.
Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to discard a roaming minion.
loreText: Most Rangers of Ithilien carried spears, bows, and swords while marching.

title: Mablung
subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert Mablung to wound a roaming minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: We come to teach them another lesson.'

title: Madril
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
While you can spot 2 gondor rangers, Madril is twilight cost 2.
At the start of the Maneuver phase, each minion is site number +1 for each threat you can spot until the start of the regroup phase.
loreText: For that is the ruin of Osgiliath...'

title: No Quicker Path
gameText:
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter dwarven companion or hunter elven companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a gondor Man strength +2.
loreText: ...we no longer need any trail to tell us which way...'

title: No Travellers In This Land
gameText: Exert a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man to wound a minion (or wound that minion twice if it is a hunter).
loreText: ...only the servants of the Dark Tower, or of the White.'

title: Portico
gameText:
Fortification. This condition is twilight cost -1 for each gondor ranger you spot.
Skirmish: Exert a gondor Man or spot 2 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a gondor Man.
loreText: The doors of Minas Tirith were meant to keep out more than Orcs.

title: Ranger's Cloak
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
While bearer is a ranger or at a forest site, each minion skirmishing bearer is site number +2.
Skirmish: Add a threat or exert bearer to make a minion skirmishing a gondor Man site number +2.

title: Silent Traveler
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
At the start of each skirmish involving this companion and a roaming minion, you may reinforce a gondor token.
loreText: We have not found what we sought...'

title: Tremendous Wall
gameText:
Fortification. Characters skirmishing bearer cannot take wounds from losing a skirmish involving bearer.
Skirmish: Exert a gondor Man or spot 3 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a gondor Man.

title: Unyielding Ranger
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This companion is strength +1 for each roaming minion you can spot.
loreText: Their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes...

title: Bill Ferny
subtitle: Agent of Saruman
gameText:
If Bill Ferny is unwounded, the Free Peoples player cannot assign him to skirmish a companion.
Shadow: Exert Bill Ferny twice and spot a site you control to add twilight2.
loreText: ...he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'

title: Bold Easterling
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a <symbol>men</symbol> minion from your discard pile. That minion is <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
loreText: They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien.'

title: Chieftain of Dunland
gameText:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove twilight2 to make a men Man strength +2.
Skirmish: Spot 2 sites you control and remove twilight2 to make a men Man strength +3.
Skirmish: Spot 3 sites you control and remove twilight2 to make a men Man strength +4.

title: Courageous Easterling
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a <symbol>men</symbol> minion from your discard pile. That minion is <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
loreText: Easterlings came to Mordor to aid Sauron in his final assualt.

title: Destroyed Homestead
gameText: When you play this, spot 2 <symbol>men</symbol> Men to randomly reveal a site from the Free Peoples players adventure deck. Note its cardtitle. Each site on the adventure path with the same card title as the selected site loses its gametext.
loreText: Destruction sometimes brings new opportunities.

title: Easterling Scout
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a <symbol>men</symbol> minion from your discard pile. That minion is <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
loreText: In battle, Easterlings surprise their foes with a great number of different techniques.

title: Engrossed Hillman
gameText: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot another <symbol>men</symbol> Man and 8 characters (or if you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures), you may take control of a site
loreText: Years of anger have a tendency to bring focus to one's rage.

title: Enraged Herdsman
gameText: While you can spot more companions than minions, each <symbol>men</symbol> hunter is strength +2 and is an <keyword>archer</keyword>.
loreText: Dunlendings don't mind being outnumbered in battle.

title: Great Axe
gameText:
Bearer must be a men Man.
While bearer is skirmishing a hunter companion, bearer is strength +2.
loreText: To his surprise, Frodo's cloak served as an effective camoflague among the rocks.

title: Grieving the Fallen
gameText:
To play, spot a men Man.
Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
Bearer cannot take wounds during the archery phase. At the start of the regroup phase, discard this condition.
loreText: Mordor will pay for this!

title: Grousing Hillman
gameText: While you control a site, this minion is strength +3 and <keyword>fierce</keyword>.
loreText: Acquiring more territories only increases the rage of the Dunlendings.

title: Hunting Herdsman
gameText:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This minion is strength +3 for each follower you can spot.
loreText: Hunters are valuable members of Dunlending tribes.

title: Last Gasp
gameText: Wound 3 <symbol>men</symbol> archers to exhaust a companion.
loreText: Southron archers know that they must press through their exhaustion to win the battle.

title: Lying Counsel
gameText: Exert your <symbol>men</symbol> Man and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owners hand. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to discard those cards instead.
loreText: Let your counsellor Gríma keep all things...'

title: Mûmak Commander
subtitle: Giant Among the Swertings
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Exert Mûmak Commander twice to exert a companion twice (except the Ring-bearer).
loreText: ...high upon his neck still desperately clung a tiny figurethe body of a mighty warrior...

title: Primitive Savage
gameText:
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if he bears a hand weapon, you may take control of a site.
loreText: The only thing scarier than a Wild Man is a Wild Man with an axe.

title: Pursuing Horde
gameText:
To play, spot a men Man.
Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per companion.
Each time the fellowship moves, add twilight1.
loreText: Once the Dunlendings track their enemy they will not lose their trail.

title: Rapid Reload
gameText:
While you can spot a men Man, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site in the current region.
Archery: Spot a men Man and remove twilight3 to exert an unbound companion.
loreText: The Men of Harad kept a large supply of arrows at hand.

title: Rapt Hillman
gameText:
At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may liberate a site. You may spot 3 Men to prevent this.
Maneuver: Spot another men Man and exert this minion to take control of a site.
loreText: Dunlendings take delight in destruction.

title: Ravaging Wild Man
gameText:
While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 men Men to discard a follower.
loreText: No villager is safe when the Wild Men attack.

title: Savage Southron
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> If the Free Peoples player has at least 1 site in his or her adventure deck, exert 2 <symbol>men</symbol> Men to randomly choose a site from that deck. Replace the fellowships current site with that site.
loreText: The Southrons are skilled at fighting in many different kinds of terrain.

title: Swarthy Hillman
gameText: While you control a site, this minion is an <keyword>archer</keyword>.
loreText: The Wild Men will defend their territories at all costs.

title: Wandering Hillman
gameText:
To play, spot a men Man.
While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3.
Maneuver: Remove 2 burdens or 2 threats to control a site.
loreText: The Hillmen are always searching for lands to conquer.

title: Battlefield Recruit
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this minion to make a minion strength +2.
loreText: Grond! Grond! Grond!

title: Battlefield Veteran
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this minion to make a minion strength +1.
loreText: Though he had seen it many times before, Grond's destructive power never ceased to amaze.

title: Beasts of Burden
gameText:
To play, spot 2 orc minions.
At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an orc condition from play to play an orc minion. It is twilight cost 2 (or 4 if you can spot 6 or more companions).
loreText: ...some great beast...would go mad and spread stamping ruin...

title: Black Gate Sentry
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
loreText: Very few tried to sneak into Mordor. Even fewer succeeded.

title: Black Land Chieftain
gameText:
To play, spot an orc minion.
When you play Black Land Chieftain, you may add a threat for each Free Peoples possession and each Free Peoples artifact you can spot.
loreText: Orcs frequently used the weapons of their fallen enemies as their own.

title: Black Land Commander
gameText:
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5.
Skirmish: Remove 2 threats to make a character skirmishing this minion strength 2.
loreText: ...do they just live on foul air and poison?'

title: Black Land Observer
gameText:
When you play this minion, you may spot an orc condition to add a threat.
While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3.
loreText: Orcs must always watch for attacks from their enemies...and from their own.

title: Black Land Overlord
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Remove a threat and spot another <symbol>orc</symbol> minion to exert an unbound companion.
loreText: Move on! To the Gate!

title: Black Land Runner
gameText:
To play, spot an orc Orc.
While you can spot more sites on the adventure path than minions, this minion is strength +5.
loreText: When commanded to, Orcs could travel great distances with great speed.

title: Black Land Shrieker
gameText:
To play, spot an orc condition.
Black Land Shrieker is twilight cost -1 for each threat you spot.
loreText: No sound from an Orc was more frightening.

title: Black Land Spy
gameText:
When you play this minion, you may spot an orc possession to add a threat.
While you can spot a companion of strength 13 or more, this minion is strength +7.
loreText: Frodo's quest could be undone with one glance.

title: Coordinated Effort
gameText:
To play, spot 2 orc minions.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession, add twilight2.
loreText: Breaking a Gondorian fortification is not easily done.

title: Desolation Orc
gameText: To play, spot 3 Free Peoples cultures or discard 2 <symbol>orc</symbol> conditions from play.
loreText: Neither Man nor beast can withstand the fury of the Orcs.

title: Destructive Orc
gameText: When you play Destructive Orc, you may discard a fortification for each <symbol>orc</symbol> possession and each <symbol>orc</symbol> artifact you can spot.
loreText: At Minas Tirith, some Orcs chose to attack the city before it's inhabitants.

title: Gorbag
subtitle: Filthy Rebel
gameText:
Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)
When you play Gorbag, you may discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples players deck for each hunter character you can spot.
loreText: I'm gonna bleed you...like a stuck pig!

title: Isengard Marauder
gameText:
To play, discard 3 cards from your hand.
While you can spot 2 other orc minions, this minion is fierce.
loreText: Wargs and riders sent by Saruman disrupted the villagers' retreat to Helm's Deep.

title: Moria Menace
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player shuffle his or her draw deck and reveal the top card of that draw deck. Make this minion strength +X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.
loreText: Orcs attacked in sunlight only when absolutely necessary.

title: Mountain-troll
gameText:
When you play this minion, you may discard 5 orc minions from play to make it twilight cost is 10 and it is fierce.
Shadow: Remove twilight3 to play an orc Orc from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is 2.
loreText: Thrice the great ram boomed. And suddenly on the last stroke the Gate of Gondor broke.

title: Orkish Camp
gameText:
While you can spot a orc Orc, the Free Peoples player cannot replace the fellowships current site.
Shadow: Exert an orc minion and remove twilight2 to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is an orc Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.

title: Orkish Hunting Spear
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc Orc.
Bearer gains hunter X (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +X.), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you can spot.
loreText: Orcs hunt for Men, ponies, and their own kind.

title: Pummeling Blow
gameText:
To play, exert an orc minion. Plays on the fellowships current site.
This site cannot be replaced. While the fellowship is at this site, each Troll is strength +1.
loreText: Where battering rams failed, Trolls did not.

title: Scouting Orc
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
loreText: ...it was of a small breed...with wide and snuffling nostrils: evidently a tracker of some kind.

title: Tower Troll
gameText:
For each companion over 5, this minion is damage +1.
Assignment: Exert this minion twice to assign it to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). If you cannot spot 6 companions, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.

title: Unmistakable Omen
gameText:
While you can spot a threat, the site number of each orc Orc is -1.
Regroup: Remove 3 threats and discard 3 orc Orcs from play to make the Free Peoples player spot a companion and place that companion in the dead pile. Discard this condition.

title: Unreasonable Choice
gameText: Spot 2 <symbol>orc</symbol> minions to discard a Free Peoples condition. The Free Peoples player may add <symbol>twilight2</symbol> for each Free Peoples condition you can spot to prevent that.
loreText: An attacking swarm of Orcs leaves few desirable options.

title: Veteran War Chief
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
loreText: ...I'll stick you, if you don't shut it down, see?'

title: Brilliant Light
gameText: Make a <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion strength +2 (or +3 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword> if he or she is a hunter companion).
loreText: The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.

title: Burial Mounds
gameText: Make a <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion <keyword>defender +1</keyword> and minions skirmishing that companion cannot take wounds during a skirmish involving that companion until the regroup phase.
loreText: Their hearts were heavy, remembering the many men that had fallen in battle in this place.

title: Éomer
subtitle: Horsemaster
gameText:
Valiant. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
While you can spot a rohan Man, Éomers twilight cost is -1.
Skirmish: Discard a rohan card from hand to make Éomer strength +2.

title: Éomer's Spear
subtitle: Trusty Weapon
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
If bearer is Éomer and he is unwounded, he is damage +1 and resistance +1.
Skirmish: If bearer is Éomer, discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing.
loreText: Aim for their heads!

title: Éowyn
subtitle: Willing Fighter
gameText:
Valiant.
Response: If a hunter companion or valiant Man is about to take a wound, exert Éowyn to prevent that wound.
loreText: I can fight!

title: Gamling
subtitle: The Old
gameText:
Valiant. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) To play, spot a rohan Man.
While you can spot 3 hunters, Gamling is strength +3.
loreText: Dawn is not far off.... But dawn will not help us, I fear.'

title: Grim Trophy
gameText: Make a <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man strength +1 for each hunter you can spot (or if you can spot more valiant Men than hunters, make a <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man strength +1 for each valiant Man you can spot).
loreText: At least they will not love the Orcs.'

title: Haleth
subtitle: Son of Háma
gameText:
While you can spot 2 mounts, Haleth is strength +2.
While you can spot 3 mounts, Haleth is damage +1.
While you can spot 4 Free Peoples mounts, those mounts can not be discarded by a Shadow player.

title: Horse of Great Stature
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make a rohan Man strength +1.
loreText: Aragorn saw a shadow on the distant green, a dark swift-moving blur.

title: Horseman of the North
gameText:
While you can spot a valiant Man, this companions twilight cost is -1.
This companion is strength +2 while no opponent controls a site.
loreText: And they became our allies, and have ever proved true to us...'

title: Last Days of My House
gameText: Spot 2 <symbol>rohan</symbol> Men (or 1 hunter <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man) to play a <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion or a <symbol>rohan</symbol> follower from your draw deck.
loreText: No parent should have to bury their child.

title: Our Inspiration
gameText: Spot a <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man to play a possession from your discard pile for each hunter character you can spot.
loreText: Decorative armor adorned the hallways and armories of Helm's Deep.

title: Rider's Mount
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
loreText: Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind....

title: Rohan Stable Master
gameText:
Aid  twilight1. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight1 to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a rohan Man.
Bearer is considered to be mounted.
loreText: Rohirrim warriors were seldom seen without their mount.

title: Rohan Worker
gameText:
Aid  twilight1.
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a rohan companion, exert bearer twice.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may liberate a site.
loreText: In preparation for the Battle of Helm's Deep, everyone helped fortify the doors and walls.

title: Rohirrim Axe
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
While bearer is skirmishing a hunter minion, bearer is damage +1.
loreText: Rohirrim young and old were given weapons of all kinds to defend Helm's Deep.

title: Rohirrim Doorwarden
gameText:
Aid  twilight2. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight2 to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a rohan Man.
Bearer is strength +1 for each possession he or she bears.
loreText: ...any weapon that you bear, be it only a staff, you must leave it on the threshold.'

title: Rohirrim Soldier
gameText:
Valiant. While you can spot a rohan Man, this companions twilight cost is -1.
This companion is strength +1 for each hunter minion you can spot.
loreText: Let us ride on!'

title: Rohirrim Warrior
gameText:
Valiant.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot a hunter minion (or exert 2 valiant Men) to make this companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
loreText: ...a warrior should have more skills and knowledge than only the craft of weapons and slaying...'

title: Spear of the Mark
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
If bearer is mounted, bearer is defender +1.
loreText: Rohirrim spears are much deadlier when the bearer is on horseback.

title: Sturdy Shield
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
While no opponent controls a site, bearer is strength +1.
Regroup: Discard this to liberate a site (or two sites if bearer is mounted).
loreText: Sometimes the best offense is a good defense.

title: Swift Stroke
gameText: Spot your <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man bearing a possession to discard all possessions from one character.
loreText: ...she drove her sword between crown and mantle, as the great shoulders bowed before her.

title: Community Living
gameText: Spot a Hobbit to play a <symbol>shire</symbol> follower from your draw deck.
loreText: ...ease and peace had left this people still curiously tough.

title: Frodo
subtitle: Weary From the Journey
gameText:
Ring-bearer. Ring-bound.
While skirmishing a minion of strength 8 or less, Frodo is strength +2.
loreText: Let's...get out of this cursed place as quick as we canif we can!'

title: Hobbit Sword
gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit.
loreText: These are for you. Keep them close.

title: Hobbiton Brewer
subtitle: Maker of Fine Ales
gameText:
Aid  Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot a Hobbit.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, transfer Hobbiton Brewer to your support area to prevent that wound.

title: Hobbiton Farmer
subtitle: Lover of Pipeweed
gameText:
Aid  Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Bearer is strength +1 for each fierce minion you can spot.
loreText: ...for ages folk in the Shire smoked various herbs...

title: Little Golden Flower
gameText:
Each Hobbit bearing a hand weapon is vitality +1.
Each Hobbit bearing a follower is resistance +1.
Each unwounded Hobbit is strength +1.
loreText: ...she is very beautiful, and is going to be beautifuller still.'

title: Merry
subtitle: The Tall One
gameText:
While Merry bears a follower, he is strength +2.
Skirmish:
If Merry is skirmishing a hunter minion, add a threat to make Merry strength +2.
loreText: Three-foot-eight? You did something!

title: No Visitors
gameText: Transfer a follower from a Hobbit to your support area to cancel a skirmish involving that Hobbit.
loreText: No thank you!

title: Pippin
subtitle: The Short One
gameText:
Each shire follower is twilight cost 1.
Skirmish: If Pippin is skirmishing a hunter minion, exert the Ring-bearer to make Pippin strength +2.
loreText: I've always been taller than you.

title: Relaxation
gameText: <keyword>Response:</keyword> If a Shadow card is about to add any number of burdens, discard a <symbol>shire</symbol> follower and this condition from play to prevent that and discard that Shadow card.
loreText: As for the Hobbits of the Shire...they were a merry folk.

title: Sam
subtitle: Innocent Traveler
gameText:
Ring-bound. While Sam bears the One Ring, he is resistance 4.
Maneuver: If Sam is bearing a follower, exert him to heal another Hobbit.
Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer.

title: Second Breakfast
gameText: Add a threat and exert your Ring-bearer to wound each non-hunter minion skirmishing your <symbol>shire</symbol> Ring-bearer.
loreText: Don't think he knows about second breakfast, Pip.

title: Advancing Horde
gameText:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each site you control.
loreText: To war!

title: Charging Uruk
gameText:
Fierce.
During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).
loreText: They kept no order... yet their speed was very great.

title: Chasing Uruk
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot 4 hunters (or Uglúk) to control a site.
loreText: But why not kill them quick, kill them now?'

title: Covetous Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each possession you spot.
loreText: The Uruk-hai pillage the remains of the fallen merely to satisfy their bloodlust.

title: Defensive Rush
gameText:
While you can spot an urukhai minion, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site.
At the start of each skirmish, you may remove twilight3 to heal an urukhai minion (or heal an urukhai minion twice if you control a site.)
loreText: Though the arrows rained down, the Uruk formation did not break.

title: Following Uruk
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion not assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: The hobbits were left with the Isengarders: a grim dark band...of large, swart, slant-eyed Orcs with great bows and short broad-bladed swords.

title: Hunting Uruk
gameText: While this minion is at a battleground site, he gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
loreText: They're taking the Hobbits to Isengard!

title: Lurtz
subtitle: Now Perfected
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert X companions, where X is the current region number.
loreText: You will taste man-flesh!

title: Lurtz's Sword
subtitle: Mighty Longsword
gameText:
Bearer must be an urukhai Uruk-hai.
Bearer gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
If bearer is Lurtz, he is fierce.
loreText: Defeating an Uruk with a broad-bladed sword is not easily done.

title: Mauhúr
subtitle: Relentless Hunter
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Assignment: Exert Mauhúr to assign him to a non-hunter character (except the Ring-bearer).

title: Merciless Berserker
gameText:
Damage +1.
Shadow: Exert this minion to exert X companions and add X threats, where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.
loreText: These are Uruk-hai. Their armor is thick and their shields broad.

title: Poised for Assault
gameText:
Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving an urukhai minion, place an urukhai token here.
Skirmish: Remove 2 urukhai tokens from here to take control of a site.
loreText: Over the wall...the last assault came sweeping like a dark wave upon a hill of sand.

title: Pursuing Uruk
gameText:
Fierce.
During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, he gains hunter 4.
loreText: I wish to kill, and then go back north.'

title: Searching Uruk
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 1.(While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Searching Uruk is strength +1 for each other urukhai hunter you can spot.
loreText: ...we must stick together...'

title: Seeking Uruk
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +1 for each hunter you can spot.
loreText: Rest while you can! We'll find a use for your legs before long.'

title: Sentry Uruk
gameText:
To play, spot a urukhai minion.
While you can spot a fierce minion, this minion is fierce.
While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1.
While you can spot a character that is damage +1, this minion is damage +1.

title: Tracking Uruk
gameText: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
loreText: We are servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand: the Hand that gives us man's-flesh to eat.'

title: Uglúk
subtitle: Ugly Fellow
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)
At the start of each skirmish involving Uglúk, each non-hunter skirmishing Uglúk must exert.
loreText: ...let's have no more nonsense!'

title: Uglúk's Sword
subtitle: Weapon of Command
gameText:
Bearer must be an urukhai Uruk-hai.
While you control 2 or more sites, bearer can not take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
If bearer is Uglúk, he is damage +1.
loreText: I don't trust you little swine.'

title: Uruk Cavern Striker
gameText:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Spot a Free Peoples players site on the adventure path and exert this minion twice to exchange the spotted site with a site you control. You now control the spotted site.
loreText: Get them into the caves.

title: Uruk Infantry
gameText:
Damage +1.
While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +2.
Regroup: Exert 4 urukhai minions (or discard 3 urukhai minions) to take control of a site.
loreText: March to Helm's Deep! Leave none alive!

title: Uruk Village Assassin
gameText:
Damage +1.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot another urukhai minion and remove 3 urukhai tokens to take control of a site or discard a follower.
loreText: Rohan, my Lord, is ready to fall.

title: Uruk Village Rager
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, take control of a site.
While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds (except during the skirmish phase).
loreText: They come to destroy its people.

title: Uruk Village Stormer
gameText:
Damage +1.
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4.
Each time a companion or ally is killed during a skirmish involving an urukhai minion, you may take control of a site.
loreText: Saruman's hordes will pillage and burn...

title: Violent Hurl
gameText: Make an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion strength +2 (and <keyword>damage +1</keyword> if that minion is a hunter).
loreText: Uruk-hai weaponry was built to be used offensively and defensively, depending on the situation.

title: With All Possible Speed
gameText:
Each unwounded hunter urukhai minion is strength +1.
Response: If your hunter minion is about to take a wound during a skirmish, discard that minion to exert a non-hunter companion.
loreText: They seemed to have left winter clinging to the hills behind.

title: Later Than You Think
gameText: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgûl. That Nazgûl is twilight cost 2 and gains <keyword>hunter 2</keyword> until the start of the regroup phase.
loreText: The Nine have left Minas Morgul.

title: A Shadow Fell Over Them
gameText:
Each time a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 Nazgûl (or a Nazgûl twice) to add a threat.
Assignment: Spot a Nazgûl and remove twilight4 to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.
loreText: ...a blind fear and a deadly cold fell on them. Cowering they looked up.

title: They Feel The Precious
gameText: <keyword>Response:</keyword> If a Nazgûl is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.
loreText: Three times is a threat. They feel us here...'

title: Úlairë Attëa
subtitle: Desirous of Power
gameText:
Fierce.
Úlairë Attëa is strength +1 for every 3 twilight tokens you can spot.
loreText: The Nazgûl were strongest, and most terrifying, at night.

title: Úlairë Lemenya
subtitle: Eternally Threatening
gameText:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may remove twilight1 to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
loreText: Soon there could be no doubt: three or four tall black figures were standing on the slope, looking down on them.

title: Úlairë Nelya
subtitle: Fell Rider
gameText:
Fierce.
While you can spot 6 companions, wraith minions cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
Skirmish: If this minion is mounted, exert him twice to wound a companion bearing a wraith condition.

title: Anduin River
gameText: <keyword>River.</keyword> The fellowship archery total is 3.

title: Breeding pit of Isengard
gameText: <keyword>Underground.</keyword> The twilight cost of the first hunter minion played each Shadow phase is 2.

title: City Gates
gameText: When the Fellowship moves to this site, add a threat (or 2 if you can spot a hunter minion) for each companion over 4.

title: East Wall of Rohan
gameText: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may exert two hunter companions to play a hunter companion from your draw deck.

title: Gate of Mordor
gameText: <keyword>Battleground.</keyword> Each time the fellowship moves to this site, add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> for each culture you can spot.

title: Isengard Ruined
gameText: <keyword>Battleground.</keyword> Each time a follower is transfered to a character, the first Shadow player may exert a companion twice.

title: Mount Doom
