gameText: <keyword>Battleground. Mountain. Underground.</keyword> Until the end of the game, sites in this region cannot be replaced.

title: Westfold Village
gameText: <keyword>Plains.</keyword> Each hunter character is strength +1.

title: Legolas
subtitle: Of the Woodland Realm
gameText:
Archer. Hunter 1(While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).
Archery: Exert Legolas to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each hunter minion you can spot.(Limit +3)
loreText: You would die before your stroke fell!

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Powerful Guide
gameText:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time you play a spell, you may add a burden to wound a minion.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, you may draw a card and then discard a card from your hand.
loreText: Let the Ring-bearer decide.

title: Quickbeam
subtitle: Hastiest of All Ents
gameText:
Quickbeam is twilight cost -1 for each Ent you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this companion to place another gandalf companion from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck and reinforce a gandalf token.
loreText: A punch from an Ent-fist crumples up iron...'

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Thorongil
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
Maneuver: Add a threat to exert a non-hunter minion with strength less than Aragorn's.
loreText: I will follow the Orcs...'

title: Madril
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
While you can spot 2 gondor rangers, Madril is twilight cost 2.
At the start of the Maneuver phase, each minion is site number +1 for each threat you can spot until the start of the regroup phase.
loreText: For that is the ruin of Osgiliath...'

title: Éomer
subtitle: Horsemaster
gameText:
Valiant. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
While you can spot a rohan Man, Éomers twilight cost is -1.
Skirmish: Discard a rohan card from hand to make Éomer strength +2.

title: Úlairë Attëa
subtitle: Desirous of Power
gameText:
Fierce.
Úlairë Attëa is strength +1 for every 3 twilight tokens you can spot.
loreText: The Nazgûl were strongest, and most terrifying, at night.

title: Úlairë Lemenya
subtitle: Eternally Threatening
gameText:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may remove twilight1 to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
loreText: Soon there could be no doubt: three or four tall black figures were standing on the slope, looking down on them.

title: Úlairë Nelya
subtitle: Fell Rider
gameText:
Fierce.
While you can spot 6 companions, wraith minions cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
Skirmish: If this minion is mounted, exert him twice to wound a companion bearing a wraith condition.

title: Forth the Three Hunters!
gameText:
Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters).
Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).

title: Forth the Three Hunters!
gameText:
Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters).
Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).

title: Barrow-wight Stalker
gameText:
Enduring.
Each wraith Wraith cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes).
Shadow: Remove a burden to play a wraith Wraith. That minions twilight cost is 2.
loreText: The icy touch froze his bones, and he remembered no more.

title: Candle Corpses
gameText:
Enduring.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a companion, you may spot another wraith Wraith and remove twilight2 to wound that companion.
loreText: ...here and there they twisted like ghostly sheets unfurled by hidden hands.

title: Covetous Wisp
gameText:
Enduring.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns Covetous Wisp to a companion, you may spot another wraith Wraith and remove twilight2 to add a burden.
loreText: Only shapes to see, perhaps, not to touch.'

title: Dead Faces
gameText:
Enduring.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a companion, you may spot another wraith Wraith and remove twilight2 to discard a condition.
loreText: There are dead things, dead faces in the water!'

title: Spirit of Dread
gameText:
Enduring.
While you can spot another wraith Wraith, wounds cannot be healed and burdens can not be removed (except by Wraiths).
Skrimish: Exert Spirit of Dread to make another wraith Wraith strength +1.
loreText: ...across their three necks lay one long naked sword.

title: Undead of Angmar
gameText:
Enduring.
While you can spot another wraith Wraith, each wounded companion is resistance 2.
Shadow: Exert Undead of Angmar twice to play a wraith Wraith from your draw deck, then reshuffle.
loreText: In the dark there was a snarling noise.

title: Armor of Khazâd
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Each time bearer is about to take a wound, you may add a threat to prevent that.
Regroup: Discard this possession to take up to 2 other dwarven possessions into hand from your discard pile.

title: Balin Avenged
gameText:
When you play this condition, you may add a dwarven token here. While you can spot 4 dwarven tokens and 2 Dwarves, eachorcOrc gains this text "To play, remove an ¥ card from your discard pile from the game.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to exert a minion for each Dwarf you can spot.

title: Dwarven Stratagem
gameText: Spot a Dwarf hunter and choose one: exert a minion for each hunter you can spot or reinforce a <symbol>dwarven</symbol> token for each hunter you can spot.
loreText: Always well armed, a Dwarf has many options in battle.

title: Ring of Artifice
gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer is damage +1.
Bearer is strength +1 for each dwarven artifact in your discard pile.
Regroup: Discard this to take a non-event dwarven card into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: "'Beyond the Shadow it waits for you still...'"

title: Axe-work
gameText: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or if you cannot spot a threat, make that Dwarf strength +1 For each Dwarf you can spot).
loreText: Brave in battle, Dwarven pride and will cannot be broken.

title: Thorin III
subtitle: Stonehelm
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time a minion loses a skirmish involving Thorin III, its owner discards the top card from his or her draw deck.
loreText: Veteran warrior and keen leader, Stonehelm drove the enemy from Dale.

title: Elven Guardian
gameText:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +2.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to heal another hunter.
loreText: "We are proud to fight alongside Men, once more"

title: Hearth and Hall
gameText: Spot an <symbol>elven</symbol> hunter and choose one: draw a card for each hunter you can spot or reinforce an <symbol>elven</symbol> token for each hunter you can spot.
loreText: "Until at last our toil be past/ our journey done, our errand sped."

title: Lothlórien Guides
gameText: Spot 2 Elves (or an Elf and an <symbol>elven</symbol> follower) to discard a condition (or discard two conditions if you can spot 4 or more Shadow conditions).
loreText: "The road is very dangerous"

title: Namárië
gameText:
When you play this, add an elven token here for each hunter you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this or remove a token from here and spot an elven hunter to discard a condition.
loreText: "We shall not meet again, Elessar."

title: Orophin
subtitle: Silvan Elf
gameText:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While Orophin is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +3.
Archery: Exert another elven hunter and add a threat to wound a minion.
loreText: Guardian of the Golden Wood.

title: Rúmil
subtitle: Silvan Elf
gameText:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While you can spot a wounded minion, Rúmil is strength +1 and gains archer.
Archery: Exert another elven hunter and add a threat to wound a minion.
loreText: Guardian of Nimrodel.

title: The World Ahead
gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
Each time the fellowship moves to a region 1 site, add a threat.
Each time the fellowship moves to a region 2 site, heal an Elf.
Each time the fellowship moves to a region 3 site, draw a card.

title: Weapons of Lothlórien
gameText: Spot an <symbol>elven</symbol> archer and add a threat to wound a minion (or add 3 threats to exert 3 minions).
loreText: "Leithio i philinn!"

title: A New Light
gameText:
Spell.
Spot a gandalf Wizard to return a minion to its owner's hand from its owner's discard pile. Reveal that Shadow player's hand and discard a minion from his or her hand.
loreText: "'I once knew every spell in all the tongues of Men or Elves or Orcs...'"

title: Barliman Butterbur
subtitle: Red-faced Landlord
gameText:
Barliman Butterbur is strength +1 for each attached gandalf follower.
Maneuver: Exert Barliman Butterbur to reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Take any gandalf cards into hand and discard the rest.
loreText: "'Barliman Butterbur at your service!'"

title: Gandalf
subtitle: Returned
gameText:
When you play Gandalf (except in your starting fellowship), you may play a gandalf possession on him from your draw deck or discard pile.
Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may reinforce a Free Peoples token.

title: Glamdring
subtitle: Orc Beater
gameText:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
Bearer is damage +1.
Each time a companion is about to take a wound, you may discard a companion from hand to prevent that.
loreText: "...in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white."

title: Guidance of the Istari
gameText: Make a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion strength +1 for each <symbol>gandalf</symbol> Man you can spot.
loreText: "Hold them back. Do not give in to fear! Stand your posts! Fight!"

title: Gwaihir
subtitle: The Windlord
gameText:
Aid - Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.)
If bearer is a gandalf Wizard, each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion (if that minion is a Wizard, wound it instead).
loreText: "'...swiftest of the Great Eagles...'"

title: Long-stemmed Pipe
gameText:
Pipeweed.
When you play this, you may search your deck for a gandalf card and place it in your discard pile.
Regroup: Discard another pipeweed from play to discard a condition. Discard this condition.
loreText: The smoke from his pipe drifted up, obscuring his face.

title: Meneldor
subtitle: Misty Mountain Eagle
gameText:
Aid - twilight1. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may addtwilight1 to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot a gandalf follower.
Bearer is strength +1 for each other gandalf follower you can spot.
loreText: To many he was known as the swift.

title: Scintillating Bird
gameText:
Spell.
Fellowship: Exert your Wizard and choose an opponent to name either Free Peoples or Shadow. Reveal the top three cards of your deck. If you revealed at least two of the chosen card type, take those cards into hand, otherwise, discard those cards.

title: Shadowfax
subtitle: Greatest of the Mearas
gameText:
Bearer must be a gandalf Wizard.
Discard all other possessions on bearer and bearer may not bear a hand weapon.
Fellowship: Add a threat to remove a burden.
loreText: "There are no horses like those that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White."

title: The Sap is in the Bough
gameText: Discard a companion from hand to make a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion strength +3 (or +4 if you can spot 3 Ents).
loreText: "'Together we will take the road that leads into the west/ and far away, we'll find a land where both our hearts may rest.'"
englishTitle: The Sap is in the Bough

title: Woodland Onod
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard a companion from hand to make an Ent strength +2.
loreText: "'Ents are earthborn, old as mountains...'"

title: Andúril
subtitle: Sword That Was Broken
gameText:
Bearer must be Aragorn.
He is damage +1.
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may exert him to liberate a site or discard a condition borne by a companion.
loreText: "It has been Remade."

title: Faramir
subtitle: Bearer of Quality
gameText:
While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats.
Skirmish: While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, you may wound Faramir to make a minion skirmishing a gondor Man roaming until the end of the turn.

title: Faramir's Bow
subtitle: Ithilien Longbow
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor ranger.
If bearer is Faramir, he is an archer.
The site number of each minion skirmishing a gondor ranger is +1.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to exhaust a minion Faramir is skirmishing.
loreText: "...great bows. Almost their own height..."

title: Madril
subtitle: Loyal Lieutenant
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
While you can spot a roaming minion, your gondor conditions cannot be discarded from play by Shadow cards.
Maneuver: Exert 2 rangers to make a minion site number +2 until the regroup phase.

title: Narsil
subtitle: Forged by Telchar
gameText:
Bearer must be Elendil or Isilder.
Bearer is damage +1.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Shadow possession.
loreText: "...and the sword of Elendil filled Orcs and Men with fear...."

title: Nimble Attack
gameText: Spot 2 <symbol>gondor</symbol> companions and add a threat to discard a shadow possession.
loreText: "'We shall be pursued as soon as news of our deed reaches the Enemy...'"

title: Ranger of the White Tree
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
When this is in your starting fellowship and you can spot an unbound gondor companion with cost 3 or more, his twilight cost is -2.
Maneuver: Exert this companion and spot a roaming minion to make him defender +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Spirit of the White Tree
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor companion.
An opponent can not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving bearer.
Each time a Shadow player adds a burden, discard this condition.
loreText: A blossom of hope.

title: Soldier's Cache
gameText:
Fortification.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot 3 rangers or exert a gondor Man to transfer this condition to a minion. Wound that minion.
Regroup: Exert a ranger to reinforce a gondor token.

title: Throne of Minas Tirith
gameText:
To play, spot Denethor (or 2 gondor companions).
Each time a minion is killed or discarded from play during a skirmish, you may reinforce a gondor token.
Skirmish: Remove 3 gondor tokens to discard a possession.

title: Saruman
subtitle: Instigator of Insurrection
gameText:
Saruman cannot be assigned to a skirmish.
While you can spot 6 companions, each minion gains hunter 2.
Response: If a hunter minion is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that.

title: Saruman
subtitle: Servant of Sauron
gameText:
Aid - twilight1. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may removetwilight1 to transfer this to a minion.)
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion.
loreText: "'I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, but you have elected the way of pain.'"

title: Throne of Isengard
gameText:
Each time you play Saruman, spot a minion. That minion is fierce until the start of the regroup phase.
Each Wizard is strength +3 and damage +1.
loreText: From the heights of Orthanc, Saruman spied on Middle-earth and plotted his rise to power.

title: Beast of War
gameText:
Bearer must be a men Man.
While you can spot a threat, bearer is fierce.
While you can spot 3 threats, bearer is damage +1.
While you can spot 5 threats, you may play this from your discard pile.
loreText: "...mûmakil were bellowing as they were goaded to war."

title: Ceremonial Armor
gameText:
Each time a men minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here.
Response: Discard a minion stacked here or discard this to prevent a wound to a men minion.
loreText: Scarlet cloaks and bronze armor adorned the marching forces

title: Easterling Dispatcher
gameText: When you play this minion, you may spot 2 other <symbol>men</symbol> Men to add<symbol>twilight1</symbol> for each possession you spot.
loreText: The men of Rhûn's preparation for battle was second to none.

title: Easterling Sneak
gameText: While you control 2 sites, Easterling Sneak is <keyword>fierce</keyword>. While you control 4 sites, each <symbol>men</symbol> minion is strength +1 and <keyword>fierce</keyword>.
loreText: "The dark is gathering all armies to him."

title: Gríma's Dagger
gameText:
Bearer must be a men Man.
If bearer is Gríma, he is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
Response: If a skirmish event is played, discard this possession to cancel that event.
loreText: The blade of a pathetic creature.

title: In the Wild Men's Wake
gameText: Spot a <symbol>men</symbol> possession in your support area and a <symbol>men</symbol> minion. Make that minion strength +1 for each minion stacked on that possession. You may discard that possession to make that minion damage +1.
loreText: "Too long have these peasants stood against you."

title: Pandemonium
gameText: Play a <symbol>men</symbol> minion stacked on a <symbol>men</symbol> possession as if from hand.
loreText: Few could escape the oncoming pillage of the Dunlending's savage stampede.

title: Primitive Brand
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this possession to another men minion. If you do, stack a men minion from play on a men possession in your support area.
loreText: The men of Dunland took even the most basic of tools to be weapons against Rohan.

title: Saruman
subtitle: Coldly Still
gameText:
Each men minion bearing a possession is strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to play a men possession from your discard pile.
loreText: "Take back what they stole from you!"

title: Stampeding Chief
gameText:
Damage +1. Fierce.
If you play Stampeding Chief from your hand, remove twilight3 and spot another men minion or discard Stampeding Chief.
loreText: But no more would Rohan stand against his kind.

title: Stampeding Hillsman
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Spot a <symbol>men</symbol> minion in your discard pile and discard this minion to place that minion on your <symbol>men</symbol> support area possession.
loreText: "Argh!!"

title: Stampeding Madman
gameText:
To play, spot 2 men Men.
When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each site you control.
loreText: "'"Death to the robbers of the North!"'"

title: Stampeding Ransacker
gameText:
To play, spot 2 men Men.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish and you can spot a site you control, exhaust an unbound companion.
loreText: "'"Death to the Forgoil!"'"

title: Stampeding Savage
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Discard this minion and X minions stacked on a <symbol>men</symbol> possession to play a <symbol>men</symbol> minion from your discard pile. That minion is twilight cost -X.
loreText: "We will fight for you!"

title: Stampeding Shepherd
gameText:
Fierce.
Maneuver: Discard this minion and a men minion with a twilight cost 2 or less from play to play Stampeding Chief from your draw deck. It is twilight cost -8.
loreText: "We will die... for Saruman!"

title: Sunland Guard
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Exert this minion to play a <symbol>men</symbol> minion (or 2 if you spot 6 companions) from a <symbol>men</symbol> possession as if from hand.
loreText: They prepare for the last war.

title: Sunland Scout
gameText:
This minion is strength +1 for each men possession with a men minion stacked on it.
Maneuver: Spot a men possession and discard this minion from play to discard a condition.
loreText: The Southrons did not march into war blindly.

title: Sunland Skirmisher
gameText:
This minion is strength +1 for each men minion stacked on each men possession.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may play a minion stacked on a men possession as if from hand.
loreText: Vile servants of Sauron marched to their master.

title: Sunland Sneak
gameText: This minion is twilight cost -1 for each <symbol>men</symbol> minion stacked on a <symbol>men</symbol> possession.
loreText: Southron men were always ready for war.

title: Sunland Trooper
gameText:
This minion is strength +2 for each men possession with a men minion stacked on it.
Maneuver: Spot X men minions stacked on a men possession and discard this minion to add twilightX.
loreText: "...legions of Haradrim from the South..."

title: Sunland Warrior
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Spot a <symbol>men</symbol> possession and discard this minion from play to make each <symbol>men</symbol> minion you spot strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.
loreText: They were wicked men.

title: Sunland Weaponmaster
gameText:
To play, spot 2 men Men.
While this minion bears a possession, he is strength +2 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
loreText: "War will make corpses of us all."

title: Vengeful Savage
gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack a <symbol>men</symbol> minion from your discard pile on a <symbol>men</symbol> possession in your support area.
loreText: "'"We will take their king."'"

title: Vengeful Wild Man
gameText: At the start of the maneuver phase, spot another <symbol>men</symbol> Man and exert this minion to add a threat. Then add an additional threat for each companion you spot over 4.
loreText: The pawns of Saruman are relentless in their tasks.

title: Vengeful Pillager
gameText: When you play this minion from your draw deck or from your <symbol>men</symbol> possession, it is <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
loreText: "Murderers!"

title: Vengeful Primitive
gameText:
You may play this minion any time you could play a maneuver event.
When you play this minion in the maneuver phase, you may discard X men minions from play to add twilightX.
loreText: Incited by Saruman, they created pandemonium in the land of Rohan.

title: Wildman's Oath
gameText:
Each time a men minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here.
Skirmish: Discard this possession to make a men Man strength +2.
loreText: "Take back the lands they stole from you!"

title: A Defiled Charge
gameText:
To play, exert your mounted orc Orc.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a mounted orc Orc to a companion, he or she must choose to either exert that companion or add twilight2.
loreText: "The wolf snarled and sprang towards them with a great leap."

title: Chaotic Clash
gameText:
To play, spot no minions.
Each time you play a minion, it is twilight cost +1.
While you can spot an orc minion, each companion is strength -1.
loreText: An Orc often was spurred into battle as if death was preferable to the torment of its orkish life.

title: Cry and Panic
gameText: Each time a mounted <symbol>orc</symbol> Orc wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must reveal his or her hand and place two Free Peoples cards revealed on the bottom of his or her draw deck.
loreText: "Wargs! We are under attack!"

title: Feral Ride
gameText: Make an <symbol>orc</symbol> minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is mounted).
loreText: It was hard at times to tell who was truly the master, the warg or the Orc.

title: Grishnákh
subtitle: Treacherous Captain
gameText:
Hunter 2.
While you can spot an urukhai minion, each orc Orc gains hunter 1 (if that urukhai minion is Ugluk, each orc Orc gains an additional hunter 1).
Shadow: Exert Grishnákh twice to play an urukhai hunter minion from your draw deck.

title: Orkish Assassin
gameText: While you can spot a follower attached to a companion, each <symbol>orc</symbol> minion is strength +2.
loreText: Vile villain of all that opposed his master.

title: Orkish Berserker
gameText: When this minion wins a skirmish, discard an <symbol>orc</symbol> minion from play.
loreText: These Orcs were fearsome warriors.

title: Orkish Cavalry
gameText:
Each time you play anorcmount, you may draw a card.
Assignment: If this minion is mounted, exert it twice to assign it to a companion of strength 9 or more.
loreText: With speed and numbers, these feared riders were not easily avoided.

title: Orkish Dreg
gameText: Each time you play this minion, you may spot another <symbol>orc</symbol> minion to exert a companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
loreText: Under the cover of darkness the Orcs came.

title: Orkish Fiend
gameText:
To play, spot anorcOrc.
While at an underground site, this minion is fierce and the Free Peoples player may not replace sites or play a site from his or her adventure deck.
loreText: Dwellers of foul pits and tunnels.

title: Orkish Flanker
gameText:
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if it is mounted, exert a companion.
Shadow: Exert 3 orc minions and spot an orc mount to discard a condition.
loreText: Quick to contain their fleeing victims, the Orkish riders were always feared.

title: Orkish Footman
gameText: This minion is strength +1 for each twilight token you can spot.
loreText: They feared their master more than any enemy.

title: Orkish Invader
gameText: At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may reveal an <symbol>orc</symbol> condition from hand to wound the companion this minion is skirmishing twice and then discard this minion.
loreText: Spawned from terrible acts, the Orcs emerged as ruined and terrible forms of life.

title: Orkish Lackey
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Spot 2 <symbol>orc</symbol> conditions and discard this minion from play to wound an unbound companion.
loreText: They came from dark and evil places.

title: Orkish Marauder
gameText: This minion is strength +1 for each <symbol>orc</symbol> condition in your discard pile.
loreText: As the Orcs silently approached, the fear they brought multiplied.

title: Orkish Rider
gameText:
Each mounted orc Orc is strength +1.
Shadow: Discard an orc card from your hand to play an orc mount from your discard pile.
loreText: They formed the cavalry of the Orc legions.

title: Orkish Runner
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Exert this minion and spot another <symbol>orc</symbol> minion to add <symbol>twilightX</symbol>, where X is the number of the current region.
loreText: Orcs were kept in check by the light of the Sun.

title: Orkish Scout
gameText: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Exert this minion to add <symbol>twilightX</symbol>, where X is the current site's Shadow number.
loreText: Bred in dark sorcery.

title: Orkish Traveler
gameText:
Each orc mount is twilight cost -1.
Skirmish: Remove twilight3 to make a mounted orc Orc strength +2.
loreText: There is not much that is fouler than Orcs.

title: Orkish Veteran
gameText:
Each time you play an orc mount, you may reinforce an orc token.
Regroup: Exert Orkish Veteran to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
loreText: Skin as dark as wood that has been charred by flame.

title: Orkish Warg-master
gameText:
Each time a mounted orc minion wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her deck.
Shadow: Exert bearer to play an orc mount from your discard pile.
loreText: "Argh!!"

title: Orkish Warrior
gameText:
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, discard this minion.
loreText: These Orcs were loathsome as Elves were fair.

title: Relentless Warg
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc Orc with strength 10 or less.
Bearer is fierce.
When you play this possession, spot a race. While bearer is skirmishing a companion of that race, bearer is strength +3 and damage +1.
loreText: "The wolves of Isengard will return."

title: Rider's Gear
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc Orc.
While bearer is mounted, it cannot take wounds except during the skirmish phase.
loreText: Foul of smell but light to bear, a warg would often allow its rider little leeway.

title: Threatening Warg
gameText:
Bearer must be a orc Orc with strength 10 or less.
Bearer is fierce.
When you play this, you may spot 2orcOrcs that are not bearing mounts to play anorcmount from your draw deck.
loreText: "'The wolf that one hears is worse than the orc that one fears.'"

title: Vicious Warg
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc Orc with strength 9 or less.
Bearer is fierce.
loreText: "'...where the warg howls, there also the orc prowls.'"

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Defender of Rohan
gameText:
Valiant.
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each rohan companion gains hunter 1.
loreText: "'No enemy has yet taken the Hornburg. Depart, or not one of you will be spared.'"

title: Dispatched With Haste
gameText:
While at a plains site, each mounted companion is strength +1.
Regroup: Spot 2 rohan Men and discard a rohan possession to discard a possession.
loreText: "Assemble the army at Dunharrow, as many men as can be found."

title: Éomer
subtitle: Northman
gameText:
Damage +1.
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +3.
Maneuver: If Éomer is mounted, exert him to make him defender +1 until the end of turn.
loreText: "We cannot achieve victory through strength of arms."

title: Éowyn
subtitle: Northwoman
gameText:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éowyn cannot take wounds while skirmishing.
Assignment: Exert Éowyn and assign a minion to the Ring-bearer to make that minion lose all keywords and unable to gain keywords until the regroup phase.

title: For Death and Glory
gameText:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing a rohan companion loses hunter and is unable to gain hunter.
Skirmish: Exert a rohan companion to make that companion gain hunter 1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Throne of the Golden Hall
gameText:
To play, spot Théoden (or 2 rohan companions).
Saruman and Gríma cannot be assigned to skirmishes.
Response: If a rohan Man is about to take a wound, exert another rohan Man and add twilight2 to prevent that.

title: Háma
subtitle: Northman
gameText: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing Háma loses strength bonuses and damage bonuses from possessions.
loreText: "Hail, Théoden King!"

title: Into the Caves
gameText:
To play, spot 3 rohan companions.
Assignment: Assign a minion to Frodo to make that minion lose all keywords of your choice and unable to gain keywords until the regroup phase.
loreText: "Saruman's arm will have grown long indeed if he thinks he can reach us here."

title: Soldier of Rohan
gameText: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, this companion is strength +2.
loreText: For ages, the people of Rohan have been allied to Gondor.

title: Théoden
subtitle: Northman, King of Rohan
gameText:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each rohan companion is strength +1.
Regroup: Spot 2 rohan followers and exert Théoden to liberate a site.
loreText: "When last I looked, Théoden, was King of Rohan."

title: Where Now The Horse
gameText: Spot a <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion to make Frodo strength +5. If Frodo loses the skirmish, discard that <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion.
loreText: "'They have passed like rain in the mountains, like the wind in the meadow.'"

title: Warrior of Rohan
gameText:
Possessions cannot be transferred from this companion to another character.
Fellowship: Play a possession on this companion to liberate a site.
loreText: Rohirrim territories are not easily taken.

title: Throne of the Dark Lord
gameText:
To play, spot 2 minions.
While you can spot Sauron, each other minion is damage +1.
While the fellowship is in the same region as Mount Doom, each companion is resistance -2.
loreText: "One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne."

title: Halfling Leaf
gameText:
Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
loreText: "'It feels good, and it smells good.'"

title: Merry
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health
gameText:
Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot.
Regroup:
Exert Merry to place a pipeweed from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
loreText: "'I think we may have made a mistake leaving the Shire, Pippin.'"

title: Hornblower Leaf
gameText:
Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit.
Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to remove a threat.
Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to discard a minion.
loreText: "'These are the Hornblower brandmarks...'"

title: Pippin
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health
gameText:
Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard 2 pipeweed cards from play to remove a burden.
loreText: "Ents are - well Ents are all different for one thing."

title: Southfarthing Leaf
gameText:
Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2.
Regroup: Discard this pipeweed from play to play a pipeweed from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.

title: Southlinch Leaf
gameText:
Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
loreText: "'How it came here, I can't imagine. For Saruman's private use, I fancy.'"

title: Blade of the White Hand
gameText:
Bearer must be an urukhai Uruk-hai.
While you can spot 2 controlled sites, this minion is damage +1.
While you can spot 4 controlled sites, this minion is damage +3.
loreText: The servants of the White Hand laid waste to the Pride of Gondor.

title: Deathly Roar
gameText:
Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession or artifact, place a urukhai token here.
Each time an urukhai minion wins a skirmish, you may remove an urukhai token to exert a companion.
loreText: The Uruk-hai assault on Helm's Deep was relentless.

title: Land Had Changed
gameText: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (or spot a site you control to make that Uruk-hai strength +3 instead). You may then liberate a site to make that Uruk-hai strength +2 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword>.
loreText: "'The Deeping Wall is taken, lord, and all the defense swept away...'"

title: Saruman
subtitle: Curunír
gameText:
Each time an urukhai hunter wins a skirmish, heal a different urukhai minion.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman twice to make a companion lose the hunter keyword until the start of the regroup phase.
loreText: "'He has claimed lordship over all this land...'"

title: Saruman
subtitle: Master of the White Hand
gameText:
Each companion is resistance -1.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to discard a condition borne by a companion skirmishing an urukhai minion.
loreText: "A new power is rising. Its victory is at hand."

title: Spear of the White Hand
gameText: Bearer must be an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> Uruk-hai.
loreText: "We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear..."

title: Vile Pit
gameText:
To play, spot an urukhai hunter.
At the start of each Shadow phase, you may discard 2 urukhai cards from hand to play an urukhai hunter from your discard pile.
Regroup: Discard this condition to return an urukhai hunter from play to your hand.
loreText: Saruman gazed on his creations with great pride

title: White Hand Aggressor
gameText:
Damage +1.
While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds, except during the skirmish phase.
loreText: "It's Saruman's army! The war has started."

title: White Hand Attacker
gameText:
Damage +1.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each site on the adventure path gains each terrain keyword from each site you control.
loreText: "You will taste man flesh."

title: White Hand Berserker
gameText:
Damage +1.
At the start of the archery phase, if you control a site, you may add 2 to the minion archery total for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
loreText: "...there was a crash and a flash of flame and smoke."

title: White Hand Butcher
gameText: Hunter 6. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +6.)
loreText: "'Bring out your skulking king!'"

title: White Hand Captain
gameText:
Fierce.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter character is strength +1.
loreText: They wore black armor and mail that was marked with the white hand of Saruman.

title: White Hand Destroyer
gameText:
Fierce.
This minion gains hunter 3 for each site you control.
loreText: "'This is no parley. You have nothing to say.'"

title: White Hand Enforcer
gameText:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may liberate a site to add twilightX, where X is the Shadow number of the liberated site.
loreText: The Uruks were tireless in the pursuit of their prey.

title: White Hand Guard
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make an urukhai hunter minion strength +2.
loreText: Under the banner of the white hand, they came in great numbers.

title: White Hand Intruder
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if you do not control a site, you may take control of a site.
loreText: "March to Helm's Deep!"

title: White Hand Invader
gameText:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, exert a companion for each site you control.
loreText: "There will be no dawn for men."

title: White Hand Legion
gameText:
Damage +1.
To play, remove 2 threats.
loreText: "The Orcs yelled and jeered."

title: White Hand Scout
gameText:
Damage +1. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
The roaming penalty for each urukhai minion you play is -1.
loreText: "'You've got no guts outside your own sties.'"

title: White Hand Slayer
gameText:
Fierce.
Each time a player plays an event in a skirmish involving this minion, that player may exert a non-hunter character.
loreText: "'...and there has been war between us for many months.'"

title: White Hand Taskmaster
gameText:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
When you play this minion, you may spot another urukhai minion to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
loreText: White Hand warriors fell to evil deeds with a passion.

title: White Hand Trooper
gameText:
Fierce.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter companion loses its special abilities and skirmish events can not be played in those companions' skirmishes.
loreText: "...the West is no longer safe."

title: White Hand Vanquisher
gameText:
Fierce.
This minion is damage +1 for each urukhai hunter assigned to a skirmish.
loreText: "'They have a blasting fire, and with it they took the wall.'"

title: White Hand Veteran
gameText:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, if you control a site, you may take an urukhai event into hand from your discard pile.
loreText: "To War!"

title: White Hand Warrior
gameText:
Damage +1. Hunter 4. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +4.)
Each time this minion is assigned to a non-hunter companion, you may heal a hunter.
loreText: "Leave none alive!"

title: You Do Not Know Fear
gameText: Discard a condition for each <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion you can spot.
loreText: Endangering and entangling all those that stood before them, the Uruk-hai shrunk before none.

title: You Do Not Know Pain
gameText:
Each time you take control of a site, you may spot 3 urukhai minions to exert an unbound companion.
Skirmish: Liberate a site to make an urukhai minion damage +1.
loreText: "If the wall is breached, Helm's Deep will fall."

title: Úlairë Cantëa
subtitle: Duplicitous Assassin
gameText:
Fierce. Each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each card he or she bears.
Skirmish: Exert Úlairë Cantëa to exert a companion with resistance 2 or less.
loreText: "Drawn to the power of the one. They will never stop hunting you."

title: Úlairë Enquëa
subtitle: Duplicitous Lieutenant
gameText:
Fierce. Each time the Free Peoples player heals a companion, you may add a burden.
Maneuver: Exert Úlairë Enquëa twice to discard a condition (or two conditions if you can spot 5 Free Peoples player's conditions).
loreText: "At all times they feel the presence of the ring."

title: Úlairë Otsëa
subtitle: Duplicitous Specter
gameText:
Fierce. When you play Úlairë Otsëa, you may spot another Nazgûl to draw a card for each wounded companion you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a wraith card from hand to add a burden.
loreText: "Blinded by their greed, they took them without question."

title: Ring of Savagery
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must either add a burden or exert a companion.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: Ring of Terror
gameText:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Bearer is damage +1.
When you play this artifact, you may remove 2 threats to take a wraith card into hand from your discard pile.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: The Witch-king
subtitle: Conqueror of Arthedain
gameText:
Fierce.
Each time the Witch-king wins a fierce skirmish, you may exert a companion for each companion you can spot over 4.

title: Dol Guldur
gameText: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Exert your minion and remove a threat to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.

title: Falls of Rauros
gameText: <keyword>River.</keyword> When the Fellowship moves to this site in region 2, the Free Peoples player places a card from the dead pile out of play.

title: Imladris
gameText: <keyword>River.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site, if it is a sanctuary, remove 2 burdens.

title: Nurn
gameText: <keyword>Plains.</keyword> While you control this site, each of your hunter minions is strength +1.

title: Gimli
subtitle: Sprinter
gameText:
Damage +1. Hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may add a threat to wound a minion (or wound a hunter minion twice).

title: Run Until Found
gameText:
When you play this condition, place a dwarven token here.
Skirmish: Discard this condition from play or remove a dwarven token from here to make a dwarven companion gain hunter 1.
loreText: "Let us hunt some Orc!"

title: Thorin's Harp
gameText:
Tale.
Maneuver: Exert a dwarven companion to make the fellowship's current site gain mountain until the regroup phase.

title: Arwen's Bow
gameText:
Bearer must be an elven companion.
Archery: If bearer is Arwen, discard 2 elven cards from hand to wound a minion.
loreText: Arwen had skill with a bow matched only by her beauty.

title: Arwen's Dagger
gameText:
Bearer must be an elven companion. Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
Maneuver: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to draw 2 cards.
loreText: Woe be to any against whom she wielded it.

title: Back to the Light
gameText: To play, exert an <symbol>elven</symbol> companion or spot Arwen. Examine the top 5 cards of your draw deck and place any number of them aside. Shuffle the remaining cards into your draw deck and place those cards set aside on top of your draw deck in any order.

title: Celebring
subtitle: Elven-smith
gameText:
Aid - twilight2 (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight2 to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot 2 elven companions.
When you play Celebring, you may play an elven artifact from your deck.
loreText: "...renewed shall be the blade that was broken."

title: Elven Armaments
gameText:
To play, bearer must not be bearing any possessions.
Bearer must be an elven companion. Bearer cannot bear any other possessions.
While a unique companion bears this possession, skip the archery phase.
loreText: "Tangado haid!"

title: Elven Defender
gameText: While you can spot an <symbol>elven</symbol> token, this companion is strength +2.
loreText: While they may prefer to avoid conflict, the elves can be ferocious warriors in defense of their ideals.

title: Elven Supplies
gameText:
Fellowship: Remove a culture token from a Free Peoples card to add an elven token here.
Skirmish: Remove 2 elven tokens from here to make a minion skirmishing an elven companion strength -1.
loreText: "By river you have the chance of outrunning the enemy..."

title: Galadriel's Silver Ewer
gameText:
To play, spot Galadriel or Celeborn.
While Galadriel is the Ring-bearer, she is strength +2 and resistance +2.
Each time you play an elven skirmish event, you may reinforce an elven token.
loreText: "Will you look into the mirror?"

title: Glorfindel
subtitle: Eldarin Lord
gameText:
Ranger. To play, spot 2 elven companions.
Minions skirmishing Glorfindel cannot gain strength bonuses from possessions.
Each time Glorfindel wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.
loreText: "'Yet oft in lies truth is hidden...'"

title: Haldir
subtitle: Warrior Messenger
gameText: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Exert Haldir or discard a <symbol>elven</symbol> card from hand to make a minion skirmishing Haldir strength -2.
loreText: "I bring word from Elrond of Rivendell."

title: Lembas Bread
gameText:
To play, spot 2 elven companions.
Bearer must be a companion.
Regroup: Discard this possession from play to reconcile your hand.
loreText: "Sam thought that it tasted far better, somehow, than it had for a good while..."

title: Miruvóre
gameText: Add 2 threats to heal an <symbol>elven</symbol> companion.
loreText: "The long years have passed like swift draughts of sweet mead in lofty halls beyond the West..."

title: Woodhall Elf
subtitle: Exile
gameText:
Aid - twilight2 (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight2 to transfer this to a companion.).
When you transfer this to an elven companion, you may draw 3 cards.
loreText: "'Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes.'"

title: Gil-galad
subtitle: High King of the Noldor
gameText:
To play, spot 2 elven companions.
Maneuver: Add a threat to take an elven event into hand from your discard pile.
Regroup: Remove an elven token to play an elven condition from your discard pile.
loreText: "'...the power of Gil-galad has increased in his absence.'"

title: Beorning Axe
gameText:
Bearer must be a gandalf Man.
While Grimbeorn is bearing this possession, each time he wins a skirmish, you may take a gandalf card from your discard pile into hand.
loreText: No Orc or wolf dared enter the land of the Beornings.

title: Drawn to Full Height
gameText: <keyword>Spell.</keyword> Spot a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> Wizard to make a minion lose all strength bonuses from possessions.
loreText: "I am not trying to rob you. I'm trying to help you."

title: Ents Marching
gameText: If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, exert 2 Ents to make an Ent defender +1. If the fellowship is in region 3, spot a <symbol>gandalf</symbol> companion to draw a card.
loreText: "The old that is strong does not wither; Deep roots are not reached by the frost."

title: Last Stand
gameText:
Fellowship: Exert a gandalf Man to add 2 gandalf tokens here.
Skirmish: Remove 3 gandalf tokens from here to make a companion strength +3.
loreText: To give his people time to escape, Brand stood against the Mordor army until he was slain. His friend, the dwarf Dain Ironfoot, stood over him until he too was slain.

title: Librarian
subtitle: Keeper of Ancient Texts
gameText:
While you can spot 2 gandalf tokens, each of your gandalf Men is strength +2.
Regroup: Discard a follower from play to choose one: draw a card; or take a gandalf skirmish event from your discard pile into hand.
loreText: A guide through books and scrolls from floor to ceiling.

title: One-Upsmanship
gameText: <keyword>Spell.</keyword> Spot 2 pipeweed cards to remove a burden for each <symbol>gandalf</symbol> Wizard you can spot.
loreText: Gandalf regarded the smoke ring for a moment, sucked his cheeks in, and blew out a majestic, full-rigged ship that sailed right through the ring.

title: Our Time
gameText:
Spell. To play, exert Gandalf.
When you play this condition, remove twilight3.
At the start of the maneuver phase, add twilight4 and remove this condition from the game.
loreText: "All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us."

title: Perspective
gameText: <keyword>Maneuver:</keyword> Add 2 threats and spot a Wizard to prevent a Shadow player from using special abilities on Shadow cards until the regroup phase.
loreText: "Hobbits really are amazing creatures! You can learn all that there is to know about their ways in a month, and yet after a hundred years, they can still surprise you."

title: Radagast's Herb Bag
gameText:
Bearer must be a gandalf Wizard.
Each time you play a gandalf spell, you may exert bearer to wound a minion.
loreText: The tools of a master of herb and beast-lore were often confined to the simplest of places.

title: Ship of Smoke
gameText: <keyword>Pipeweed.</keyword> Each time you play a pipeweed card, you may spot Gandalf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the remaining cards.
loreText: "Old Toby. The finest weed in the Southfarthing."

title: Countless Cords
gameText: Spot Shelob to make a minion strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
loreText: "'But don't go on, master! Don't go down to that den! Now's our only chance. Now let's get out of this foul hole!'"

title: Deceit
gameText: <keyword>Response:</keyword> If a Free Peoples player's card is about to discard your other <symbol>gollum</symbol> condition, remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> to prevent that.
loreText: "Presently they were under the shadow, and there in the midst of it they saw the opening of a cave. 'This is the way in,' said Gollum softly."

title: Enemy in Your Midst
gameText: Heal a Ring-bound companion to reinforce a <symbol>gollum</symbol> token.
loreText: Earning pity and trust was the first step of Gollum's plan to reclaim his precious.

title: It Draws Him
gameText: Spot a <symbol>gollum</symbol> card to play a minion. Its twilight cost -1 (or -3 if it is roaming).
loreText: "He will never be rid of his need for it. He hates and loves the Ring, as he hates and loves himself."

title: Not Easily Avoided
gameText:
Shadow: Remove twilight3 to take a gollum card into hand from your draw deck, then randomly discard a card from your hand.
Skirmish: Discard a gollum card from hand to make a gollum minion strength +2.
loreText: "'But I still feel that they are looking at me, or thinking about me: making some other plan, perhaps.'"

title: Set Up
gameText: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to return a follower to its owner's hand.
loreText: "He took it!! I've seen him. He is always stuffing his face when Master is not looking."

title: Shelob
subtitle: Menace
gameText:
Fierce. Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may add threats up to the number of burdens you can spot.
Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may play Gollum from your discard pile; he is strength +3 and fierce until the end of turn.

title: Sting of Shelob
gameText:
To play, spot Shelob.
The Free Peoples player chooses two companions. He or she then chooses to place one of those companions in the dead pile and return the other to his or her hand.
loreText: "Poison frothed and bubbled..."

title: Time for Food
gameText: If a skirmish event is played, spot Sméagol to cancel that event.
loreText: "Oh yes we could! Spoil nice fish. Give it to usss rrraw... and wrrriggling! You keep nasty chips."

title: Trusted Promise
gameText: Reinforce a <symbol>gollum</symbol> token. Each Shadow player may draw a card.
loreText: "We swears to serve the master of the preciousss. We will swear on... on the precious."

title: Aragorn
subtitle: Heir to the Throne of Gondor
gameText:
Hunter 2.
While you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, Aragorn is defender +1.
While you can spot 2 Shadow cultures, Aragorn is defender +1.

title: Armor of the White City
gameText: Bearer must be a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man. Bearer is a <keyword>knight</keyword>.
loreText: "'Surely this is the greatest jest in all the history of Gondor: that we should ride with seven thousand, scarce as many as the vanguard of its army in the days of its power, to assail the mountains and the impenetrable gate of the Black Land!'"

title: Boromir
subtitle: Proud and Noble Man
gameText:
Ranger.
When you play Boromir (except in your starting fellowship), you may play a possession with a twilight cost of 1 or less on him from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.
loreText: "Yes, there is weakness. There is frailty. But there is courage also, and honor to be found in Men."

title: Crown of Gondor
gameText:
To play, spot Aragorn, Elendil, or Isildur.
Skirmish: Spot a gondor Man with 3 or more vitality and discard a gondor card from hand to make that Man strength +2.
loreText: "Et Eärello Endorenna utúlien. Sinome maruvan ar Hildinyar tenn' Ambar-metta!"

title: Denethor
subtitle: On the Edge of Madness
gameText:
Each time the fellowship moves from a site, add a burden.
Skirmish: Exert another gondor Man to make him or her strength +1 and damage +1.
loreText: "No tomb for Denethor and Faramir. No long, slow sleep of death embalmed."

title: Denethor's Sword
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
While bearer is Denethor, his game text does not apply.
loreText: "But if doom denies this to me, then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated."

title: Defenses Long Held
gameText: Make a ranger strength +2 and you may reinforce a <symbol>gondor</symbol> token.
loreText: "Let the armies of Mordor know this: Never again will the land of my people fall into enemy hands!"

title: Dúnadan's Bow
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor ranger.
Archery: Discard 2 gondor cards from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1.
loreText: Well trained and deadly accurate, a ranger's bow was more an extension of himself than a weapon of wood.

title: Disarmed
gameText:
Bearer cannot bear any Shadow cards.
When this condition is transferred to bearer, discard all Shadow cards it bears.
Maneuver: Exert a gondor Man or spot a ranger to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.
loreText: In a flurry of swordplay, Aragorn sliced his arm off.

title: Elendil's Army
gameText: Aid - Exert a gondor companion. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a gondor companion to transfer this to a companion.)
loreText: "...and on the slopes of Mount Doom they fought for the freedom of Middle-earth."

title: Faramir
subtitle: Captain of Ithilien
gameText:
Ranger. Hunter 2.
If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1.
Maneuver: Exert Faramir to heal a companion with resistance 5 or more.
loreText: "There are no travelers in this land. Only servants of the Dark Tower."

title: Faramir's Company
gameText:
Aid - Add a threat.(At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.)
When you attach this card to a companion, spot a gondor possession to heal that companion.
loreText: Cloaked rangers armed with deadly arrows and swords.

title: The Faithful Stone
gameText:
Tale.
Each time a non-wraith minion is played, you may spot a Man to put a gondor token here.
Maneuver: Remove 3 gondor tokens from here to spot a minion. That minion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the regroup phase.
loreText: Each turn was guarded by Púkel-men stones with their huge, clumsy arms folded across their round bellies.

title: For Gondor!
gameText: Exert a knight to make him or her strength +3.
loreText: "This city was once the jewel of our kingdom. A place of light and beauty and music. And so it shall be once more!"

title: Gondorian Servant
subtitle: Denethor's Handman
gameText:
Aid - twilight1. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight1 to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you attach this to a companion, except a gondor Man, add twilight4.
loreText: If the personal servants of Denethor were aware of his madness, they were wise to conceal it.

title: Horn of Boromir
subtitle: The Great Horn
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
Maneuver: Exert bearer and discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 until the regroup phase (if bearer is Boromir, he is also defender +1 and cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled).

title: Isildur
subtitle: Sword-bearer
gameText:
Knight. Each time Isildur loses a skirmish, exert a companion.
Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a companion.
loreText: "It was in this moment, when all hope had faded, that Isildur, son of the king, took up his father's sword."

title: Ranger of the North
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
Maneuver: If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, you may exert bearer to make him or her defender +1.
Regroup: Discard this to heal a companion.
loreText: "This is no mere ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn. You owe him your allegiance."

title: Ranger of the South
gameText: <keyword>Ranger.</keyword> While you can spot a<symbol>gondor</symbol>token, this companion is strength +2.
loreText: "All had swords at their sides, and were clad in green and brown of varied hues, as if the better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien."

title: Shield of the White Tree
gameText:
Bearer must be a gondor Man.
The minion archery total is -1.
Regroup: Discard this possession from play to make each opponent shuffle his or her hand into his or her draw deck and draw 8 cards.
loreText: Tipped with silver, and adorned with the White Tree.

title: Soldier's Cache
gameText:
Fortification.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot 3 rangers or exert a gondor Man to transfer this condition to a minion. Wound that minion.
Regroup: Exert a ranger to reinforce a gondor token.

title: Watcher at Sarn Ford
subtitle: Ranger of the North
gameText:
Ranger.
Skirmish: Exert a gondor Man with a resistance 6 or more to make that Man strength +3.
loreText: "'Little do they know of our long labour for the safekeeping of their borders, and yet I grudge it not.'"

title: Corsair Boarding Axe
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
Skirmish: Remove twilight3 to reinforce a men token and make bearer fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: Small and light, the boarding axe is ideal for close-quarters fighting aboard ships or in confined spaces.

title: Corsair Bow
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
Bearer is an archer.
Each time a companion is killed during the archery phase, you may control a site.
loreText: Not nearly as ornate or as accurate as the Gondorian bows, the short-bows of the Corsairs killed just as well.

title: Corsair Grappling Hook
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
When you play this possession you may reinforce a men token twice.
Each time a companion is killed during a skirmish phase, you may control a site.
loreText: A tool equally useful in times of peace and in times of war.

title: Corsair Halberd
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
Bearer is damage +1.
Shadow: Remove a companion in the dead pile from the game to control a site.
loreText: Long handled and heavy, a single powerful swing of this weapon could cleave through even some of the thickest armor.

title: Corsair Scimitar
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
Bearer is strength +1 for each men token you can spot (limit +5).
loreText: A largely stylistic weapon, scimitars are favored for their light weight yet powerful strikes.

title: Declined Business
gameText: If the Free Peoples player plays a companion, discard a <symbol>men</symbol> card from hand to return that companion to its owner's hand.
loreText: During the War of the Ring, the streets of Bree were filled mainly with Southern ruffians and thieves, and Bree-folk were afraid to leave their homes.

title: Fleet of Corsair Ships
gameText:
When you play this possession, you may add a men token here.
Regroup: Remove 4 men tokens from here to place a men card from your discard pile on the top of your draw deck.
loreText: "They'll be in the city in two days. You're outnumbered, Aragorn."

title: Gríma
subtitle: Witless Worm
gameText:
Regroup: Exert Gríma to add twilight2.
Regroup: Remove a men token to add twilight2.
Regroup: Remove twilight4 to exert an unbound companion.
loreText: "'You are held wise, my friend Wormtongue, and are doubtless a great support to your master.'"

title: Harry Goatleaf
gameText:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
loreText: "What do you want?"

title: Henchman's Dagger
gameText:
Bearer must be a men minion.
Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
loreText: Carved from bone or forged from iron, no warrior would enter the fields of battle without a trusty, simple blade.

title: Ill News is an Ill Guest
gameText: Exert a <symbol>men</symbol> minion to discard a follower from play (if you can spot Gríma, also draw a card).
loreText: "Late is the hour in which this conjurer chooses to appear."
englishTitle: Ill News is an Ill Guest

title: Mûmakil Commander
subtitle: Bold and Grim
gameText:
While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
Each mounted Man is strength +1.
Regroup: Shuffle any number of your men mounts in play into your draw deck.
loreText: With a sound of his horn, a line of Mûmakil appeared and the Pelennor field was filled with chaos.

title: Ruffian
gameText:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
loreText: "It works for him!"

title: Grond
subtitle: Forged With Black Steel
gameText:
To play, spot an orc minion.
Each time the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, you may discard this possession to search the Free Peoples player's draw deck and remove up to 2 Free Peoples cards from the game.
loreText: "Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond!"

title: Rough Man of the South
gameText:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
loreText: Making money and making mischief was often inspiration enough for these louts. The taking of Bree and the Shire was easy work.

title: Gruesome Meal
gameText: Make a companion skirmishing an <symbol>orc</symbol> minion strength -2 (or -3 if he or she is an archer).
loreText: They dined on the flesh of all that lived and breathed in Middle-earth.

title: Squint-eyed Southerner
gameText:
While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4.
While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
loreText: A man of Dunland, this outlaw was a prized agent of Saruman and a spy for the Witch-king.

title: Orkish Ax
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc Orc.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
loreText: Crude blood rusted steel axes were dragged by Orcs from battle to battle.

title: Ted Sandyman
subtitle: Chief's Men's Ally
gameText:
Maneuver: Liberate a site you control to make each men minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
Regroup: Exert Ted Sandyman to stack a men Man in play on a possession.
loreText: "'You can't touch me. I'm a friend o' Boss's. But he'll touch you all right, if I have any more of your mouth.'"

title: Orkish Aggressor
gameText: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
loreText: Enraged by Sauron, the frenzied Orcs streamed to the battlefields.

title: Treachery
gameText: Spot Gríma to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use his or her game text until the regroup phase.
loreText: "This order does not come from me. It comes from the king. He signed it this morning."

title: Orkish Archer Troop
gameText:
To play, spot an orc card.
The minion archery total is +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
loreText: "...the enemy is moving. Sauron's forces are massing in the east..."

title: Whisper in the Dark
gameText:
Bearer must be a follower.
At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must exert an unbound companion.
loreText: "My lord, Gandalf the Grey is coming. He's a herald of woe."

title: Destroyers and Usurpers
gameText:
Each companion loses all defender bonuses and cannot gain defender bonuses.
Maneuver: Spot 2 orc minions to make the fellowship's current site gain battleground until the regroup phase.
loreText: "They come with fire, they come with axes. Gnawing, biting, breaking, hacking, burning!"

title: Frenzy of Arrows
gameText: Spot an <symbol>orc</symbol> minion to add 2 to the minion archery total. Then add an additional 2 to the minion archery total for each follower you can spot.
loreText: The black fletched arrows of Sauron's armies found many targets.

title: Gothmog
subtitle: Morgul Leader
gameText:
Each the fellowship and minion archery totals are +3.
Regroup: Remove twilight2 to play an orc minion from your discard pile.
loreText: "Fear. The city is rank with it."

title: Gothmog's Warg
subtitle: Leader's Mount
gameText:
Bearer must be an orc Orc with strength 9 or less (or bearer must be Gothmog).
Bearer is fierce.
While bearer is Gothmog, he is damage +1 in fierce skirmishes.

title: Orkish Breeder
gameText:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Shadow: Exert this minion to play an urukhai hunter at twilight cost -2.
loreText: Deep in the Isengard pits, Orcs tended the mud from which the Uruk-hai were pulled from.

title: Orkish Defender
gameText: While the fellowship is at a battleground or underground site, this minion cannot take wounds in the archery phase.
loreText: "'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'"

title: Orkish Headsman
gameText:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This minion is strength +3 for each companion in the dead pile (limit +6).
loreText: As the free people of Middle-earth fell, Mordor's strength grew.

title: Orkish Skirmisher
gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert him twice to wound a companion.
loreText: Pain. Pain was part of each Orc's life.

title: Orkish Sneak
gameText:
Assignment: Spot another orc Orc to assign this minion to skirmish a non-shire Ring-bearer.
The Free Peoples player may add a burden or exert the Ring-bearer twice to discard this minion.
loreText: The Orcs attacked the Alliance, rushing across the field that separated the armies.

title: War Preparations
gameText: Remove a threat to reinforce an <symbol>orc</symbol> token.
loreText: "The old world will burn in the fires of industry. The forests will fall. A new order will rise. We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear and the iron fists of the Orc. We have only to remove those who oppose us."

title: Wary Orc
gameText: This minion is strength +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
loreText: "War is brewing. The mountains are fair teeming with goblins."

title: Cast from the Hall
gameText:
Each time you play a rohan possession, add a rohan token here.
Skirmish: Remove 3 rohan tokens from here to make a rohan companion strength +1 and damage +1.
loreText: "Your leechcraft would have had me crawling on all fours like a beast!"

title: Éomer's Bow
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1.
Archery: If bearer is Éomer, exert him to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
loreText: The short bows of Rohan brought down many a foe on the fields of battle.

title: Erkenbrand's Horn
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
Fellowship: Exert bearer to play a follower from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.
Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 (if bearer is Erkenbrand, he is strength +5 instead).

title: -Erkenbrand's Shield
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man.
The minion archery total is -1.
Skirmish: Add twilight2 to cancel a fierce skirmish involving bearer.
Response: If a rohan Man is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf and exert bearer to prevent that wound.

title: Fall Back to Helm's Deep
gameText: If the fellowship is at a plains site, exert a <symbol>rohan</symbol> companion to return a minion to its owner's hand.
loreText: "This is not a defeat. We will return."

title: Gamling
subtitle: Dutiful Marshal
gameText:
Valiant.
Skirmish: Transfer a rohan possession that Gamling can bear to him.
loreText: "Summon every able-bodied man to Dunharrow."

title: Gamling's Horn
gameText:
Bearer must be a rohan Man or Merry.
Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4. If bearer is Gamling, you may also spot another companion to make him or her strength +4 until the regroup phase.
loreText: "Sound the charge! Take them head-on!"

title: Precise Attack
gameText: Discard a <symbol>rohan</symbol> possession from play to choose one: Wound an unwounded minion; exert a minion; or discard a Shadow card the Ring-bearer is bearing.
loreText: Éomer's spear, now thrown, brought down the Haradrim leader.

title: Rohirrim Diadem
gameText:
To play, spot Théoden.
Skirmish: Spot a rohan Man bearing a possession and discard a rohan possession from hand to make that Man strength +2.
loreText: With Gríma's treacherous whispers removed and Saruman's grasp released, none doubted the might and lordship of Théoden, the King of Rohan.

title: Rohirrim Recruit
gameText:
Valiant.
While you can spot a rohan token, this companion is strength +2.
loreText: Even the older men of Rohan had talents in the arts of war.

title: Surrendered Weapons
gameText:
Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a rohan companion to discard a possession a character is bearing from play.
Skirmish: Add twilight1 to transfer a rohan possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.
loreText: "I cannot allow you before Théoden-King so armed."

title: Théoden
subtitle: Ednew
gameText:
While you can spot Gandalf, Théoden is resistance +2.
While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1.
While you can spot 3 mounted rohan companions, Théoden is strength +2.
loreText: "Now for wrath! Now for ruin! And a red dawn!"

title: A Dragon's Tale
gameText:
Tale. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Maneuver: Discard a tale from play to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
loreText: "If you're referring to the incident with the dragon, I was barely involved. All I did was give your uncle a little nudge out of the door."

title: Fredegar Bolger
subtitle: Fatty
gameText: While the fellowship in is region 1 and you can spot 2 other <symbol>shire</symbol> companions, Fredegar Bolger is strength +3.
loreText: "'You'll wish you were back here with me before this time tomorrow.'"

title: Golden Perch Ale
gameText:
Each time a shire companion wins a skirmish, you may add a shire token here.
Fellowship: Remove a shire token here to remove a burden.
loreText: "'The best beer in the Eastfarthing, or used to be: it is a long time since I tasted it.'"

title: Make a Run For It
gameText: Remove 2 <symbol>shire</symbol> tokens to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
loreText: "As soon as he saw the dark shapes creep from the garden he knew that he must run for it, or perish. And run he did, out of the back door, through the garden, and over the fields."

title: Prized Lagan
gameText:
At the start of each turn, you may add twilight2 to heal a shire companion.
Maneuver: Add a threat to spot a minion. That minion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce until the regroup phase.
loreText: "We are sitting on the field of victory, enjoying a few well-earned comforts."

title: Robin Smallburrow
subtitle: Shirriff Cock-Robin
gameText:
Aid - twilight2. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add twilight2 to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you attach this follower to a shire companion, you may discard X cards from hand to draw X cards.

title: Scouring of the Shire
gameText:
Tale.
When there are 4 shire tokens here, discard this condition from play.
Response: If a shire condition or shire possession is about to be discarded from play by a Shadow card, add a shire token here to prevent that.

title: Sting
subtitle: Elven Long Knife
gameText:
Bearer must be Bilbo or Frodo.
Regroup: Exert bearer to remove a threat.
loreText: "My old sword, Sting! Here! Take it, take it!"

title: Cleaved
gameText:
Regroup: Exert an urukhai hunter twice to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion.
Archery: Spot an urukhai minion to transfer this condition from your support area to a Free Peoples archer.

title: Final Triumph
gameText: Spot your Uruk-hai skirmishing a companion to use vitality to resolve that skirmish instead of strength.
loreText: Now left alone, it stopped before its foe. With a snarl it pulled back the bow, ready to deliver the last blow.

title: Fury of the Evil Army
gameText:
Bearer must be an urukhai minion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose one: discard a follower from play; heal an urukhai minion; or control a site.
loreText: "What can men do against such reckless hate?"

title: Ghastly Wound
gameText: Make an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion strength +2 and <keyword>damage +1</keyword>.
loreText: That force of ten-thousand Uruk-hai was designed for the downfall of Man - and all those that allied with them.

title: Lurtz
subtitle: Halfling Hunter
gameText:
Archer. Damage +1.
Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase.
Assignment: Exert Lurtz twice to assign it to an unbound companion. The Free Peoples player may exert that companion or add a burden to prevent this.

title: Lurtz's Bow
subtitle: Black-fletch Bow
gameText:
Bearer must be an Uruk-hai.
When you play this possession on Lurtz, you may draw a card.
Archery: If bearer is Lurtz, discard 2 urukhai cards from hand to exert an unbound companion.
loreText: The bow of the Uruk captain dealt a powerful blow.

title: New Forges Built
gameText: Exert an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion to reinforce an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> token.
loreText: "'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'"

title: Pikes Upon Pikes
gameText:
Each urukhai minion bearing a hand weapon cannot take wounds during the archery phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make an urukhai minion bearing a possession strength +2.
loreText: Many a crude weapon was forged for his forces.

title: Shagrat
subtitle: Tower Captain
gameText:
Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While you can spot 7 possessions, Shagrat is fierce and cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
loreText: "I don't take orders from stinking Morgul rats!"

title: Tracking the Prize
gameText: While you can spot 3 <symbol>urukhai</symbol> hunters, at the start of each skirmish involving an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> hunter, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.
loreText: Though bred for battle, the Uruks could track prey like the best of hunters.

title: White Hand Attacker
gameText:
Damage +1.
While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
loreText: The Uruk-hai army stopped and growled in anticipation of the upcoming battle.

title: White Hand Exorciser
gameText:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may heal an urukhai minion.
loreText: "March to Helms Deep! Leave none alive!"

title: White Hand Marchers
gameText:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each other urukhai minion you can spot.
loreText: The enormous Uruk-hai armies marched with great speed.

title: White Hand Marshal
gameText:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may control a site.
loreText: The Men and Elves looked out into the darkness, and through the rain they saw, lit by the thousands of torches, the huge advancing Uruk-hai army.

title: White Hand Mystic
gameText:
Damage +1.
Response: If an urukhai minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that wound.
loreText: The Uruk-hai... resilient... imposing...

title: White Hand Sieger
gameText:
Damage +1.
To play, spot an urukhai minion and you must control a site.
loreText: The flood of Uruk-hai storming the Deeping Wall seemed to be unstoppable.

title: White Hand Traveler
gameText:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Spot 2 other urukhai minions and remove twilight2 to make this minion strength +1 and damage +1.
loreText: The Uruk-hai troop snuck along through the forest following the three boats carrying the Fellowship.

title: White Hand Uruk
gameText:
Damage +1.
To play, spot an urukhai minion.

title: All Life Flees
gameText:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Remove twilightX to choose one: discard a follower from play that has a twilight cost of X; or play from deck a wraith minion that has a twilight cost of X.
loreText: "A sudden unreasoning fear of discovery laid hold of Frodo, and he thought of his Ring."

title: Pull of the Ring
gameText: Remove a burden to choose one: assign a <symbol>wraith</symbol> minion to a companion who has resistance 0; or have a <symbol>wraith</symbol> minion lose <keyword>fierce</keyword> and gain <keyword>hunter 2</keyword>.
loreText: "I'm naked in the dark. There's nothing, no veil between me and the Wheel of Fire. I can see him with my waking eyes!"

title: Doorway to Doom
gameText: <keyword>Mountain.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site, each player wounds two of his or her characters.

title: Foot of Mount Doom
gameText: <keyword>Mountain.</keyword> Each card that is about to be placed into the discard pile is removed from the game instead.

title: Mithlond
gameText: <keyword>River.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site, each player heals each of his or her characters.

title: Morannon Plains
gameText: <keyword>Battleground. Plains.</keyword> When the fellowship moves to this site, each player may reinforce a culture token.

title: Sirannon Ruins
gameText: <keyword>River.</keyword>

title: Steward's Tomb
gameText: Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.

title: Streets of Bree
gameText: <keyword>Dwelling.</keyword> While the fellowship is at this site, followers cannot be transferred to a character.

title: The One Ring
subtitle: The Great Ring
gameText:
While wearing The One Ring, each time bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Add a burden to make the Ring-bearer strength +3.

title: Gimli
subtitle: Opinionated Guide
gameText:
Damage +1. Fellowship.
Each time you play a dwarven possession, you may draw a card.
loreText: If anyone was to ask for my opinion, which I note they're not, I'd say we were taking the long way round.

title: Still Twitching
gameText:
Bearer must be a dwarven companion.
Bearer gains Hunter 2.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another dwarven companion. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, discard this condition from play.

title: That's Two!
gameText: Spot Gimli and exert a fellowship companion to have each Shadow player discard one of his or her Shadow cards from play.
loreText: Legolas, two already!

title: Army Long Trained
gameText:
Bearer must be an elven companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another elven companion.

title: Arwen
subtitle: Royal Maiden
gameText:
Ranger.
While you can spot 2 elven followers, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength 2.
Maneuver: Add 3 threats to reconcile your hand.
